title.rendered: Best iMessage games to play with friends (2026)

content.rendered:
iMessage is one of the primary reasons why people choose to stay in the Apple Ecosystem. It is touted as one of the safest means of messaging and fun as well. iMessage has been updated with many other fun features like stickers, memoji, animoji, and bubble effect messages; the game integration update remains people’s favorite. I have a list of games that I love to play within iMessage, and I have filtered the best iMessage games that you can play with your friends. Let’s have a look.

10 best iMessage games

Here are fun iMessage games to enjoy with your friends anytime, anywhere! To play these iMessage games, the other person must also have the game installed on their iPhone or iPad.

1. GamePegion

GamePegion is an exceptional platform for all types of gamers, offering the best iMessage games for iPhones and iPads. Catering to several interests and preferences, GamePegion includes arcade classics to trivia challenges. These meticulously designed games feature captivating graphics, smooth gameplay, and intuitive controls.

Whether you’re a seasoned player or a pro, getting started with GamePegion on iPhone is really easy. It further features multiplayer functionality over games like Gomoku, allowing you to play iMessage games on iPhone, compete with friends, or challenge your gaming foes right in iMessage itself. Moreover, you will always have a favorite game at your disposal, with regular updates keeping the library fresh.

Price: Free (In-app purchase starts at $1.99)

Download

2. 8 Ball Pool™ – Online Pool Multiplayer Games

Straight from the house of Miniclip, 8 Ball Pool is an iMessage game with fans worldwide. It offers an immersive and enjoyable pool-playing experience right at your fingertips. With incredible graphics, it will take you through an immersive gaming experience where you can aim and shoot the cue ball with precision.

We’re not done yet. The multiplayer mode of 8 Ball Pool is one of a kind. Here, players can compete against their friends or challenge opponents from around the world, ensuring endless hours of fun and excitement. With regular updates and new features, including new tables and cues to unlock, 8 Ball Pool is sure to satisfy the needs of all pool enthusiasts.

Price: Free (In-app purchase starts at $0.99)

Download

3. Bubble Witch 3 Saga – Shoot, blast & pop bubbles!

The renowned creators of Candy Crush Saga bring another masterpiece entitled Bubble Witch 3 Saga. This game seamlessly integrates into the iMessage platform, offering a captivating and enchanting gaming experience. Bubble Witch 3 Saga stands out among its competitors not only for its gameplay but also for its stunning graphics, compelling storyline, and challenging gameplay.

While strategically using several boosters and power-ups to progress through levels, players must precisely take down their targets. The easy-to-understand controls make it extremely simple for the players to embark on an enchanting journey filled with magical spells and powerful potions as they help Stella the Witch in her quest to defeat Wilbur the Cat.

And you’re not alone in this saga. The game incorporates competitors across the world showcasing their skills. All in all, this deadly combination of realistic graphics and addictive gameplay mechanics is enough to offer an exceptional iMessage gaming experience.

Price: Free (In-app purchase starts at $0.99)

Download

4. Cobi Arrows – Super fun Archery action!

Developed by Cobra Mobile Ltd., Cobi Arrows is widely regarded as one of the best iOS iMessage games available for iPhone and iPad users. It combines puzzle-solving with strategy, quick reflexes, and strategic thinking to enrich players with an immersive experience. This game seamlessly integrates with the Messages app, creating a unique and engaging experience for players of all ages.

You can further compete with your friends in iMessage chat. The game is simple: shoot for the bullseye while adjusting your aim for distance and wind. You must hit all targets popping up within the respective time frame. With its intuitive controls, stunning graphics, and captivating soundtrack, Cobi Arrows keeps players glued to their screens for hours on end.

Price: Free (In-app purchase starts at $1.99)

Download

5. Pictoword – Fun Word Quiz Games

Featured as the most popular word game in 30 countries, meet Pictoword. This highly addictive game combines word puzzles with picture guessing. Simply put, you will get a set of images that represent a word or phrase to decipher the combination. With categories such as food, movies, and famous landmarks, Pictoword is an all-time fun iMessage game to enjoy with friends and family.

Apart from offering a unique and engaging iMessage gameplay experience, it provides hints for those tricky puzzles. There are also tons of fun trivia categories, so it is not just limited to word pictorial puzzles. Besides, its seamless integration with iMessage allows for effortless gameplay without the need for additional apps or downloads.

Price: Free (In-app purchase starts at $0.99)

Download

6. Cobi Hoops – The basketball mayhem

Cobi Hoops is a one-stop destination for your hooping hunger. The goal is simple yet challenging, and players need to flick their fingers toward the basketball hoop and aim to score as many baskets as possible within the time count. The quick response mechanics and seamless controls of the game will keep you engaged for hours while offering the real court feel right on your device.

Cobi Hoops further offers a variety of levels and challenges to keep you hooked. Above all else, the in-game sounds enhance the gaming experience, ensuring that every dime is well spent. Players can also customize their basketball experience by choosing from a range of different teams and players, each with their own unique abilities and skills.

Price: Free (In-app purchase starts at $1.99)

Download

7. Solitaire – Fun classic Klondike card game

Due to its timeless appeal and engaging gameplay, Solitaire is highly regarded as one of the best games to play on iMessage. Users can enjoy this classic card game filled with an intuitive interface on iMessage, regardless of the device. With a series of challenging levels and multiple game modes at your disposal, this game will definitely keep you entertained for hours.

The stunning graphics and responsive touch controls make it easy for the players to enjoy a truly immersive experience. If you ask me, Solitaire is simply perfect for both casual players and seasoned enthusiasts looking to blow off some steam. So, what are you waiting for? Show your cards and steal the win away.

Price: Free (In-app purchase starts at $1.99)

Download

8. Tic Tac Toe – Duel & play with your friends

By now, we’ve been through a series of amazing games you can enjoy on your iPhone’s messaging app. However, the next one is something you’re all going to love – Tic Tac Toe. With its simplistic yet strategic gameplay, this iconic game has managed to captivate players for decades. Boasting an intuitive interface, this game is enriched with smooth graphics and responsive controls.

Tickling one’s brain cells with each move, this delightful rendition of Tic Tac Toe promises endless hours of fun while also testing one’s analytical skills and tactical abilities. From its polished design to its addicting gameplay, this iMessage game undoubtedly stands out as one of the best choices for casual gamers looking to enjoy quality entertainment at their fingertips.

Price: Free (In-app purchase starts at $0.99)

Download

9. Let’s Puck It! – Air Hockey simulation

If you’re a hockey fan, you can see what’s coming your way. Let’s Puck It has obtained popularity among players who enjoy a quick dose of air hockey. This virtual air hockey game offers a realistic and addictive gameplay experience. With each passing level, the speed increases, making it harder to score. There’s nothing more addictive and greater for resolving disputes than this simple game.

With various game modes such as Classic, Timed, and Challenge, Let’s Puck It caters to different playing styles and skill levels. The game also features power-ups that enhance gameplay by introducing unique abilities and challenges. Its sleek design and fluid animations further contribute to its appeal, making it immersive and engaging entertainment.

Price: Free (In-app purchase starts at $0.99)

Download

10. WIT – Make your own puzzles

Before we begin our last presentation, let’s decode the title, shall we? WIT stands for several titles, such as What Is This? Where Is This? Who Is This? Why Is This? When Is This? Designed to offer a fun and interactive gaming experience, WIT combines creativity with strategic thinking by presenting players with various images and challenging them to guess the hidden word or phrase.

With its sleek design and user-friendly interface, WIT can act as a long-lasting entertainment hub for players of all ages. Whether you prefer puzzle games to challenge your problem-solving skills or action-packed adventures to get your adrenaline pumping, look no further than WIT’s collection of iMessage games for iPhone and iPad.

Price: $0.99

Play your heart out!

From brain-teasing puzzles to trivia adventures, the iMessage App Store offers a treasure trove of games to explore. So, why wait? Dive into the captivating world of iMessage games, challenge your contacts, and let the fun unfold right in your messages. Until next time, may your texts be filled with competition, camaraderie, and countless moments of gaming joy.

title.rendered: How to clear Facebook cache on iPhone or iPad

content.rendered:
Key takeaways
  • You can easily clear cache on Facebook iOS app from its Settings. Go to Settings and privacy > Settings > Browser and tap Clear beside Cookies and cache.
  • Deleting the Facebook app also remove its cache from your iPhone.
  • Clearing cache will not erase any of your account information on Facebook, including your profile, pictures, updates etc.

Are you experiencing frequent crashes or lags while scrolling your Facebook news feed? The Facebook app collects cached data that might slow down your device or make it behave erratically. To avoid these issues, you need to clear the Facebook app cache from your iPhone.

This improves the performance of your iPhone and iPad and frees up storage space. In this guide, I will explain why clearing Facebook’s cache is important and show you how to do it on your iPhone and iPad.

Table of Contents
  • What is Facebook cache on iPhone?
  • Why should you clear your Facebook cache on your iPhone and iPad?
  • How to clear your Facebook app's cache on an iPhone
  • Clear Facebook cache on iPhone by deleting the app

What is Facebook cache on iPhone?

The Facebook cache is a collection of temporary files stored by the app on your iPhone or iPad. Whenever you use Facebook—whether you’re scrolling through your feed, watching videos, or liking posts—the app stores your activity data to help speed up your future interactions. This includes images, videos, comments, and other content in the posts, pages, and profiles you visit.

So, the cache saves information on your device for Facebook to access quickly without requesting it from the internet each time you use the app. If you open the Facebook app offline, you will see a news feed with posts you have already read.

Despite their usefulness, caches also have disadvantages. Over time, this saved information accumulates on your iPhone, occupying a considerable amount of space and might affect its performance. If the cache isn’t cleared regularly, it can get corrupted, causing the app to slow down, crash, or behave unpredictably.

Why should you clear your Facebook cache on your iPhone and iPad?

As I already mentioned, clearing your Facebook cache plays a crucial role in maintaining the app’s and your device’s performance. Here’s why you should consider doing it:

  • Free up storage space: As the cache accumulates, it can take up considerable space on your iPhone or iPad. Clearing the cache can free up space if you’re running low on storage. So your device can run more smoothly and make Facebook load faster.
  • Improve app performance: A bloated cache can slow down the Facebook app, causing lag, freezing, or crashes. Clearing the Facebook app cache removes outdated or unnecessary data, helping the app function properly and reducing glitches.
  • Resolve app issues: If you’ve noticed that Facebook is acting up, like not loading content properly, being unable to update your profile, etc., deleting the cache can often resolve these issues. It gives the app a fresh start and eliminates potential conflicts.
  • Fetch new content: Long-stored cache data may often show older content on the news feed. Clearing Facebook caches from iPhone forces the app to retrieve the most current data from the server.

In summary, regularly clearing your Facebook cache is a performance booster and an effective way of removing common app-related problems. So, how frequently should you do this? You should clear your Facebook app cache every few weeks or when there are any indications of poor performance.

And do not worry; clearing the cache does not erase any of your personal data, such as Facebook posts, messages, or photos. It only deletes the app’s temporary local files.

Pro tip

Even though removing cache from Facebook may slightly improve performance, you must delete cache of other apps to optimize your iPhone’s speed and efficiency. I advise clearing cache on Safari and deleting browsing history of Chrome.

How to clear your Facebook app’s cache on an iPhone

  1. Launch the Facebook app on your iPhone. 
  2. Tap the Menu icon → Scroll down, and tap Settings & Privacy → choose Settings. 
  3. Scroll down and choose Browser under the Permissions section. 
  4. Tap the Clear button next to Cookies and cache.

Clear Facebook cache on iPhone by deleting the app

After clearing your browsing data, if Facebook is still slow and unresponsive on your iPhone, you can delete the app and reinstall it. Here’s how.

  1. Open the Settings app on your iPhone. 
  2. Tap General → iPhone Storage → Facebook.

  3. Choose Delete App → tap Delete App to confirm.

  4. Return to the home screen of your iPhone and open the App Store.
  5. Type Facebook in the Search section and reinstall the app.

Alternatively, you can press and hold the Facebook app on your iPhone Home Screen → tap Remove App → Delete App → select Delete. 

To uninstall the Facebook app from the App Library, tap and hold the app icon → tap Delete App.

Wrapping up… 

Has clearing the Facebook cache on your iPhone improved your privacy and speed? You can also experiment with other features, like customizing your feeds and enabling dark mode, to enhance your Facebook experience. 

Do you still have questions about clearing the cache on Facebook? Please let me know in the comments.

FAQs

How often should I clear the Facebook cache on my iPhone or iPad?

If you actively use Facebook daily, the cache files can quickly pile up. So, you must delete them once every 1-2 weeks. For moderate users, clearing the cache once every month is sufficient.

Does clearing the cache delete any of my Facebook data?

Not at all. Deleting the Facebook app cache does not affect your information. You will still stay logged into Facebook, and your friends list, shared photos, chats, and other activities will remain as they were.

reviewedBy.description: "The founder of iGeeksBlog, Dhvanesh, is an Apple aficionado, who cannot stand even a slight innuendo about Apple products. He dons the cap of editor-in-chief to make sure that articles match the quality standard before they are published."  About Dhvanesh Ever since teenage years, gadgets and technology have held a special place in Dhvanesh's heart. This fascination with gadgets and their inner workings fueled a lifelong passion for exploration and troubleshooting. Disassembled electronic items scattered around the house became a familiar sight during his younger years, a testament to this insatiable curiosity. From SEO Expert to Apple Evangelist After completing his IT engineering diploma, Dhvanesh's professional journey began with a 4.5-year stint as an SEO executive, honing valuable digital marketing skills. However, the desire to share tech knowledge and connect with a like-minded community proved stronger. In 2012, Dhvanesh embarked on a new adventure, founding iGeeksBlog. This blog became a haven for Apple enthusiasts and tech aficionados seeking insightful and in-depth information about everything Apple. A Decade of iGeeksBlog: Leading the Apple Charge In the past 12 years, Dhvanesh has donned multiple hats at iGeeksBlog. As the founder, he has steered the blog’s vision, ensuring it remains a trusted resource for Apple users worldwide. Additionally, he has been serving as the CEO of iGeeks Media Private Limited for the past 4 years, overseeing the company's growth and development. Beyond Writing: A Multifaceted Approach Dhvanesh isn't just a prolific writer, having penned hundreds of articles for iGeeksBlog. He has also served as the blog’s Editor-in-Chief and Content Strategist, ensuring a consistent flow of high-quality content that caters to the diverse needs of the Apple user base. The passion for exploration extends beyond the written word. He has created numerous YouTube videos for iGeeksBlog, providing visual demonstrations and engaging directly with the audience. Staying Connected with the Apple Ecosystem Dhvanesh's dedication to the Apple community goes a step further. Currently, he also manages the iGeeksBlog+ weekly newsletter, delivering curated Apple news, gadgets, apps, tips and tricks straight to subscribers' inboxes. This unwavering commitment to Apple technology and a genuine desire to empower fellow users make him a valuable asset to the iGeeksBlog team.

blockGraphs.question: How often should I clear the Facebook cache on my iPhone or iPad?
blockGraphs.answer: If you actively use Facebook daily, the cache files can quickly pile up. So, you must delete them once every 1-2 weeks. For moderate users, clearing the cache once every month is sufficient.

blockGraphs.question: Does clearing the cache delete any of my Facebook data?
blockGraphs.answer: Not at all. Deleting the Facebook app cache does not affect your information. You will still stay logged into Facebook, and your friends list, shared photos, chats, and other activities will remain as they were.

title.rendered: Best iPhone 15 belt clip cases

content.rendered:
If you travel a lot, you may miss out on your precious iPhone. Whenever I’m outside, I use holster cases for my iPhone 15 that clip onto my belt. These unique cases keep your iPhone safe and easy to reach. Here, I have share the best iPhone 15 belt clip cases. Whether you’re a professional on the go, an outdoor adventurer, or simply someone who appreciates convenience, we’ve got you covered. 

1. SUPCASE Unicorn Beetle Pro case – Editor’s Choice

If you want the utmost rugged protection for your iPhone 15, SUPCASE belt clip cases are ideal. It has passed the 20ft drop test, achieving the title of CNET’s “Best Case Scenario.” This Unicorn Beetle Pro case wraps around your iPhone snugly with its three-layer construction. The built-in screen protector keeps your display dust, grim, and scratch-proof without sacrificing touch sensitivity. 

Besides, the back cover has dual-layer hybrid polycarbonate to withstand sudden bumps and shocks. And don’t worry about the side cracks, as the added TPU bumpers can resist impacts well. Moreover, the case has a rotatable belt clip with a swivel and an in-built kickstand. Therefore, you can carry it easily and watch movies in both portrait and landscape orientation hands-free.

Pros

  • Raised edges
  • Built-in kickstand doubles as ring holder
  • Port plugs keep dust and debris out
  • Super sturdy

Cons

  • Difficult to take out from belt clip
  • No wireless charging support

Check out on Amazon

2. Encased MAG Belt case – Crystal clear

I like sleek, bulk-free clear cases for my iPhone 15. So, the Encased MAG belt clip case is my second choice. It has a slim profile, though made with a dual hybrid structure with a scratch-resistant PC back and an outer TPU protection bumper. Also, you will get shock-absorbing air pockets strategically positioned to provide the proper cushioning.

Thus, your new phone is safe from drops and unwanted scratches. The best part is using your MagSafe charger and accessories with the case on. Moreover, the brand has reinforced the rotatable belt clip to absorb impromptu shocks. Also, the holster’s secure top-latch design allows for quick access in vertical or horizontal postures.

Pros

  • AirGuard technology
  • Protects camera lens
  • MagSafe compatible
  • Limited lifetime warranty

Cons

  • The side buttons are hard to push

Check out on Amazon

3. Ghostek Nautical MagSafe case – Waterproof

No more worries about rain splashes or sudden drops in water, as the Ghostek belt-clip case will protect your iPhone 15. You can also record your underwater activities up to 20ft submerging. The multi-layered case seals your iPhone from every angle with a built-in screen protector, camera lens covers, and watertight port plug, avoiding water, sand, dust, and filth.  

Additionally, it has added reinforced bumpers and shock-absorbing corners to resist 12ft drop impacts. However, Ghostek has ensured you never slip out of your iPhone with the rubberized grip patterns. Not only the rugged protection, but the case can also withstand daily wear and tear thanks to its anti-scratch back panel and lifted camera and screen edge.  

You can enjoy peak responsiveness with the tactile buttons. Besides, the included belt-clip holster can also double as a kickstand to let you put your iPhone in a landscape position and watch your favorite movies. Moreover, the built-in magnets facilitate a strong magnetic alignment and compatibility with MagSafe chargers and accessories. 

Pros

  • Fully body-sealed protection
  • Added bumpers and air pocket corners
  • 1mm raised edges
  • Rubber flex design

Cons

  • Feels bulky

Check out on Ghostek

4. PiTau Holster for iPhone 15 – Quick access

The PiTau vertical holster belt-clip case is perfect for busy professionals to carry around their iPhone 15. Its compact size and tough nylon make the cover travel-friendly and impact-resistant. However, you can put your iPhone in without removing its additional case. With its sturdy belt loop, you can safely fasten it to your belt.  

Besides, the tough nylon defends daily wear and tear, though it’s prone to scratches. A Velcro clasp keeps Your phone secure, preventing unintentional drops. Also, you can attach the case to your belt horizontally or vertically for easy access to your phone. Plus, each side of the cover has two built-in pen holders. 

Pros

  • Durable nylon
  • Soft touch
  • Eco-friendly

Cons

@graph.name: SUPCASE Unicorn Beetle Pro case
@graph.description: If you want the utmost rugged protection for your iPhone 15, SUPCASE belt clip cases are ideal. It has passed the 20ft drop test, achieving the title of CNET’s “Best Case Scenario.” This Unicorn Beetle Pro case wraps around your iPhone snugly with its three-layer construction. The built-in screen protector keeps your display dust, grim, and scratch-proof without sacrificing touch sensitivity. Besides, the back cover has dual-layer hybrid polycarbonate to withstand sudden bumps and shocks. And don’t worry about the side cracks, as the added TPU bumpers can resist impacts well. Moreover, the case has a rotatable belt clip with a swivel and an in-built kickstand. Therefore, you can carry it easily and watch movies in both portrait and landscape orientation hands-free.

image.caption: Supcase rugged case for iphone 15

@graph.name: Encased MAG Belt cas
@graph.description: MYBAT PRO belt clip cases are your iPhone’s rough and tough buddy, offering full-body protection. The case has four layers of heavy-duty construction. The outer shell is made of rubber to resist drop impacts and a hard polycarbonate back panel for sturdiness. After that, a microfiber lining on the interior protects the glass back of the iPhone from dents. Besides, the front shell adds a 2.3mm raised edge around the screen to avoid contact with the surface. Altogether, the case has passed DROP + 4X MIL-STD-810G 516.6 test. You will never slip the phone from your hand, thanks to the textured bumper grips. The built-in tempered glass screen protector ensures your iPhone display doesn’t accumulate fingerprints, smudges, and scratches. The brand has incorporated 38 enhanced N52 magnets, ensuring compatibility with MagSafe accessories and fast charging. You can attach the holster clip to the case and secure it to your belt or bag for quick, convenient access. Additionally, this iPhone 15 belt clip case serves as a handy kickstand, enabling hands-free video viewing in any position.

image.caption: Mybat pro maverick series iphone 15 case with belt clip

@graph.description: No more worries about rain splashes or sudden drops in water, as the Ghostek belt-clip case will protect your iPhone 15. The multi-layered case seals your iPhone from every angle with a built-in screen protector, camera lens covers, and watertight port plug, avoiding water, sand, dust, and filth. Additionally, it has added reinforced bumpers and shock-absorbing corners to resist 12ft drop impacts. However, Ghostek has ensured you never slip out of your iPhone with the rubberized grip patterns. Not only the rugged protection, but the case can also withstand daily wear and tear thanks to its anti-scratch back panel and lifted camera and screen edge. You can enjoy peak responsiveness with the tactile buttons. Besides, the included belt-clip holster can also double as a kickstand to let you put your iPhone in a landscape position and watch your favorite movies. Moreover, the built-in magnets facilitate a strong magnetic alignment and compatibility with MagSafe chargers and accessories.

image.caption: Ghostek nautical iphone 15 waterproof holster magsafe cases

reviews.content: Fingic has built this sleek and stylish belt-clip case specifically for the iPhone 15. The outer shell is durable due to its double interlocking plastic parts and protects your phone from shocks, damage, dust, and scratches. Besides, a soft felt interior further guards the screen from scratches or abrasions while the phone is enclosed in the holster. The case has a rubberized texture, giving you further protection and a better grip. Moreover, the built-in kickstand lets you keep your phone in a horizontal or vertical orientation, and the 180-degree rotating swivel clip offers simple adjustment and a reliable locking mechanism to keep your phone secure at all times. Without the holster, you can juice your iPhone wirelessly.

title.rendered: How to create an event on Facebook on iPhone or iPad

content.rendered:
Key takeawayse
  • Creating events on Facebook helps you easily organize gatherings, share event details, and invite guests all in one place.
  • You can easily create public or private events directly from the menu in the Facebook app.
  • Events can be customized with a name, date, time, location, and privacy settings to suit the organizer’s needs.

When you’re organizing an event, Facebook can make it easier to invite others and communicate all the details. Whether it’s a private affair such as a birthday party or open to the public, you can create a custom event page with information such as date, time, location, etc. Further, you can also keep track of who’s attending and edit details if needed. So, let’s learn more about how to create an event on Facebook on your iPhone.

How to create an event in Facebook on iPhone or iPad

  1. Launch the Facebook app and tap on the Hamburger icon with your profile picture at the bottom right corner.
  2. Scroll down and select Events. If you don’t see the option, tap See more to reveal it.
  3. Now, tap the plus icon at the top to create a new event.

  4. Then, enter a suitable Event name and tap done on the keyboard.
  5. Next, add the Start Date and time. When setting the date and time, you can also add the End time of the event. Tap OK to save it.

  6. Now, tap the “Is it in person or virtual” box to set the location.
    • If it’s in person, search and select a location.
    • For online events, move to the Virtual tab and select how the event will be hosted.
    • Facebook Live: A Facebook Live will be scheduled for your event so that people can watch.
    • External link: Adding a link will help people to know where to go when your event starts.
    • Other: It allows you to add instructions on how to participate to your event details. Here, I chose Facebook Live. Tap Done to save it.

  7. Set the event privacy by tapping the “Who can see it?” box.
    • Private: It would only allow the participants who have been invited prior to the event. You can also let the guests invite their friends to the event.
    • Public: Can be viewed by anyone on or off the Facebook app.
    • Friends: Will be visible to all of your Facebook friends.
    • Group: You can send the event invite to the groups you are in on Facebook.
  8. Select an option and tap Done to confirm your choice.

  9. Next, add a description or guidelines for the event.
  10. If you are hosting the event in collaboration, tap Add co-hosts, choose friends, select Add X co-hosts.
  11. For more fun, you can create a group with the participants. Tap Chat with guests, toggle on Add a WhatsApp group chat and select Next.

  12. If you want to add a custom banner for your event, tap Upload at the top, select a photo, hit Done, frame the banner properly, and tap Save. Else, you can choose banners from Facebook Gallery or Pick a GIF.
  13. Review the details of the event and tap the Create event button at the bottom.
  14. Now, you will be prompted to send invites. Select your friends and tap Invite.

To spread the word about your event and create engagement, you can create posts on the event details page. For private events, only the invited friends can see the posts.

If you have enabled group chat when creating the event, you need to set it up as well.

  1. From the Facebook Event details page, tap Add a WhatsApp group invite → Continue → Open.
  2. It will redirect you to WhatsApp.
  3. Tap New group, select the members, tap Next.
  4. Enter a suitable group name and hit Create.

Invite friends to your event on Facebook

Once the event is created, you can copy its links and share them with your friends and family. Tap the Manage button under the event name and select Copy invitation link. Note that this invitation link will expire once 100 people respond to it and confirm their email or phone number.

If you want to invite a person who doesn’t have a Facebook account, follow the steps below:

  1. Tap the Invite button on the event details page. If you don’t see it, tap Manage and select Invite.
  2. Select Text or email from the menu.
  3. Enter their phone number or email address and tap Invite.

Facebook also lets you invite your Instagram followers. From the Invite people page, search for the Instagram ID, tap the Invite button next to them, and hit Done.

Edit an existing event in Facebook on your iPhone

  1. Open the Facebook app and go to the Events section.
  2. Here, you will see your events. Tap on the event you wish to edit.
  3. Now, tap on Manage and select Edit.

  4. You can change the event name, time, location, banner, add co-hosts, and more info about the event.

      You will change the event name, time, location, add co-hosts, and add more info about the event. In addition, you will be able to view the changes you’ve done in the event details.

      How to add Facebook events to your iOS’s Calendar app

      One thing I always do after creating an event on Facebook is add it to my calendar so I can keep up with my schedule. Here’s how:

      1. Tap Manage on the event details page.
      2. Select Add to calendar and grant permission to Facebook to access your Calendar app.
      3. Now, edit the details as per your requirements and tap Add to save it.

      How to cancel or delete an event on Facebook

      1. Go to the Facebook event you’ve created.
      2. Tap the Manage button and select Edit.
      3. Tap on the Trash icon at the bottom right corner. Now, select an option:
        • Cancel and keep event details: It will only cancel the event schedule. But people will continue to see the event details page and create posts on it.
        • Cancel and delete event details: This option cancels the event and removes the event details page along with all the posts.
      4. Select the Cancel Event button to confirm your choice.

      All the guests will get a notification that you have canceled the event. You may also add a post about the cancellation.

      Note Once you’ve deleted an event, you won’t be able to restore the event.

      That’s It!

      I hope all your queries in this article were resolved. If you still have some questions! Write to us in the comment section below! Till then, keep reading and stay updated.

title.rendered: Best power banks for MacBook Air or Pro in 2026

content.rendered:
M1 and M2-powered MacBooks provide the best battery life out of all the laptops available in the market right now. I am yet to come across laptops with a similar form factor and longer battery life than M1/M2 MacBooks. Nonetheless, like any other gadget powered by batteries, MacBooks do tend to run out of charge.

If you travel frequently and are looking for a power bank to recharge your MacBook Pro or Air and other devices alongside it, here is our list of the best power banks for your MacBook that you can buy right now. 

Table of Contents
  1. Anker PowerCore+ charger – Editor's choice
  2. Omni 20c+ with wireless charging – Multipurpose charger
  3. AOHI 30,000mAh power bank – 100W PD charging
  4. mophie power station XXL – Minimal design
  5. HALO Bolt Wireless – Can jump start your car

1. Anker PowerCore+ charger – Editor’s choice

Anker is one of America’s leading USB charging brands. They make great quality products at affordable prices. The PowerCore+ is a 26,800mAh power bank. The dimensions are 7.68 x 3.54 x 2.36 inches, and the weight is 1.6 pounds. 

The Anker PowerCore+ supports 45W PD (power delivery) charging and can fully charge 13-inch MacBooks within 2 hours. It features 2 USB-A ports that can give an output of 15W and a USB-C port that offers 45W PD charging support. Also, it comes with built-in trickle charging support to charge low-power devices like TWS, Bluetooth speakers, etc. 

The power bank supports 60W power input while charging and can go from 0-100 within 3 hours and 30 minutes. The icing on the cake is the 60W USB-C power adaptor is included in the box alongside a USB-C to USB-C power cable and a travel pouch. You also get 18 months of free warranty. 

Pros

  • Sleek and Minimal design
  • 45W PD Charging 
  • Bundled 60W charging brick and USB-C to USB-C charging cable

Cons

  • On the heavier side, at 1.6 pounds

Check out on Amazon

2. Omni 20c+ with wireless charging – Multipurpose charger

The Omni 20c+ is a 20,000mAh power bank. Despite its huge capacity, it is compact with dimensions of 5 x 4.8 x 1.1 inches. It weighs just a little over a pound. It boasts a unique design with an OLED screen to provide smart power readings and looks like a product from some sci-fi movie. 

Also, it isn’t all style and no substance; in fact, it is one of those products that have more substance than style. It features a pair of USB-C ports that can give an output of 60W power when being used simultaneously. The left USB-C port can output 100W speed when being used alone. There are a pair of USB-A ports that support QC 3.0.

Moreover, the top panel doubles as a 10W wireless charger. And it supports passthrough charging while being recharged too, and takes up to 3 hours to completely charge using a 45W adaptor. That’s not all; the Omni 20c+ also functions as a USB Hub for file transfers. And the company has a patented power protection system in place to ensure both the power bank and your device remain safe during charging. 

Pros

  • Eye-catchy design
  • Wide-range of ports
  • Excellent speeds
  • Passthrough charging

Cons

  • Some users complained of longevity issues

Check out on Amazon

3. AOHI 30,000mAh power bank – 100W PD charging

AOHI products never fail to impress. I’ve reviewed a couple of AOHI chargers and can assure you the features they provide are on par with other offerings in the market. The 30,000mAh power bank by AOHI is yet another remarkable product, as it offers 100W PD charging through USB-C and only weighs 1.17 pounds. Its dimensions are 6.02 x 3.46 x 0.98 inches, which means the product is not very bulky. 

Moreover, AOHI always has a very peculiar design (in a good way), and I love the yellow accent within the ports. It features just 2 ports: a USB Type-C and a USB Type-A. It might not be enough for all, but it is certainly enough to charge your MacBook through the USB-C port at 65W and your iPhone through the USB-A port at 20W. All of this was made possible due to extensive support for PD protocols, all the way from PD 20W to PD 65W. 

It can out 83W of total power while being connected to two devices. How long does the power bank take to charge, you ask? Well, the 30,000mAh power bank can go from 0-100 in around 2 hours. However, you will need to charge it through a 100W USB Type-C PD charger. 

Pros

  • Lightweight
  • 65W PD charging support alongside other PD Protocols
  • 100W power input 
  • USB-C to USB-C charging cable included in the box

Cons

  • No wireless charging 

Check out on Amazon

4. mophie power station XXL – Minimal design 

The mophie Powerstation XXL is a 20,000mAh power bank. This is the perfect choice for you if you consider yourself a minimalist. It comes in a fabric finish that prevents scuffs and scratches. Also, remember that it just feels like fabric but is nothing other than textured TPU. 

However, at just 0.96 pounds, it is one of the lightest power banks I have come across. Moreover, the dimensions are 3.05 x 6.26 x 0.98 inches, which is amazing for a 20,000 mah power bank. I feel if you’re someone who values great design and can sacrifice some utility, this is what you should opt for.

Because the power bank features 3 ports, it isn’t bad by any means. However, it provides the highest power output through the USB Type-C port at 18W. This means that while it can charge your iPhone from 0-50% within 30 minutes, it will charge your MacBook slower than most of the other products on this list. The other two ports are a pair of USB Type-A ports.

Pros

  • Classy Fabric Finish
  • Lightest among all other power banks on the list 
  • Multiple USB Ports 

Cons

  • Slower charging speeds

Check out on Amazon

5. HALO Bolt Wireless – Can jump start your car

Very few would believe that a power bank could house enough power to jump-start a car. The HALO Bolt can jump-start a standard car 50 times, an SUV 35 times, or a riding lawn mower 94 times. All of this is made possible through its massive 44,400mAh capacity. It weighs 1.7 pounds and has a dimension of 7 x 3.7 x 1.5 inches. 

Yes, it can easily recharge your MacBook multiple times. But there is a tiny hiccup. You will need to use a Type-A to Type-C or MagSafe cable, as the HALO Bolt only features 2 USB-A ports. That might be a deal breaker for many. Apart from these ports, the power bank also features AC output, a port to insert the car jump starter cables. 

Also, it is a TSA (Transport Security Administration) compliant charger, so you need not worry about facing any issues when traveling with it. Lastly, it also supports wireless charging and can simultaneously charge 4 devices. 

Pros

  • Wireless charging 
  • Massive capacity 
  • Can Jump Start your Car
  • TSA compliant

Cons

  • Lacks USB-C ports 

Check out on Amazon

Never run out of power

Pick any of these power banks based on your needs, and never worry about your MacBook running out of power whenever you are out and about. There are very few power banks with higher battery capacities available these days, simply because the battery life of iPhones and MacBooks is getting better and better with every single generation. 

However, there are times when there is an unexpected power cut or if you have to travel when these power banks come in handy. If you have any other recommendations, leave them in the comments below, and we’ll ensure to add them to our list. 

Editorial Note: When you purchase through our links, we earn a small commission. However, this does not affect our opinions or evaluations. Learn more about our Editorial Process and Disclaimer.

title.rendered: Rugged iPad mini 6 Cases That Stand Up to Drops.

content.rendered:
While you might find a couple of durable cases out there, not all iPad mini 6 cases are fit for hard times. If you tend to carry your tablet on rough trips like me or have bumpy routines, you need a rugged case to protect your iPad mini 6 on all corners.

Confused which one’s right? Here’s a list of the best rugged iPad mini 6 cases. Read on to find the one for you.

Table of Contents
  • 1. SUPCASE Unicorn Beetle Pro Series -Editor's choice
  • 2. Spigen Rugged Armor case – Most lightweight and slimmest
  • 3. Herize iPad mini 6 case – Most sophisticated
  • 4. Zugu case for iPad mini 6 – Comes with a 2-year warranty
  • 5. ZtotopCases iPad mini 6 case – Most padded
  • 6. Grifobes case – Best iPad mini 6 case for kids
  • 7. DTTO Shockproof Case – Lifetime warranty
  • 8. ZenRich iPad mini 6 case – Most aesthetic
  • 9. Soke iPad mini 6 case – Translucent frosted back case

1. SUPCASE Unicorn Beetle Pro Series -Editor’s choice

The SUPCASE Unicorn Beetle series is a full-body armor for your iPad mini 6. It features a multilayered thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU), a built-in screen protector, a pen groove, and an adjustable kickstand on the back cover.

This Unicorn Beetle Pro Series case also has military-grade shockproof corners, back, and raised edges. This prevents direct impact on your tablet from falls or smacks. The multilayered TPU cover not only confers strength but makes it sturdy, flexible, and resistant to greasy stains and abrasions.

Of course, the screen protector, being strong itself, is sensitive to touch. There are covers on the ports to prevent dust or dirt from penetrating. This one has passed many drop tests. So you can trust it.

Pros

  • Sturdy, multilayered with raised edges
  • 1-year warranty
  • Stain-resistant
  • Adjustable kickstand offers many viewing angles
  • Passed several drop tests

Cons

  • Available only in black color

Check out on: Amazon | Supcase

2. Spigen Rugged Armor case – Most lightweight and slimmest

If you want something simple but sturdy, the Spigen Rugged Amor case is the right choice. It comes with a screen protector and an Apple Pencil holder. And the entire cover wields a thermoplastic polyurethane material with Air Cushion technology.

There are carbon fiber linings on either side and at the top-most part of the back case for extra protection. The built-in screen protector is sensitive and adequately raised on the corners to prevent damage from impacts.

The air cushion technology also absorbs shocks before it gets to your iPad. This not only makes it strong but also lightweight. Unfortunately, you might not stand your tablet conveniently with this as it doesn’t have a back stand.

Pros

  • Slim, sturdy, and lightweight
  • Built-in screen protector
  • Raised corners and carbon fiber
  • Supports magnetic charging of Apple Pencil
  • Proprietary Air Cushion technology

Cons

  • No back stand

Check out on: Amazon

3. Herize iPad mini 6 case – Most sophisticated

The Herize iPad mini 6 case has a sophisticated look and features many protective parts. In addition to a sensitive screen protector, the skin features a strong silicon material covering a hard polycarbonate plastic inner shell. And it features a segment at the tip for holding your Apple Pencil conveniently.

The case also has an adjustable hand and shoulder strap and stand, all on the back case. The hand strap might come in handy for fixing your tablet to your palm if you fall asleep. Moreover, the hand strap and back stand sit on a rotating nob, allowing you to turn your iPad at an angle of 360 degrees while holding or standing it.

There are also hard coverings on every corner to absorb impacts during falls. However, the edges on this one are raised farther from your iPad to protect it when it falls or hits a surface.

Pros

  • Multilayered covering with raised edges and hard corners
  • Many viewing angles with hand strap and back stand
  • Supports wireless charging of the Apple Pencil
  • Available in different colors

Cons

  • Rotating nob might be stiff sometimes
  • Heavier than others on the list

Check out on Amazon

4. Zugu case for iPad mini 6 – Comes with a 2-year warranty

If you prefer a case with a face cover instead, the Zugu case is what you want. It features thermoplastic polyurethane material and a front cover. Thus, it’s sturdy and offers adequate protection to your iPad.

There are raised edges around this to further protect critical parts of your iPad in case of hard impacts. The case also comes with a back stand. This is adjustable to seven different delineated angles on the magnetic component of the front cover. With magnetic sensors, the front cover also controls the locking and opening of your iPad.

It has a pencil holder attached to the back of the case like a pocket. And it supports wireless pen charging.

Pros

  • 7 Magnetic angles
  • Front cover protects the screen
  • Raised edges for extra protection
  • Up to 5 ft. drop protection
  • 2-year warranty
  • 30-day return policy

Cons

  • Doesn’t offer much protection on the corners
  • Most expensive on the list

Check out on: Amazon | Zugu

5. ZtotopCases iPad mini 6 case – Most padded

Here’s another solid protection for your iPad mini 6. The entire body of the ZtotopCase is a thermoplastic polyurethane woven together with polyurethane into one rugged piece.

Besides raised edges, it also has an auto wake and sleep front cover to protect your tablet screen effectively. There’s an adjustable stand on the back cover with efficient inner magnets. So you can attach it vertically to magnetic surfaces like a refrigerator.

The Pencil holder is at the tip of the closure, and it supports magnetic charging as well. It also features shockproof thermoplastic spines for extra protection on the corners.

Pros

  • Sturdy, compact, and simple
  • Sleep/wake functionality
  • Magnetic kickstand doubles as refrigerator mount
  • Built-in 2nd gen Apple Pencil holder

Cons

  • Might restrict access to volume and power buttons

Check out on Amazon

6. Grifobes case – Best iPad mini 6 case for kids

The Grifobes iPad mini 6 case is attractive, rugged, and comes in different colors to fit your likes. The beautiful carvings and the round groove that exposes the Apple logo on the rear side of your iPad give it an elegant look.

However, the Grifobes case gets its strength, sturdiness, and smoothness from a silicon material. This also gives it additional padding all around to protect your iPad from impacts due to falls. Unfortunately, it neither has a front cover nor a screen protector. But you can buy a screen protector to beef up your iPad’s guard.

Nonetheless, there are 0.21-inch and 0.17-inch raised edges around the screen and camera, respectively, to prevent direct impact on these delicate areas. It also has a Pen groove at one end of the tip to keep your Apple Pencil in place and accessible. And the ports also have a clean and precise cut.

Pros

  • Well-raised edges protect delicate parts
  • Strong silicon material
  • Beautiful superhero design
  • Accessible ports and side buttons
  • Precise cutouts

Cons

  • No screen protector or cover

Check out on Amazon

7. DTTO Shockproof Case – Lifetime warranty

The DTTO shockproof case is slim and perfect for minimalists. However, it features a strong polycarbonate backplate and a tough built-in screen guard. There’s also an adjustable stand at the back for convenient viewing.

In addition to raised edges, the screen cover is touch-sensitive. So you can use your iPad while protecting it simultaneously. The polycarbonate back cover is also rigid and impact-resistant, preventing any potential damages from falls or hits.

However, like many iPad mini 6 cases, this one also features an Apple Pencil holder at the tip. The adjustment on the back stand is limited, as it only supports two viewing angles.

Pros

  • Multiplayer defense protection
  • Built-in 2nd gen Apple Pencil holder and charger
  • Post plug protection
  • Drop and fall protection
  • Lifetime free replacement warranty

Cons

  • Limited back stand adjustment

Check out on Amazon

8. ZenRich iPad mini 6 case – Most aesthetic

The Zenrich iPad mini 6 case is multilayered, elegant, and comes in different colors. It has a rotating back stand, a hand strap, and a longer shoulder strap. There’s also a Pencil holder at the tip of one side.

The outermost part of the case is silicone rubber, covering two other inner reinforcements. All these ensure that your iPad remains in good shape even if it falls or hits a hard surface. The back of the case is also heavily carved, adding the desired ruggedness to your iPad mini 6.

Additionally, this one doesn’t come with a screen cover or guard but has well-raised edges around the screen and camera regions.

The palm strap also allows you to fix this to your palm without falling off. The shoulder strap is adjustable, so you can keep it as close to yourself as you like. There’s also a nob at the back for rotating the stand and strap clockwise or anticlockwise to enjoy various viewing angles.

Pros

  • Multilayered covering and carved back
  • Available in multiple colors
  • Supports wireless Apple Pencil charging
  • 360-degree rotating stand
  • Built-in hand and shoulder strap

Cons

  • No screen cover or guard

Check out on Amazon

9. Soke iPad mini 6 case – Translucent frosted back case

The Soke iPad mini 6 case has a visually-compelling effect with functionalities more than meets the eye. While the frame features thermoplastic polyurethane, the back cover is a hybrid hard frosted polycarbonate material.

The polycarbonate material itself is rugged and shock-absorbing. So when coupled with thermoplastic polyurethane, you can be sure your iPad gets all the protection it needs. There’s also a groove for holding the Apple Pencil. And this supports wireless Pen charging.

The stand is also three-fold. So you can adjust it flatly into three different viewing angles. It has precise cutouts, fostering accessibility to ports and speakers on your tablet.

Pros

  • Sturdy frame
  • Supports magnetic 2nd gen Apple Pencil charging
  • Raised edges and hard corners
  • Lightweight and easy to install
  • Anti-fingerprint
  • Shock- and dirt-resistant

Cons

  • No built-in screen protector

Check out on Amazon

Signing off!

Getting a rugged case for your iPad mini 6 is essential! These recommended cases are unique as they offer detailed protection that many ignore. So, which one of these cases did you find helpful to run the daily cruise with you? Tell me in the comment section.

Editorial Note: When you purchase through our links, we earn a small commission. However, this does not affect our opinions or evaluations. Learn more about our Editorial Process and Disclaimer.

title.rendered: Best iPhone 12 pro max camera protector

content.rendered:
The iPhone 12 Pro Max boasts one of the leading smartphone cameras in the market. So you’ll want to protect those precious lenses from dust, scratches, and other damage. Keeping this in mind, you’ll want to add a camera lens guard to your defensive arsenal that includes cases and screen guards. So go ahead and opt for one of these best iPhone 12 Pro Max camera protectors.

Table of Contents
  • 1. UniqueMe Camera Lens Protector 3-Pack
  • 2. EGV Tempered Glass Camera Protector
  • 3. BAZO Screen Protector + Camera Lens Protector
  • 4. LK Camera Lens Protector 6-Pack
  • 5. Rhidon Tempered Glass Lens Protector
  • 6. Ferilinso Lens Protector + Tempered-Glass
  • 7. VEGO Protector for Camera Lens

1. UniqueMe Camera Lens Protector 3-Pack

This 9H tempered glass protector is embedded with night anti-glare coating to protect your camera and produce the original picture quality.

It’s got 99.99% transparency that preserves the original screen or picture brightness. The camera lens protector with an oleophobic layer prevents water, oil, and dust, keeping your camera lens crystal-clear for the best quality photos and videos.

Check out on Amazon

2. EGV Tempered Glass Camera Protector

Check out this premium tempered glass lens guard that offers protection against scratches, reduces dust, and is highly impact and explosion-proof. The 99.99% transparency preserves the original quality and brightness of your captures.

It covers the whole camera lens area perfectly without covering up any lenses. Moreover, it’s easy to apply by just aligning the hole to set the lens protector against the lens hole. It’s also available for the iPhone 12 Pro.

Check out on Amazon

3. BAZO Screen Protector + Camera Lens Protector

Here’s another iPhone 12 Pro Max camera lens protector that comes with a screen protector to ensure the safety of your device. It is strong and scratch-resistant to prevent any damage to the lens.

The included screen protector is 100% sensitive to touch, providing a high-definition display. At the same time, it will protect your phone from scratches on the screen and reducing the impact of drops.

Check out on Amazon

4. LK Camera Lens Protector 6-Pack

This transparent camera protector with black edges can block the light refracted by the flash and reduce the exposure to ensure original quality for pictures and videos.

Further, it includes a tempered glass screen protector, and both are made of superior 9H tempered glass that is scratch resistant and shatterproof. So, your screen and camera stay protected from scratches and high impact drops.

Check out on Amazon

5. Rhidon Tempered Glass Lens Protector

This camera lens protector has a “Night Flash Circle” so that it never interferes with the flash when you’re trying to take photos in low light. It maintains excellent picture quality, too, with 99.99% light transmittance.

It’s easy to install within seconds, and the nano-electrostatic automatic adsorption technology ensures strong adsorption force. It will not fall off and prevent any formation of bubbles.

Check out on Amazon

6. Ferilinso Lens Protector + Tempered-Glass

Here’s another set of camera lens protectors for the iPhone 12 Pro Max that do not affect your camera’s flash. It ensures light transmittance of 99.99%, keeping picture quality at its original level.

The nano-electrostatic automatic adsorption technology makes it a breeze to apply without any bubbles. Plus, it attaches securely and will not fall off.

Check out on Amazon

7. VEGO Protector for Camera Lens

This lens cover is easy to install with no risk of air bubbles and effectively protects against oil and sweat from fingerprints, keeping your phone camera pristine over time.

It’s been specially designed to avoid overexposure and maintain more than 99% high transparency to ensure clear and high-resolution photos and videos.

Check out on Amazon

So, have you found the perfect camera lens protector for your iPhone 12 Pro Max? Share your choice in the comments below.

Editorial Note: When you purchase through our links, we earn a small commission. However, this does not affect our opinions or evaluations. Learn more about our Editorial Process and Disclaimer.

title.rendered: Best iPhone 14 Series Camera Lens Protection Accessories

content.rendered:
The new iPhone 14 and iPhone 14 Plus have great cameras. It’s best to use camera lens protectors if you’ve bought one for yourself. It’s going to be challenging to choose one because of the range available in the market. I’ve picked some of the best iPhone 14 and 14 Plus camera lens protectors to ease things for you.

Table of Contents
  1. Spigen Optik Pro – Editor's Choice
  2. ESR tempered glass protector – Best individual protection
  3. Jeluse lens protector – Metal and glass combo
  4. Ringke camera styling – Multicolor options
  5. Tensea camera lens protector – Shiny lenses
  6. Goton camera frame – Eye-catching design
  7. Amovo camera lens covers – Minimalistic

1. Spigen Optik Pro – Editor’s Choice

If you’re looking for the best protection and an easily applicable lens protector, you should undoubtedly go for the Spigen Optik Pro. It comes with 9H-rated tempered glass for better durability. Additionally, an oleophobic coating resists fingerprints on the lens, so you don’t have to worry about fingerprint smudges.

The packaging comes with an EZ Fit tray that lets you align them perfectly with the camera lenses on your iPhone. Furthermore, as expected, you’ll see two lens covers and a cleaning kit.

Pros

  • Better fit
  • Installation guide included

Cons

  • Expensive

Check out on Spigen

2. ESR tempered glass protector – Best individual protection

If you want something stealthy and don’t want your camera to protrude with a protector, ESR’s solution is the right one for you. The ESR tempered glass lens protector has individual glass protectors for each lens, and since this tempered glass is scratch-resistant, it’ll keep your lenses safe.

You can apply them on top of each camera lens, and the strong adhesive will keep them in place. Additionally, you don’t have to worry about bubbles when applying them. These lens doesn’t obstruct your camera’s angles or views, so you get great photos while keeping it safe. These glasses don’t block and scatter your camera’s flashlight, either.

Pros

  • Great build quality
  • Bubble-free application
  • Protection for individual lenses

Cons

  • Will need replacement after a while

Check out on ESR

3. Jeluse lens protector – Metal and glass combo

This one is for you if you want individual camera lens protection yet want metal protection. It comes with 9H tempered glass housed inside an aluminum metal ring. While it protects your camera lenses from drops and shocks, it also repels water, oil, and dust protection, providing clean photos for you.

On top of it, anti-reflection technology doesn’t reflect flashlights during the nighttime. Also, it has patterns on the surface that sparkle in any lighting. It arrives with an easy installation kit and demolition sticks, letting you remove it whenever you want to switch things up.

Pros

  • Aluminum ring
  • Drop and Shock resistance
  • Multiple colors available

Cons

  • Might look too flashy

Check out on Amazon

4. Ringke camera styling – Multicolor options

If you are looking for something different other than glass, the Ringke camera styling protector is perfect for you. Instead of tempered glass, it uses aluminum to protect the camera frame. However, it doesn’t cover the lenses giving you an unhindered photography experience.

Its surface is anti-reflective, hence doesn’t affect your photos when you take images at night. It is entirely shock-absorbant yet lightweight. The packaging is kept minimal to keep it eco-friendly. Furthermore, the installation is straightforward, and you wouldn’t need much assistance.

Pros

  • Aluminum build
  • Shock-absorbant
  • Lightweight

Cons

  • Doesn’t cover lenses completely

Check out on Amazon

5. Tensea camera lens protector – Shiny lenses

If you prefer to go bling-bling over stealth, Tensea’s individual lens protectors are the right ones for you. It has a 9H tempered glass protector housed in an aluminum ring casing. The aluminum ring has a 3D texture that shines in different lighting conditions.

This lens is available in multiple colors, and since it’s easier to apply and remove, you can switch between different colors anytime. Moreover, you don’t get any haze when you take photos at night with a flashlight. It fits perfectly with iPhone 14 and 14 Plus lens cutouts. Moreover, it is shock-absorbant while maintaining a slim profile.

Pros

  • Aluminum ring
  • Drop and Shock resistance
  • Shiny in different lighting

Cons

  • Color might fade over time
  • Too thin

Check out on Amazon

6. Goton camera frame – Eye-catching design

If just bling-bling for individual camera lenses isn’t enough for you, Goton’s solution makes your camera shiny. It combines metal and glass materials to provide excellent protection to your iPhone’s cameras. Also, it’s entirely covered with sparkly rhinestones laid under the glass, making it shine under light.

It comes with 9H-rated drop and scratch protection and doesn’t affect your photos when you use a flashlight. Applying it is convenient, and you’d not see bubbles after that. It’s available in multiple colors if you want to switch styles.

Pros

  • Metal and glass protection
  • Great after-sales support
  • Multiple color options

Cons

  • Might look a little thick

Check out on Amazon

7. Amovo camera lens covers – Minimalistic

If you want a simple yet effective protector, consider Amovo. It’s a camera frame with 9H-rated glass that protects your camera from external damage and scratches. The glass is also hydrophobic and oleophobic, repelling water, dust, oil, and even your fingerprints.

It maintains a slim profile while not affecting your photos due to precision cuts. It uses the nano-electrostatic adsorption technology that allows you to install this protector without bubbles in a few steps.

Pros

  • Slim profile
  • Lightweight
  • Multiple variations available

Cons

  • It can break when dropped hard

Check out on Amazon

Final thoughts

Apple claims that its iPhones are strong enough to withstand usual drops. However, it’s best to stay a step ahead and keep your brand-new iPhone 14 and 14 Plus safe. These were a few options to protect your camera lens, but you can also find some good rugged or thin cases if you prefer them.

Read more:

  • Use Night Mode on iPhone camera like a pro
  • How to use the timer on iPhone Camera

@graph.name: iGeeksBlog
@graph.description: iGeeksBlog is your global go-to source for Apple, tech, and gaming. Get the latest news, reviews, and tips to stay ahead in the fast-paced tech world.

@graph.name: Spigen Optik Pro – Editor’s Choice
@graph.description: If you’re looking for the best protection and an easily applicable lens protector, you should undoubtedly go for the Spigen Optik Pro. It comes with 9H-rated tempered glass for better durability. Additionally, an oleophobic coating resists fingerprints on the lens, so you don’t have to worry about fingerprint smudges. The packaging comes with an EZ Fit tray that lets you align them perfectly with the camera lenses on your iPhone. Furthermore, as expected, you’ll see two lens covers and a cleaning kit.

@graph.name: ESR tempered glass protector – Best individual protection
@graph.description: If you want something stealthy and don’t want your camera to protrude with a protector, ESR’s solution is the right one for you. The ESR tempered glass lens protector has individual glass protectors for each lens, and since this tempered glass is scratch-resistant, it’ll keep your lenses safe. You can apply them on top of each camera lens, and the strong adhesive will keep them in place. Additionally, you don’t have to worry about bubbles when applying them. These lens doesn’t obstruct your camera’s angles or views, so you get great photos while keeping it safe. These glasses don’t block and scatter your camera’s flashlight, either.

@graph.name: Jeluse lens protector – Metal and glass combo
@graph.description: This one is for you if you want individual camera lens protection yet want metal protection. It comes with 9H tempered glass housed inside an aluminum metal ring. While it protects your camera lenses from drops and shocks, it also repels water, oil, and dust protection, providing clean photos for you. On top of it, anti-reflection technology doesn’t reflect flashlights during the nighttime. Also, it has patterns on the surface that sparkle in any lighting. It arrives with an easy installation kit and demolition sticks, letting you remove it whenever you want to switch things up.

@graph.name: Ringke camera styling – Multicolor options
@graph.description: If you are looking for something different other than glass, the Ringke camera styling protector is perfect for you. Instead of tempered glass, it uses aluminum to protect the camera frame. However, it doesn’t cover the lenses giving you an unhindered photography experience. Its surface is anti-reflective, hence doesn’t affect your photos when you take images at night. It is entirely shock-absorbant yet lightweight. The packaging is kept minimal to keep it eco-friendly. Furthermore, the installation is straightforward, and you wouldn’t need much assistance.

@graph.name: Tensea camera lens protector – Shiny lenses
@graph.description: If you prefer to go bling-bling over stealth, Tensea’s individual lens protectors are the right ones for you. It has a 9H tempered glass protector housed in an aluminum ring casing. The aluminum ring has a 3D texture that shines in different lighting conditions. This lens is available in multiple colors, and since it’s easier to apply and remove, you can switch between different colors anytime. Moreover, you don’t get any haze when you take photos at night with a flashlight. It fits perfectly with iPhone 14 and 14 Plus lens cutouts. Moreover, it is shock-absorbant while maintaining a slim profile.

@graph.name: Goton camera frame – Eye-catching design
@graph.description: If just bling-bling for individual camera lenses isn’t enough for you, Goton’s solution makes your camera shiny. It combines metal and glass materials to provide excellent protection to your iPhone’s cameras. Also, it’s entirely covered with sparkly rhinestones laid under the glass, making it shine under light. It comes with 9H-rated drop and scratch protection and doesn’t affect your photos when you use a flashlight. Applying it is convenient, and you’d not see bubbles after that. It’s available in multiple colors if you want to switch styles.

@graph.name: Amovo camera lens covers – Minimalistic
@graph.description: If you want a simple yet effective protector, consider Amovo. It’s a camera frame with 9H-rated glass that protects your camera from external damage and scratches. The glass is also hydrophobic and oleophobic, repelling water, dust, oil, and even your fingerprints. It maintains a slim profile while not affecting your photos due to precision cuts. It uses the nano-electrostatic adsorption technology that allows you to install this protector without bubbles in a few steps.

title.rendered: Best Lightning Docking Stations for iPad in 2026

content.rendered:
Lightning docks are the order of the day. With Apple completely switching to the smaller “lightning” connector, accessory-makers have had to change course and produce best lightning docking stations for iPad. We already have covered docking stations for iPhone 5/5s. Now it’s time for a list of high-grade iPad lightning docks that are designed minimally, beautifully and provide the best docking stands for your iPad Air and iPad Minis and earlier iPad models.

1. Twelve South HiRise Deluxe

Twelve South’s products are known for their Apple-esque simplicity and purity. The HiRise for iOS devices is a classic example of trademark style and aesthetics from Twelve South. Courtesy the solid structure and stable base, it can hold your tablet perfectly.

One notable feature of this dock is that it holds the device in a way that you have better viewing angle.

Height adjustable cable clip makes it work with most cases. Even better, the dock comes with MFi certified cable to let you charge your devices fast and securely.

USP: Height adjustable cable clip
Check out on Amazon

2. EasyAcc

EasyAcc is what you should pick to keep all of your devices perfectly organized. Featuring as many as six ports, it lets you power up multiple devices at once.

There is an extra space to let you store small items. It’s got a durable construction that can withstand minor impact.

With the magnetic base, the dock stays intact while holding all of your devices. Lastly, you can get EasyAcc in two colors: black and brown.

USP: Magnetic base
Check out on Amazon

3. JUNCH

If you are willing to go for a high-quality wooden dock, give JUNCH a close look. This charging station is constructed with the top-quality bamboo. Thanks to the sturdy built-in it can resist drops with ease.

It can charge not just your iPad and iPad but also your Apple Watch. With the neat cable management, it prevents cable clutter. Besides, JUNCH comes in two colors: dark and light brown.

USP: Natural bamboo
Check out on Amazon

4. Pezin & Hulin

What makes “Pezin & Hulin” a fine option is the solid bamboo construction. The smooth edges and neat cutouts further enhance its design. You can use it to charge multiple iPhones, iPad, and Apple Watch simultaneously.

One notable feature of this dock is the ideal cable management. That means your desk will remain clutter-free. Due mainly to the magnetic base, it stays firmly intact while holding your device.

USP: Neat cable management
Check out on Amazon

5. iHome iPL8XHG

What about choosing a more functional docking station? Aside from letting your power up your tablet, it also entertains you with superb sound iHome iPL8XHG. You can instantly connect your iOS device to it and stream songs wirelessly.

Powered by reason8 speaker chambers, it’s got the ability to liven up your music.

The FM with six preset stations helps you catch up with your favorite programs. Moreover, you can also set up multiple alarms to stay at pace with your time.

USP: Reason8 speaker chambers
Check out on Amazon

That’s all, folks!

Which is Your Favorite?

Which one of the above lightning docking stations for iPad have you chosen to power up your iPad? It would be nice to know your pick and the features that you have found adorable in it.

You would like to check out these posts as well:

  • iPad Pro 10.5-inch Stands
  • Best iPad Pro 10.5-inch Keyboard Cases

title.rendered: Best iPhone XR Privacy Screen Protectors in 2026

content.rendered:
Your iPhone is probably one of your most prized and private possessions. So it’s essential to keep it safe with high-quality iPhone XR cases and screen protectors. Moreover, an anti-spy screen protector goes a step further to defend your screen against scratches and limit the viewing angle of your display. So you can prevent shoulder-surfers in public spaces from catching a glimpse of your sensitive information with these best iPhone XR privacy screen protectors.

1. JETech | iPhone XR Privacy Screen Protectors

Dust-free, fingerprint-free, bubble-free, case-friendly, and of course, anti-spy – this screen guard checks all the boxes for guarding your phone screen. It fits perfectly, covering all the flat areas of the display with no air bubbles.

Further, it does a commendable job of protecting your privacy by only being visible to persons directly in front of the screen. So you can use your iPhone worry-free in crowded public places.

Check out on Amazon

2. Spigen Tempered Glass | iPhone XR Privacy Screen Protectors

Spigen’s privacy screen protector makes your life extremely easy. With its auto-alignment kit, you can achieve a fail-proof installation of this tempered glass screen protector. Once you install it, you will enjoy the black privacy of this screen guard, which gets partially blacked out at 30 degrees and completely invisible at 60 degrees.

The case-friendly design never comes in your way to install a protective case on your iPhone. Finally, this top-quality screen protector provides a fantastic touch response.

Check out on Amazon

3. Tech Armor | iPhone XR Privacy Screen Protectors

A screen protector should not compromise your user experience. Tech Armor knows this, and therefore, it has manufactured a screen guard that offers the ultimate protection to a larger HD display screen of iPhone XR. It features ten innovative layers that provide a 4-way privacy filter.

Further, the Japanese PET Privacy louver material keeps your sensitive data out of the view of identity thieves. Tech Armor’s dual-louver keeps your phone screen black no matter how you hold your device.

Check out on Amazon

4. uShield Privacy Screen Protector

This privacy screen protector will keep all your personal information away from the eyes of strangers around you. However, it also filters out a portion of your screen’s brightness, reducing it by 35%.

It features a hydrophobic and oleophobic coating to ensure your screen is devoid of any sweat, fingerprint, or oil residue. Lastly, an anti-scratch surface will protect your screen from minor drops, accidental bumps, and daily wear-and-tear.

Check out on Amazon

5. FlexGear Protective Tempered Glass

FlexGear presents a new generation screen protector, which does not darken your phone’s screen, and therefore, you do not need to adjust the brightness. Further, FlexGear uses Aura Shield glass, which provides 3D touch support.

Moreover, this glass has an anti-fingerprint coating, which prevents the touchscreen from getting damaged. For maximum protection, this glass has 9H hardness, and yet it is 15% thinner than other screen protectors.

Check out on Amazon

6. TORRAS Black Diamond Screen Protector

This iPhone XR privacy screen protector blocks the view of any person around your side who may be trying to view your screen, within a 28-degree angle. It’s made of 9H super-strong explosion-proof tempered glass that can survive when dropped on a hard surface from a height of 6Ft (1.8 meters).

At the same time, it repels oil and fingerprints to offer you the most natural viewing experience and 3D sensitive touch. The brand provides excellent customer support in case of any quality issues.

Check out on Amazon

7. Supershieldz 0.33mm Anti Spy Protector

Supershiledz has mastered the art of crafting a privacy screen protector. You can trust this anti-spy tempered glass screen protector made for your iPhone. Its 2.5D rounded edge glass provides extra comfort to your fingers and hand.

It keeps your screen protected against sweat and fingerprints thanks to the hydrophobic and oleophobic coating. Moreover, with its 9H hardness, this screen guard provides better security from scratches yet maintains the original touch experience.

Check out on Amazon

8. Ailun 0.25mm Japanese Glass

Ailun has made a privacy screen protector that is precisely compatible with the rounded design of the iPhone XR. Since the high-grade glass does not cover the entire screen, it is friendly to the protective cases you use for your iPhone. With its 99.99% touchscreen accuracy, you would love to interact with your iPhone.

Ailun’s hydrophobic and oleophobic coating prevents oil smudges and fingerprint stains from harming your phone screen. Keep your phone screen only visible to you while you are on the bus, elevator, or metro.

Check out on Amazon

9. Leadstar 3D Touch Tempered Glass

High definition, premium material, and adequate privacy make this screen guard stand out. It is compatible with 99% of the cases on the market, giving a perfect fit and complete clarity. It never interferes with Face ID.

Further, it’s easy to install without any air bubbles. It does not turn the screen too dark and won’t hurt the battery of your phone. Lastly, in case of any issues, you can contact the friendly customer service and get a free replacement for defective products.

Check out on Amazon

10. pehael 9H Hardness Anty Spy Protector

This privacy screen guard keeps your personal and sensitive data safe from strangers. The best thing about this screen protector is that you can hold your device horizontally or vertically. It’s made of 0.33mm premium quality tempered-glass, which keeps your phone screen dust- and fingerprint-free.

To make the installation process straightforward, Pehael provides wet/dry wipes and dust-removal stickers in the package. Once you install the protector, enjoy its 9H hardness and safeguard the phone’s touchscreen from scratches.

Check out on Amazon

Summing Up!

iPhone XR Privacy Screen Protectors are must-have accessories for your iPhone XR. Which one did you pick to add an extra layer of protection to your sensitive information?

  • Best iPhone Wallpaper Apps
