title.rendered: Best iPad Air 3 Heavy-Duty Cases

content.rendered:
Maybe you never want to give a nasty bump any chance to damage your iPad Air 3. Or, you think that your little kid has butterfingers and may randomly drop the tablet. Whatever could be the reason; there is an ideal answer to that concern–a heavy-duty case. Not all the rugged looking cover can bear the test of time and offer comfortable user-experience. And, this is where the below carefully handpicked best heavy-duty cases for 10.5-inch iPad Air can help you choose a better companion for your device. Apart from offering a robust defense to your tablet, many of them also double up as a kickstand case to bolster your video time. So, take a quick jump to choose a solid defender for your iPad right now!

Table of Contents
  • 1. ZUGU CASE Prodigy X
  • 2. MoKo
  • 3. SEYMAC
  • 4. CAVASA
  • 5. SKYLMW
  • 6. Digital Hutty

1. ZUGU CASE Prodigy X

“Prodigy X” from ZUGU CASE is just not about robust construction. To me, it’s the most functional heavy-duty case for the 10.5″ iPad Air.

An extremely impact-resistant structure enables Prodigy X to fight out drops of up to five feet. In most cases, this level of strength would be sufficient to keep your tablet secure.

However, what makes this cover a better deal is the magnetic kickstand. Depending on your viewing needs, you can adjust it in eight different angles to watch videos more conveniently.

USP: Magnetic stand offers multiple viewing angles
Check out on Amazon

2. MoKo

Simply put, MoKo is what you should go for if you have set your sight on finding a top-notch heavy-duty case under $15. And three qualities make it a fine option.

First off, it’s equipped with dual-layered casing ably backed by hard PC and soft TPU. So, your iPad has an extra safeguard against accidental falls as well as scratches.

The second, built-in kickstand works elegantly in offering comfortable viewing angles. And the third, it provides the much-needed defense to the touchscreen in the form of the built-in screen protector.

USP: Rugged hybrid design
Check out on Amazon

3. SEYMAC

SEYMAC’s case for iPad Air 3 is designed with a soft hand strap and portable shoulder strap to keep your iPad safe and secure all day long. With this kind of arrangement, you can hang it anywhere and cater a hands-free experience for your designs or streaming.

It comes with a multi-angle view, which makes your iPad a perfect companion for outdoor traveling. Camp all you want but don’t forget your iPad for a relishing musical barbeque experience.

The case is designed aptly to have perfect access to all the buttons, controls, and ports. It also comes with drop protection, making it perfect for kids in their developing age.

USP: Touch screen display with in-screen keyboard
Check out on Amazon

4. CAVASA

If uncompromised defense to your iPad Air 2019 is your main priority, you can’t go wrong with CAVASA.

The cover has an enormously durable PC bumper and features soft TPU back. It’s this solid and impact-resistant structure that empowers the case to fight out nasty bumps with ease.

Plus, it has 3mm raised bezel to defend the screen against scratches. Besides, CAVASA kickstand can let you prop up your device both vertically and horizontally.

USP: Shockproof design
Check out on Amazon

5. SKYLMW

“SKYLMW” is the sort of case that looks like a complete package. Talking about the design, the case is very protective, thanks to the three layers of construction.

To ensure the display doesn’t get damaged, it features raised bezel. The stand can be easily rotated to 360-degrees for enhanced viewing angles.

The perfect cutouts and along with the responsive buttons allows you to use your device without any inconvenience. Lastly, SKYLMW is available in three colors like pink, black, and plumby.

USP: Form-fitting profile
Check out on Amazon

6. Digital Hutty

This offering from Digital Hutty may have found its place at the 10th place in this roundup, but it’s got all the qualities to give a long run to any of the covers mentioned above.

To provide the necessary protection to the iPad, this case has an extremely rugged structure of three layers. The 3mm higher beveled edge gives an additional shield to the screen and camera.

Besides, the kickstand is always readily available to boost your video calling or movie watching experience. That’s not all, Digital Hutty isn’t priced ($12.99) highly either.

USP: Rugged bumper with fortified corners
Check out on Amazon

That’s pretty much it! So, these are the heavy-duty covers that have passed my test. Hopefully, they can live up to your expectation as well.

What’s your pick?

They rightly say, “An ounce of prevention is better than a pound of cure. Therefore, it’s always recommended to take extra caution to keep damage at bay.

Editorial Note: When you purchase through our links, we earn a small commission. However, this does not affect our opinions or evaluations. Learn more about our Editorial Process and Disclaimer.

title.rendered: Best Cases for iPhone 15 to Protect and Style Your Phone in 2026

content.rendered:
Apple fam, your wishes have come true. The long-awaited iPhone 15 series with USB-C charging support is finally here. Knowing your love for the iPhone, we know you must have started planning your next big buy. So why not spend this time exploring some cool iPhone 15 cases as well? To make your search easier, I have curated a list of the best iPhone 15 cases. Let’s start!

Table of Contents
  • 1. Speck – Editor's choice
  • 2. totallee clear case
  • 3. ESR iPhone 15 Stash Stand Case
  • 4. Spigen Ultra Hybrid (MagFit)
  • 5. Mkeke clear case
  • 6. SUPCASE Unicorn Beetle PRO
  • 7. CASETiFY Chrome Doodles
  • 8. Mujjo – Best leather wallet case for iPhone 15
  • 9. Smartish Gripzilla
  • 10. TORRAS – 360-degree
  • Video: Best iPhone 15 cases

1. Speck – Editor’s choice

Coming from Speck, Presidio 2 Pro MagSafe with ClickLock is one of the most innovative iPhone 15 cases you can find. The ClickLock Interlock no-slip technology features a sturdy bolt that firmly attaches accessories to your iPhone or phone on other surfaces. With less friction involved, the case reduces the risk of messy slippages.   

Apart from all this, the Presidio 2 Pro MagSafe cover case comes with a precise fitting that quickly wraps all the edges of your smartphone. In addition, the ultra-responsive buttons available here bless you with a smoother clicking experience. The raised bezels add an extra edge to protect your screen and camera lens. Enjoy a scratch-resistant experience with this amazing iPhone cover.   

Also, if you want to resonate with Apple’s no-carbon initiative, let me tell you that the Presidio 2 Pro MagSafe cover uses 50% recycled plastics.   

Pros

  • Easy gripping with ClickLock 
  • Strong and durable build  
  • MagSafe charging support 

Cons

  • No cons found  

Check out on Amazon

2. totallee clear case

When it comes to iPhone safety, clear cases are the best pick. They not only keep your iPhone safe but also help you embrace a stylish look. totallee clear glass case is the epitome of beauty and performance. Tailor-made to give a crystal-clear appearance, this drool-worthy iPhone 15 case adopts a no-branding pedagogy. So, you can finally say no to logos. Phew! 

Despite its feather-like clarity, this iPhone 15 clear case offers top-notch protection from all the adversities likely to daunt upon your smartphone. It is made with a robust shock-absorbing material that is strong enough to keep your iPhone 15 a timeless artwork for a long. No scratches, bruises, or falls will shun the beauty of your iPhone 15 with Totallee’s invisible phone protector.   

Pros

  • Transparent look  
  • Shock-absorbing material build 
  • No brand logos on display 

Cons

  • Might appear dull to some users 

Check out on Amazon

3. ESR iPhone 15 Stash Stand Case

The all-new Boost Stash Stand case by ESR is a content lover’s treasure. Designed to perfection, the iPhone case adorns a perfect fit and precise cutouts that align with every edge of your iPhone 15 like its second skin. Moreover, the cover has a unique Stash Stand that lets you bend your iPhone 15 to 30-60 degrees so you can enjoy a flawless viewing experience.   

The high-grade polymer used for creating this versatile cover gives a transparent look that does not turn yellow even after prolonged usage. So, you can flex the sexy design of your iPhone 15 in all those mirror selfies. Further, the shock-absorbing polymer paired with the raised screen edges saves your precious smartphone from drops, falls, and scratches. The camera guard is just the icing on the cake.   

Pros

  • Slim and sturdy build 
  • Exclusive camera guard 
  • Flexible Stash Stand for content streaming 

Cons

  • No cons found 

Check out on Amazon

4. Spigen Ultra Hybrid (MagFit)

Are you looking for an excellent MagSafe-compatible case for iPhone 15? Congrats! The Spigen Ultra Hybrid (MagFit) case is the perfect pick for you. Measuring 5.97 x 2.98 x 0.51 inches, this robust mobile cover wraps all the edges of your iPhone 15 effortlessly. In addition, the flexible TPU material saves your smartphone from every time you bump against a wall or drop your iPhone with a thud on the floor.   

The raised edges alongside the display screen and camera setup offer uncompromised safety to your iPhone’s two most essential parts. These raised edges protect the screen and lens from scratching even when you lay your iPhone flat.   

Pros

  • Long-lasting clarity 
  • Strong magnetic charging support 
  • Raised edges for screen and camera 

Cons

  • Slightly expensive 

Check out on Amazon

5. Mkeke clear case

Mkeke clear case gives you the best of both worlds – style and safety. Made using premium-quality TPU material; this transparent case does not let stains, fingerprints, and sweat spoil the beauty of your iPhone 15. In addition, Mkeke ensures that your clear case remains the same and does not turn into an ugly shade of yellow after rigorous use for an extended period.   

Designed to fit iPhone 15, the case envelops your smartphone snugly, giving no chance for your smartphone to slip out. Moreover, its military-grade drop protection comes with in-built corner bags and elevated bezels. Every feature works together to keep your iPhone 15 from sudden falls, bumps against walls, or scratches.   

When pressed, the precisely pronounced buttons feel easy to touch, ensuring flawless access to the iPhone’s buttons, features, and functions. Further, the case features a one-of-a-kind sloped camera design that works well with wireless chargers and stands. The brand offers top-notch safety at a pocket-friendly price, something you won’t find easily.

Pros

  • Fully transparent TPU material 
  • Military-grade and shockproof protection 
  • Raised bezels around edges and camera 
  • Precise buttons  

Cons

  • Unsure about durability 

Check out on Amazon 

6. SUPCASE Unicorn Beetle PRO

I know dropping your iPhone 15 is a nightmare you will never want to come across. Fortunately, with the Unicorn Beetle PRO MAG rugged case by SUPCASE, you can shoo away all these ugly fears in a blink. Made with polycarbonate material, this iPhone 15 case has TPU bumpers that bring unprecedented safety to your fingertips. Being scratch-resistant, you can use this MagSafe case just as you want.   

Despite the rugged build, the Unicorn Beetle PRO MAG cover fits your iPhone 15 from all edges. Furthermore, the raised bezels around the screen and lens help you place your precious smartphone on rough surfaces without worrying about damage.   

Pros

  • Tough and durable build 
  • MagSafe charging support 
  • Raised bezels for enhanced safety 

Cons

  • Rustic feel might irk some users

Check out on Amazon

7. CASETiFY Chrome Doodles

Doodles are fun, and so is this latest CASETiFY Chrome Doodles case. Adorning a mirror back, this amazing iPhone 15 cover defines style and safety. Created using PC and TPU material, the cover fits around your device to keep it safe from everyday wear and sudden mishaps. Plus, its EcoShock material helps withstand drops from up to 8.2 ft., earning a 4x military-grade safety standard.   

The Chrome Doodles case has a sleek frame that stretches across the edges without adding extra bulk. Feel free to carry it in your hand while attending calls or in your pockets along with your other stuff. In addition, the cover has raised bezels around the display and rear camera to avoid surface scratches.   

The haptic buttons sit atop the iPhone 15 buttons, offering a high-responsive touch or press. Similarly, the precise cutouts give easy, seamless access to your smartphone features. Further, the case is fully compatible with MagSafe chargers, so you get instant power fill anytime and anywhere. Lastly, you can attach funky charms to the side sockets and elevate your device’s look.

Pros

  • Sleek and lightweight 
  • MagSafe compatible 
  • Raised bezels around the screen and camera 
  • Side sockets for charms 

Cons

  • Retains fingerprints

Check out on Amazon

8. Mujjo – Best leather wallet case for iPhone 15

Take your iPhone 15’s safety to the next level with the Mujjo leather wallet case. Wrapped in vegetable-tanned Ecco leather, this beautiful case is soft to the touch and lightweight to carry around in your pockets. The Japanese microfiber inner lining gives your Mujjo leather wallet case a satin-like finish. If you love premium products, you will love this iPhone 15 wallet case.   

The cover has robust machined metal buttons that sit right above the iPhone 15 keys for an easy access to features and functions. In addition, the elevated lips around the camera and screen allow you to place your smartphone on any surface without worrying about scratches. Despite the snug build, Mujjo leather case fits well with screen protectors.  

One of the main USPs of this leather case is the leather wallet-cum-card holder. Here, you can keep 2 to 3 cards, like credit card or photos. The enclosed fit of the leather wallet stops your essentials from slipping out.   

Pros

  • Attached leather wallet  
  • Raised bezels for lenses 
  • Metal buttons 

Cons

  • No MagSafe support 

Check out on Amazon 

9. Smartish Gripzilla

Smartish Gripzilla is a god’s gift for you if you have butter fingers. Equipped with grooved sides, this amazing cover is the gripping beast that will save your iPhone 15 from slipping out of your hands. Even after this, if you somehow drop your smartphone, then worry not.    

Your smartphone case should pay special attention to edges because they are most prone to getting hit against hard surfaces. For this reason, Gripzilla has shock-absorbing air pockets. These air cushions can bear a fall up to 6 feet while keeping your iPhone 15 free from bruises and damage. FYI, the product is tested for 50 drops at 6ft onto concrete.   

The case has raised bumper edges for screen and camera lens protection. Thus making it easy to place the phone face up or down. Further, the strong magnets aligned on the case support quick wireless and MagSafe charging.

Pros

  • Grooves and grippy sides 
  • Raised bumper edges  
  • Shock-absorbing edges  

Cons

  • Might feel bulky 

Check out on Amazon 

10. TORRAS – 360-degree

Start a movie marathon with your friends in stunning 4K quality on iPhone 15, and let TORRAS make this experience special. This becomes possible with the all-new iPhone 15 case with a multipurpose 360-degree rotatable ring stand. You can pull the ring out and place your iPhone in multiple angles for great views. Give rest to your hands while playing games, attending video calls, browsing content, etc. The robust build of the ring allows you to hold it single-handedly with no drops.

The case is 3X military-grade certified, and houses the patented X-shock technology that saves it from drops up to 10ft high. Moreover, the raised edges alongside the screen and camera shoo away potential scratches, dents, or bumps. With N52 magnets, this versatile iPhone 15 case allows quick charging when required.  

Another interesting feature of this case is the detachable buttons that bless you with an evident tactile pressing experience. In addition, these DIY buttons come in 3 different colors for a more personalized look.

Pros

  • 360-degree rotatable ring stand 
  • Strong N52 magnets 
  • Military-grade protection 
  • DIY detachable buttons 

Cons

  • No cons found 

Check out on Amazon  

Video: Best iPhone 15 cases

Wrapping up 

That’s a wrap. Did you find a suitable case for your iPhone 15 from this list? Do share in the comments section.  

Read more:

  • Best iPhone 15 series cable, cases and accessories
  • Best cases for iPhone 15 Pro Max
  • Best iPhone 15 thin cases

title.rendered: Protect Your iPad Air 3 With These Top Screen Protectors

content.rendered:
Even before taking a close look at everything that the new iPad Air 2019 comes with, you should offer it up the first line of defense. And when I say the first layer of defense, I mean a top-grade screen guard with no compromises at all. A durable screen protector not only safeguards the entire screen from random bumps but also wards off ugly scuffs.

Thus, the touchscreen continues to look pristine and highly responsive for a long. Not to mention it plays a significant role in enhancing the user experience of a device. Yet to get one for your iPad? Why not have a glance at the following lineup of the best screen protectors for 10.5-inch iPad Air and pick out the most durable defender. Let me walk you through it!

Table of Contents
  • 1. amFilm
  • 2. iCarez
  • 3. Fintie
  • 4. ESR
  • 5. OMOTON
  • 6. Ainope
  • 7. JETech

1. amFilm

When it comes to high-quality screen protectors, “amFilm” is a well-known name. The reason why I find this manufacturer, so reliable is that I’ve used its offerings on many of my devices. And they have always lived up to my billing.

This tempered glass screen guard is very protective and can defend the touchscreen from all sorts of damages like bumps and scuffs. Being exceptionally sensitive, it makes sure your usage remains smooth sailing. Moreover, amFilm offers it in double packs.

USP: Highly sensitive touch
Check out on Amazon

2. iCarez

“iCarez” has also been one of my favorite screen protector makers. Its screen guard boasts maximum scratch resistance due mainly to the 9H hardness.

Another quality that puts it ahead of many of its rivals is the smooth curved (2.5D) design. As a result, it’s perfectly rolled out on the large screen. Plus, the TrueTouch Sensitivity and high definition clarity make it a complete package.

USP: TrueTouch Sensitivity
Check out on Amazon

3. Fintie

The highlight of Fintie screen defender is the more durability thanks to the slightly thicker (0.33mm) design. Besides, it’s also backed by solid hardness to endure shock.

Fintie says that its screen guard provides 99.99% transparency. If that really translates into performance, you will have much-improved viewing experience. Even better, it has an additional layer to stop grease and dust from building up on the screen.

USP: 99.99% transparency
Check out on Amazon

4. ESR

title.rendered: Best Screen Protection Options for iPhone 13 Mini

content.rendered:
The iPhone 13 mini is the definition of mega power in a compact smartphone. The smaller size makes it much easier to hold, which reduces the chances of those dreaded slips and falls. But you’ll still want reinforcement in the form of screen protectors to protect the best iPhone among the iPhone 13 lineup!

These help keep scratches, scuffs, and other damage away from your device’s beautiful Super Retina XDR display. In the list below, I’ve picked the best screen protectors to maintain your screen’s original clarity and touch responsiveness. This ensures a smooth and hassle-free experience.

Table of Contents
  • 1. Spigen tempered glass screen protector: Editor's choice
  • 2. ESR screen protector: Easy to install
  • 3. SuperShieldz screen guard: Best non-glass option
  • 4. UniqueMe: Best privacy screen protector with camera lens guard
  • 5. Ailun tempered glass: Best value for money

1. Spigen tempered glass screen protector: Editor’s choice

With the highest 9H durability and an oleophobic coating, this iPhone 13 mini full body screen protector does its job perfectly. It’s built to fend off everything from smudges and scuffs to scratches and bumps. At the same time, it maintains your display’s clarity and responsiveness for ease of use.

Moreover, it comes with a handy auto-alignment installation kit for quick and effortless application without any air bubbles. At the same time, the screen protector is case-friendly and compatible with almost any iPhone 13 mini case.

Check out on Amazon

2. ESR screen protector: Easy to install

ESR is an excellent brand for iPhone accessories, and this glass screen protector for iPhone 13 mini lives up to expectations. It offers ultra-strong resistance, withstanding up to 11lb of force to protect your screen from scratches and damage.

At the same time, the ultra-clear glass ensures HD clarity and a flawless viewing experience. You’ll forget that the tempered glass is even there! Further, you can achieve bubble-free application, thanks to the easy installation frame and cleaning kit.

Check out on Amazon

3. SuperShieldz screen guard: Best non-glass option

Although a tempered glass screen protector is the way to go for sturdy protection against bumps and drops, not everyone needs it. Here’s a thin non-glass screen protector that simply keeps scratches and smudges away. It’s perfect for those who use their phones carefully and don’t need tough protection.

Moreover, it’s got a matte finish that reduces glare and fingerprints. Of course, it also maintains the real-touch sensitivity of your phone for a natural feel. Easy installation is just the cherry on top!

But the best part is its affordability! You get 6 in a pack for a pocket-friendly price of under $10.

Check out on Amazon

4. UniqueMe: Best privacy screen protector with camera lens guard

For all you fellow over-cautious people out there, I’ve found the best tempered glass for iPhone 13 mini that offers ultimate value.

Not only does the UniqueMe screen protector guard against scratches and damage, but it is also anti-spy. That means nobody can sneak a glance at your screen when you’re using your phone in public. The screen remains visible only when viewed from directly in front, so it’s great for privacy!

Moreover, it comes in a handy combo pack that includes camera lens protectors for your iPhone 13 mini. This is a night photo circle that eliminates the glare caused when using the flash. So, you can capture great photos even in the dark. Pretty cool, right? UniqueMe also provides lifetime service.

Check out on Amazon

5. Ailun tempered glass: Best value for money

Protecting your iPhone 13 mini doesn’t have to cost a lot. Ailun has some of the most affordable tempered glass screen protectors that get the job done! It fits perfectly around the contours of the display while maintaining perfect clarity and touch sensitivity.

Further, it’s hydrophobic and oleophobic to keep away the sweat and oil residue from fingerprints. The installation process is pretty straightforward and won’t leave any air bubbles as long as you follow the instructions.

Check out on Amazon

So, take your pick from these best iPhone 13 mini screen protectors and enjoy the mega power of your mini device! Got any questions? Just drop them in the comments below, and I’ll get back to you.

You may also like to read:

  • 5 Best iPhone 13 mini cases

Editorial Note: When you purchase through our links, we earn a small commission. However, this does not affect our opinions or evaluations. Learn more about our Editorial Process and Disclaimer.

acceptedAnswer.text: App Clips require internet connectivity and won't work offline. Since they're only a part of the app, they need to connect to the app database to fetch the complete information and function properly.

mainEntity.name: What is the size of an App Clip?

acceptedAnswer.text: An App Clip is generally between 10MB and 15MB in size. Earlier, the restriction was to keep App Clips under 10MB, but with the introduction of better technology and internet connectivity, App Clips in iOS 16 or later can be up to 15MB large.

acceptedAnswer.text: If you actively use Facebook daily, the cache files can quickly pile up. So, you must delete them once every 1-2 weeks. For moderate users, clearing the cache once every month is sufficient.

title.rendered: Best iPad Mini 5 Heavy Duty Cases in 2026

content.rendered:
The 5th Generation iPad Mini sports Apple A12 chip with neural engine and a staggering 7.9-inch display was launched quietly! And the upgrade that iPad Mini got, saying, it will support Apple pencil, got my attention. The device, with so many things to look after, needs to be handled with care. Be it a college, office, playground, etc, where ever you carry your precious iPad Mini 5, you need to protect it with a heavy-duty case!

Table of Contents
  • 1. Owkey
  • 2. Seymac
  • 3. SXTech
  • 4. Bentoben
  • 5. Supfives
  • 6. Seymac
  • 7. Hocase
  • 8. Grifobes
  • 9. Elegant Choise
  • 10. Sevrok

1. Owkey

Preferred by most of the users like you, Owkey stands alone when it comes to rugged cases for iPad Mini 5. This case boasts a pen holder, 360-degree swivel stand, hand strap, shoulder strap and what not! Handle hand grip is adjustable so it’s easy to carry on the go! The material used in it is durable and it’s shockproof.

The three-layer protection with precise cutouts makes it a perfect pick. Moreover, they claim to provide 12 months of free replacement or 45 days money back warranty. Now you hardly find such warranties in cases these days. It’s a complete package if you are looking a heavy duty case for your iPad Mini 5.

USP: Unmatched Warranty with Superior Quality
Check Out on Amazon

2. Seymac

Just like Owkey case, Seymac gives all in one protection. With this, you might not need a separate kickstand case for iPad Mini 5 as a 360-degree rotating stand is already available in Seymac. That’s the best thing when you’re traveling for a long distance and want to use your iPad mini freely.

Its drop proof and shock proof that gives your iPad Mini 5 protection all the way! The case is made with high-grade thermoplastic and anti-skidding silicone. And moreover, it has the built-in screen protector that gives superior protection overall.

USP: Portable Shoulder Strap
Check Out on Amazon

3. SXTech

This case is almost similar to what we have seen so far in the above two cases. The thing that stands apart is the wide range of colors available in SXTech’s iPad Mini 5 heavy duty case. With 360 degrees kickstand and more like a beast, this case is yet another contender in the race.

The shoulder strap is adjustable and can be removed whenever needed. It’s a 3-layer heavy duty bumper case that gives your iPad Mini solid protection. The case is available in Black + Black, Black + Camouflage, Black + Orange, Blue + Black, Green + Black and Rose + Black! These are some of the best color combinations I have ever seen in an iPad Mini 5 case.

USP: 3-layered Heavy Duty Protection
Check Out on Amazon

4. Bentoben

Made with soft silicone and hard plastic, this case is durable for sure. It’s shockproof and the anti-scratch feature makes it even better. Bentoben’s iPad Mini 5 rugged case is the finest combination of elegance and solidity.

The precise cutout makes it easier to access the buttons, speakers, mic, camera and all ports. This beast is available in 3 colors, grey, navy blue & grey, and navy blue & green. It doesn’t come with a screen protector as all the above mentioned cases come with.

USP: Precise Cutouts
Check Out on Amazon

5. Supfives

If you’re looking for complete protection and want to maintain a crystal clear look of your iPad Mini 5, Supfives heavy duty case if your way to go! The case comes with a pencil holder, adjustable shoulder strap for easy to carry anywhere, 360-degree rotating stand to free your hands, adjustable hand strap for important meetings and lots more!

This rugged case stands unique from all as it has a clear case with maximum protection. Apart from that, the case is available in black+red, blue+black, green, hot pink, clear+pink, black, navy blue+grey. The case comes with a 12-month warranty.

USP: Clear Case with Superior Protection
Check Out on Amazon

6. Seymac

I know that I have already listed Seymac above but believe me, this one is the best of both, at least for me. Of course, it doesn’t have the 360-degree stand and a pencil holder but I still love this one just because of its design and cutouts.

The sleek design and the leather material used in this case give a premium look for your iPad Mini 5 indeed! It’s available in 4 colors variants.

USP: Apple Pencil holder
Check Out on Amazon

7. Hocase

Hocase’s heavy duty case for iPad Mini stands out different from all due to its unique back design. The case is easy to grip as it’s made of silicone rubber and plastic material is used on the cutouts. Hocase’s iPad Mini 5 case is a perfect blend of silicone and plastic giving protection against bumps, drops, and shocks!

Hocase sports dual-layer design with shock absorbent ability. The raised edges provide a perfect camera lens and screen protection. This iPad Mini case is available in 7 color variants and that’s a lot of options to choose from. Isn’t it?

USP: Raised Edges
Check Out on Amazon

8. Grifobes

This case is more like a kickstand blended with a perfect heavy duty case. All the four corners are protected with ease as it has 3-layered shock-absorbing TPU protection. It’s easy to carry on the go as it’s not that bulky. But don’t take it for granted, despite being light in weight, it can protect your iPad Mini 5 just like another rugged case.

It’s easy to access the buttons, camera, speakers, etc as it has the precise cutouts at a perfect place. Grifobes case is available in 4 colors variants. If you’re looking forward to buying a lightweight heavy duty case for iPad Mini 5, Grifobes is your way to go!

USP: Lightweight
Check Out on Amazon

9. Elegant Choise

Yes, the Choise word is right; it’s a brand name after all. Facing tough competition from the beasts, Elegant Choise still stands unique in terms of iPad Mini 5 case design. The cutouts on the back of the panel along with a kickstand case which can be adjusted as per the viewing make it a perfect choice and affordable option as well.

The case is made of silicone and plastic material. This case is 5mm higher than the iPad Mini 5 as it protects the camera lens and screen both. It’s a perfect pick for an accidental drop as it’s a 3-layer rugged protective case. This case is available in Blue, Red, and Yellow colors.

USP: Hard plastic inner shell and a soft outer skin
Check Out on Amazon

10. Sevrok

Don’t go with the design, I repeat, don’t look at the slimness of the case. It’s much stronger than you think it looks. Of course, it’s a dual layer protection case; the shockproof feature makes it a better option. Enjoy reading, watch movies and play some games with ease as Kickstand is available in this case.

It’s easy to carry and if you’re looking forward to buying it for your kid’s iPad, this would be a perfect choice. The case is available in black, navy, blue, and mint colors.

USP: Super sturdy and easy to carry
Check Out on Amazon

That’s all for the day!

Wrapping Up…

Do let us know in the comment section about your favorite iPhone Mini 5 heavy duty case. If you find any other case that’s impressive and it’s not listed above, do let us know in comments.

Editorial Note: When you purchase through our links, we earn a small commission. However, this does not affect our opinions or evaluations. Learn more about our Editorial Process and Disclaimer.

title.rendered: Best Protective and Stylish Cases for iPhone 12 & 12 Pro

content.rendered:
When you own an iPhone 12 or a 12 Pro model, you hold the future in your hand. The device is crafted with the utmost elegance, using high-end tech integrations. There’s no doubt that it has a sturdy body. Not just this, a beautiful case and cover can further help you add looks and luxury to your priceless possession.

Having a case over it is still a wise option if you want to restore the same shine in the long run. Let’s look at some of the best cases for iPhone 12 and 12 Pro.

Table of Contents
  • 1. Apple clear case with MagSafe
  • 2. Pad & Quill's Bella Fino wallet case
  • 3. Ringke military grade cover
  • 4. Spigen thin fit designed cover
  • 5. ESR kickstand clear case
  • 6. Smartish slim card holder case
  • 7. Otterbox Strada Series wallet case
  • 8. Caseology nano pop silicone case
  • 9. Velvetcaviar bumper case

1. Apple clear case with MagSafe

Want to feel how it feels to hold delicate sturdiness? If the answer’s yes, this one can feed your desire flawlessly. Made using flexible materials and polycarbonate, the case houses your iPhone 12 or 12 Pro device effortlessly. The clear case comes in 9 different color options and has an appealing design marking the best space to fit a wireless charger. The magnets are perfectly aligned to offer you err-free and quick charging.

Pros

  • Apple’s Trust
  • MagSafe Compatibility
  • Light Weight

Cons

  • Open Bottom
  • Slight Slippery

Check out on Apple

2. Pad & Quill’s Bella Fino wallet case

An unmatched amalgamation of luxury and protection, the Pad & Quill case for iPhone 12 and 12 Pro won’t disappoint you at any point. The wallet case is crafted using American full-grain leather and offers sufficient space to house 5-7 cards/cash. Having said this, be it your business card, credit card, or cash, you’ll always have them handy with just a flip away. It further adds to looks with the French hemmed seems aligned symmetrically to give that creamy feel.

Pros

  • Premium Quality
  • 25-year leather warranty

Cons

  • Quite Bulky
  • Little Expensive

Check out on Pad & Quill for iPhone 12 | iPhone 12 Pro

3. Ringke military grade cover

Coming from the house of Ringke, the protective case is shockproof and offers the perfect grip on your iPhone 12 or 12 Pro Device. The circular emboss sides and the sleek metal buttons add to looks and ensure a perfect grip while you are holding it in your hand. It also has dual QuickCatch lanyard holes to secure it using neck straps or attach it to hand.

Pros

  • Sturdy Material
  • Non-slip material

Cons

  • Little bulky

Check out on Amazon

4. Spigen thin fit designed cover

This thin case is made using a scratch-resistant PC, which isn’t just light in weight but also easy to be kept in your pocket. The case has been made using utmost precision to cutouts for easy access and raised bezels giving added protection. The case fits in your iPhone 12 or 12 Pro as it is part of its body. Having said this, it adds negligibly to its weight and size. Besides, you can also expect to have the uptown appearance to match your formal and casual appearance.

Pros

  • Flexible
  • Slim Fit

Cons

  • Basic Protection

Check out on Amazon

5. ESR kickstand clear case

This case is available in a transparent and translucent black version. Adorned with a stainless steel two-way stand, it lets you watch your favorite videos or read a file with ease. The stand can be freely adjusted up to a 60-degree angle to give you ‘that perfect view.’ The hinge supporting it also tested under various conditions and numerous times to ensure that you receive the best experience.

  • Great for watching videos

Cons

As the name goes, the wallet slayer is indeed a smart creation. Besides securely housing your iPhone 12 or 12 Pro, it can also carry your three cards and some cash. In case you need them handy and don’t want to carry your bulky wallet with you. Talking about design and material aesthetics. This offers you textured slides with a better grip, ensuring you don’t slip it off by mistake. The raised bezels surrounding the camera and front section ensure that your screen doesn’t get any scratches even when kept flat.

Pros

  • Better Grip
  • Futuristic Design

Cons

  • Little Heavy
  • Limited Color Options

The wallet case features a functional and fashionable design with a very realistic approach. Carrying modern aesthetics, the Strada Series case for iPhone 12 and 12 Pro is undoubtedly a gem. Made using premium material, it features iconic looks, and the raised edges further add the needed protection for your device. Inside, soft leather has been used to protect your screen. You can consider carrying 2-3- cards and some cash in this leather wallet case.

Pros

  • Durable
  • Raised Bezels

Cons

8. Caseology nano pop silicone case

Simplistic design yet with ‘just the right’ blend to catch the attention. Available in four attractive color options, the Casology case for iPhone 12 and 12 Pro is indeed a treat for eyes. The durable silicone body gets complimented with a soft lining on the inside, not to harm your priceless possession. At the rear, you’d notice raised edges surrounding the camera measuring around 2mm. This makes your device further secured when lying flat on a surface or after a fall.

Pros

Cons

It’s gorgeous, and there isn’t any doubt about it. Featuring pastel marble pattern all across the body, the protective case is a treat for the eyes. Adding to the look, you can notice rose gold chrome further getting accompanied by a blush pink bumper to provide added protection to your device. Having this to secure your iPhone, you can stay assured not just to protect it from scratches, but also gain the attention of your friends and people around.

title.rendered: Best iPhone 11 Pro Max Screen Protectors You Can Buy

content.rendered:
A screen guard is perhaps the most vital accessory for your iPhone 11 Pro Max. Like protective cases, it’s an invaluable investment to protect the display from scratches, dust, smudges, and even cracks. So, it’s crucial to get a high-quality product. With so many options available, it’s no easy task to pick the right one. But we’ve helped out with this roundup of the best iPhone 11 Pro Max screen protectors.

Table of Contents
  • 1. Spigen Tempered Glass Screen Protector
  • 2. ESR Premium Screen Protector
  • 3. Trianium HD Clarity 0.25mm Tempered Glass
  • 4. SuperShieldz Anti Spy Screen Protector
  • 5. TORRAS Diamonds Hard Screen Protector
  • 6. JETech Tempered Glass Film
  • 7. Fotbor Privacy Screen Protector
  • 8. ZAGG InvisibleShield Glass+ Screen Protector
  • 9. TETHYS Glass Screen Protector
  • 10. EasyAcc Clear Case with Screen Protector

1. Spigen Tempered Glass Screen Protector

Spigen is one of the most well-known brands for iPhone accessories like cases and camera lens protectors. This tempered glass screen protector is enclosed in a casing that acts as an installation device and protects the glass until you are ready to use it.

It is perfectly compatible with almost any protective cover, particularly the ones from Spigen. An oleophobic coating ensures daily fingerprint resistance to keep your screen looking clean and pristine.

Check out on Amazon

2. ESR Premium Screen Protector

This screen guard has been tempered to resist up to 5 kg of force, helping to reduce damage from short-distance drops & bumps. It’s much smoother than plastic alternatives and has an ideal 2.5D arc, providing a smooth and safe-to-the-touch surface.

Further, it’s precisely cut for the iPhone 11 Pro Max, so it does not interfere with the Face ID feature. The screen guard will leave a bit of space near the phone’s edges to prevent air bubbles and a perfect fit.

Check out on Amazon

3. Trianium HD Clarity 0.25mm Tempered Glass

This durable screen protector consistently protects your screen from scratches, scuffs, and impacts. It’s completely transparent, so it is sure to provide the native HD iPhone experience. There’s also a lifetime warranty to make sure you are satisfied with the purchase.

Further, the protective hydrophobic and oleophobic coating protects your screen from fingerprint marks and liquid residue. The installation kit makes it quick and easy to apply, for a hassle-free experience.

Check out on Amazon

4. SuperShieldz Anti Spy Screen Protector

This screen guard for your iPhone 11 Pro Max also works as a privacy shield. It’s a high-quality privacy tempered-glass that only allows viewing when a person is directly in front of the screen. If others try to peak, they will only be privy to a blackish screen.

An easy installation tray is provided to smoothen the overall installation process. While maintaining the original touch experience, Supershieldz keeps the screen scratch-resistant and reduces sweat, oil, or fingerprint marks. Further, the glass is also designed to avoid the rainbow-effect.

Check out on Amazon

5. TORRAS Diamonds Hard Screen Protector

Here’s a screen protector that is made of nano-sized super-strong explosion-proof tempered glass material. It boasts ultra-hardness certified to survive even if it falls from a height of 6 feet (1.8 meters) to hard ground.

At the same time, it’s ultra-thin, so you will hardly feel anything on your device while also keeping it free of scratches, streaks, bubbles, fingerprints, etc. It offers natural viewing angles and 3D sensitive touch, smooth video playing, and gaming.

Check out on Amazon

6. JETech Tempered Glass Film

Here’s a tempered glass that retains amazing clarity for flawless viewing experience. It keeps your phone responds to every touch and tap. Simultaneously, 2.5D rounded edges aid your fingers in swiping and sliding smoothly across the screen.

Further, the formidable resistance of the 9H hardness can withstand all kinds of impacts and scratches to provide the ultimate dependable protection. Do note that the glass is slightly smaller than the iPhone screen for an ideal fit free of bubbles.

Check out on Amazon

7. Fotbor Privacy Screen Protector 

Get this screen guard to keep your personal and sensitive information safe from strangers in crowded places. It works whether you hold your phone horizontally or vertically while also safeguarding against wear and tear.

It’s designed with a hydrophobic and oleophobic coating and an anti-scratch surface to protect your screen from accidental spills, oil residue from fingerprints, bumps, and minor drops. Of course, it’s fully compatible with 3D touch too.

Check out on Amazon

8. ZAGG InvisibleShield Glass+ Screen Protector

ZAGG’s invisible glass shield is engineered to fit snugly on your iPhone 11 Pro Max. It’s designed meticulously to offer a precise, case-friendly fit for your premium display. It has a very smooth feel, allowing easy navigation.

At the same time, it is impact and scratch-resistant, keeping your phone looking pristine for longer. It makes your screen resistant to oil and smudges, maintaining a clean and clear viewing experience.

Check out on Amazon

9. TETHYS Glass Screen Protector

This tempered glass screen shield provides edge to edge protection to your phone against scratches, bumps, and minor drops. It is ultra-transparent, and you won’t even notice it’s presence.

Moreover, the 9H screen hardness offers maximum coverage while allowing full access to all buttons, ports, and face recognition functionality. It’s easy to install, and you’ll get a lifetime warranty for your purchase.

Check out on Amazon

10. EasyAcc Clear Case with Screen Protector

Check out this screen protector that comes with a clear case for your iPhone 11 Pro Max. The ultra-transparent design reveals and enhances your phone’s original color, covering all buttons and supporting wireless charging.

Your screen will be reliably protected against sweat and oil residue from fingerprints and, of course, scratches and scuffs too. At the same time, your device will remain lightweight and easy to use every day.

Check out on Amazon

Summing Up!

We hope this has helped you find the best screen protector for your iPhone 11 Pro Max. You can also try out liquid protectors if you like. Don’t forget to share your recommendations with us in the comments below.

Editorial Note: When you purchase through our links, we earn a small commission. However, this does not affect our opinions or evaluations. Learn more about our Editorial Process and Disclaimer.

title.rendered: Best iPad Mini 5 Clear Cases in 2026

content.rendered:
Apple has quietly introduced its iPad mini 5 during its week of surprise product launches. This low-priced tablet will surely get some takers. If you are one of those proud buyers, make sure your premium device flaunts its original design and true colors. For this, a clear case for your iPad mini 5 is the best option. The latest iPad mini is available in three finishes: Silver, Space Gray, and Gold. A crystal clear case helps you showcase the () Apple logo and the beauty of your tablet. Before you purchase a transparent cover, check its features; an anti-yellow case is your best bet.

1. ESR

ESR has emerged as a leading brand in iOS accessories. This clear case for iPad mini is designed exclusively for the latest iPad 7.9″ version. A hard case that fits on your iPad and creates a slim profile of your smart device. A notable feature of this case is FlexPress button covers, which you can press easily. This naturally makes your iPad interaction fast.

The FlexPress button covers provide another significant benefit; they keep out dust. The lightweight case adds no extra bulk to your iPad mini.

USP: FlexPress button covers
Check out on Amazon

2. AVIDET

AVIDET has precisely designed this transparent case to keep essential ports accessible quickly. The camera is a frequently used app on iPad mini, and therefore, AVIDET has left enough bezel to protect the camera lens. The soft and durable PU leather protects your device against scratches and routine damage.

The best thing about this case is hassle-free performance. You can comfortably interact with your device without removing the cover.

USP: Easy Installation
Check out on Amazon

3. TopACE

It is hard to find an ultra-thin body of a clear case, but TopACE has achieved this feat effortlessly by using soft GEL TPU. A silicone case, which is compatible with your iPad mini 5, boasts accurate cut-outs for buttons, ports, and camera of your 2019 iPad mini.

TopACE has paid full attention to details, and this has resulted in a full-body protective case, which covers your iPad mini from all sides and corners. An anti-slip grip comes from flexible TPU, which also forms a bumper cushion against shocks and drops.

USP: Silicone case
Check out on Amazon

4. Valkit

Valkit has manufactured a smart folio stand case, which flaunts a heavy-duty rugged profile. This impact-resistant armor cover automatically wakes up your iPad when you open it, and your iPad goes to sleep when you close the lid. This shockproof case has built-in magnets with dual standing positions.

This case is made of premium PU leather front and transparent back; it is a combination of hard PC and TPU. Enjoy complete protection from accidental drops and scratches.

USP: Tri-fold front cover
Check out on Amazon

5. Arozell

Why not flaunt your fantastic iPad Mini with this slim and rugged clear case from Arozell. The case also protects your mini-tablet with its ultra-tough thermoplastic polyurethane material build. Because it is made of a soft TPU material the case also lets the beauty of your tablet shine through. And I almost forgot to mention that it is environmentally friendly as well, Yeahhhhh…

The flexible polymer makes it easy to insert and remove your iPad, also providing a comfortable, non-slip grip to your device. It even has a no-bubble technology that keeps all the air bubbles that spoil the whole look of your device at bay. While the case protects your iPad from the damage it also adds minimal bulk keeping the sleekness of your device at bay.

USP: Perfect fit
Check out on Amazon

6. 4 Seasons

A delight for all the Apple Pencil owners, finally a clear case for their iPad Mini that can also hold their pencils along. I keep loosing my pencil if I don’t have a case with its holder and thus, I can relate with everyone who suffers from the same.

The 4-seasons case is a simple clear case that is made of transparent TPU that is both shockproof and protective. But what gives this case an edge over all the others on this list is the slot to store the pencil so that you don’t lose it, even when you want to flaunt your tablet.

USP: Tear-resistant case
Check out on Amazon

7. SLEO

Rubber TPU back of SLEO case makes all the difference. In this list of clear covers, this is the first product that boasts waterproof design. Your precious tablet is guarded correctly with a fashionable look.

Normally, your tablet gets damaged when you install or remove the case. SLEO has taken enough care of this challenge as you can easily install and remove the case without scratching your tablet body.

USP: Fashionable look
Check out on Amazon

8. HBorna

HBorna has crafted this slim, lightweight, and transparent silicone case from the best flexible material. The soft TPU material precisely fits on your iPad mini 7.9 like a glove. Since it does not add much bulk, your premium device looks elegant in your hands.

This non-bulky case is uniquely designed to allow you quick and easy access to buttons, ports, and controls on your iPad mini.

USP: Flexible material
Check out on Amazon

9. OtterBox

This slim case accentuates the precision lines of your iPad mini (5th Gen). It shows off the elegance of your device while also protecting against drops and scratches. You can also secure your Apple Pencil in the provided loop.

It’s an excellent minimalist case for your iPad that will provide reliable protection. The best part is that it comes with the OtterBox Limited Lifetime warranty. It’s made of a combination of polycarbonate, specialized rubber, and nylon for ultimate durability.

USP: Superior durability
Check out on Amazon

10. MoKo

Check out this soft TPU cover case that’s durable, lightweight, and protective. The transparent and waterproof design guards your precious tablet entirely while ensuring a stylish look. It’s got a unique ruffled back design that greatly fortifies the back and sides of your device.

Further, the raised edges at the four corners provide extra protection for tablet screen glass and camera. There are also precise cutouts for all ports, buttons, and the speaker to allow full access to all the features and controls without removing the cover.

USP: Side and back protection
Check out on Amazon

That’s all friends!

Summing up…

A transparent case turns yellow over a period. However, if you choose a high-quality clear case for your iPad mini, the cover remains lustrous for a long time.

Which iPad mini 5 clear case would you like to buy? Share your feedback in comment section.

title.rendered: Best USB-C to Lightning adapters in 2026

content.rendered:
Apple’s shift to USB-C ports in its MacBook Pro, iPad Pro, and now iPad Air is a great choice. However, it has made connecting the Lightning-supported devices like the iPhones and accessories a bit difficult. Users now have to rely on adapters for charging, data transfer, or connecting the Lightning headphones. If you face a similar issue, don’t worry, we’ve rounded up some of the best USB-C to lightning adapters that work flawlessly.

Table of Contents
  • What are the best UBC-C to Lightning adapters for 2026?
    • 1. Anker
    • 2. Ringke
    • 3. UGREEN

What are the best UBC-C to Lightning adapters for 2026?

Go through my review of each product, weigh the pros and cons, and take your pick! I am sure one of these adapters will surely meet your needs.

1. Anker

The MFi-certified adapter flawlessly connects lightning headphones with any USB-C device. With full digital 48KHz/24-bit transmission, you will get lossless audio, whether listening to music, podcasts, or audio novels.

The adapter maintains the full functionality of the mic and remote. Furthermore, it promises 12x more durability, thanks to high-quality materials employed in construction. Notably, it will not support charging or data transfer.

Pros

  • MFi certified 
  • Durable 
  • Lossless Audio 

Cons

  • Compatibility issues with Windows 8 or earlier 
  • No charging support

Check out on Amazon

2. Ringke

Don’t have a USB-C to lightning cable to fast charge your iPhone, Ringke can help. The sleek and small adapter is a convenient solution for all your fast charging and data transfer needs.

Whether a USB-C device like MacBook Pro or an adapter, you won’t need additional software or drivers to connect your iPhone with them. However, the converter does not support audio, so you won’t be able to use Lightning earphones.

Pros

  • Supports charging and data transfer 
  • Uttermost compatible 
  • Sturdy 

Cons

  • No support for audio or video 

Check out on Amazon

3. UGREEN

The USB-C to the Lightning audio adapter is MFI certified and ensures 100% compatibility with your iOS device. Also, you can ensure having distortion-free audio with this connecting adapter. The simple plug and play solution ensures that your listening experience is not hampered at all. While you can connect any lightning earphones, the adapter does not support charging and syncing.

Pros

  • MFi approved
  • Highly Durable
  • Distortion-free audio
  • Great compatibility

Cons

  • Doesn’t support charging  
  • No data syncing 

Check out on Amazon

That’s all for now, guys! 

There are many benefits of USB-C, including faster charging and data transfer. However, it would take some time to move all our devices to this protocol.

Looking into Apple’s reluctance to switch iPhone’s charging port, USB-C to Lightning adapters are here to stay. And they are indeed a wise investment for every multi-device user.

Read More: 

  • 8 Ways to fix Liquid detected in Lightning connector error on iPhone
  • Best USB-C to Lightning Cables
  • Thunderbolt vs. USB-C: What’s the difference?

title.rendered: Best 15-inch MacBook Pro Cases You Can Buy

content.rendered:
I pick up the form-fitting case to ensure my MacBook has the needed care. Important qualities like the latest design, top quality material, and durability are the major parameters I weigh covers before choosing them. Though the low-profile cases are always on my hit list, I’m also very fond of those appealing to the eyes. Besides, I also like to choose elegantly patterned covers to make the notebook look pleasing to the eyes. Having browsed through numerous options, I have selected some of the best 15-inch MacBook Pro cases that you would love to check out.

Table of Contents
  • 1. Woolnut
  • 2. Incipio Feather
  • 3. Harber London
  • 4. MOSISO
  • 5. ProCase
  • 6. Kuzy

1. Woolnut

For superior durability, Woolnut has used full-grain vegetable-tanned leather; the interior is 100% wool felt, which gives long life to your premium device. Finest leather and wool impart a luxurious look to this case, which not only protects your device but also enhances its overall appearance.

Available in black and cognac brown, this sleeve is perfectly imperfect. Since Woolnut has used full-grain vegetable-tanned leather, you will find subtle variations in color or veining. Designed in Sweden, this sleeve is a durable partner for your MacBook Pro 15″.

USP: 100% wool felt
Check out on Amazon

2. Incipio Feather

With just 1mm thickness, Incipio Feather is one of the thinnest cases for 15-inch MacBook Pro. Crafted with high-quality polymer material, the case is very durable. The soft-touch matte finish not just augments the look but also provides an enhanced grip.

The slim case fits snuggly on the laptop. It has the strength to shield your MBP against scratch. That’s not all; this ultra-svelte case comes in five charming color options.

USP: Soft-touch matte finish
Check out on Amazon

3. Harber London

Harber London offers a wide range of Sleeves and Cases for the 15-inch MacBook Pro and I can’t choose between what to choose ant whatnot. So I am just going to out the whole collection on this list.

All the cases and sleeves by this brand sport super slim designs that keep the bulk to a minimum. The products are made of premium full-grain vegetable-tanned leather so that it ages gracefully. The sleeves and cases also have 100% wool felt accents to give them exclusivity. This collection of sleeves range between $72 to $158, giving you a great selection of options.

USP: Best quality leather
Check out on Harberlondon

4. MOSISO

Mosiso has manufactured this case from polycarbonate material, which is flexible and durable. The robustly built case doesn’t break easily especially when you keep your MacBook Pro in your lap or any other uneven surface.

This case is equipped with four rubber feet that create a thin layer of air between your MacBook Pro and the surface. Check the two rows of slots that dissipate heat.

USP: Flexible & durable
Check out on Amazon

5. ProCase

ProCase is a reputed brand that crafts high-quality cases for iPhones and MacBook Pro. This hard case shell cover is ultra-slim and lightweight so that you can easily move your MacBook Pro wherever you go. The rubberized coating provides a smooth finish and gentle touching as it offers protection from scratches and scrapes.

You can install and remove the case quickly, and get full access to all ports and features without removing the case.

USP: Ultra-slim
Check out on Amazon

6. Kuzy

It’s the form-fitting design that charms me the most in Kuzy. Prepared with the hard plastic material, the case is highly durable. The rubberized exterior can absorb shock and keep scratch away.

Apple logo glows through the case. An anti-slip matt on the bottom ensures the notebook remains firmly placed on the surface. It’s ideally vented for smooth-sailing heat disbursement. That apart, there are 20 fascinating color variants to vie for the top spot.

USP: Form-fitting design
Check out on Amazon

That’s all folks!

Which one has arrested your eyes?

I know one of these cases is going to pair with your notebook. Which one is it? Let us know the quality you have liked in the case. I like the three primary qualities in these cases. First and foremost, they have a trendy design. The high-quality material topped by superior quality makes the covers very durable.

You shouldn’t miss out:

  • Best MacBook Stands
  • Best 10.5-inch iPad Pro Stands

title.rendered: Best strategy games for iPhone and iPad in 2026

content.rendered:
Mobile gaming has often been associated with light-hearted games that help you pass the time when you’re either commuting or procrastinating. However, in the past few years, the progress of mobile technology has created a few welcome niches in mobile gaming. And one of the genres that stand out is Strategy games!

If you are looking for something more adventurous yet educational, strategy games for iPhone have you covered! I have listed some of the best strategy games for iPhone and iPad you’ll love to play. Let’s have a look.

Table of Contents
  • 1. Raiders of the North Sea
  • 2. DomiNations
  • 3. The Elder Scrolls: Legends
  • 4. Sid Meier’s Civilization® VI
  • 5. Subterfuge
  • 6. FTL: Faster Than Light
  • 7. ROME: Total War
  • 8. Invisible, Inc.
  • 9. Fallout Shelter
  • 10. Plants vs. Zombies

1. Raiders of the North Sea

Raiders of the North Sea brings the classic elements from the physical board game into the digital world. Become a Viking raider in the Viking Age and plant raids on different communities to gather lost treasures.

The game’s objective is to raid for as many resources as possible and impress the Chieftain of your Viking clan. The more resources you have, the more Chieftain is impressed. With extra resources, you can also upgrade your crew and ship to go on more challenging raids.

The gameplay is turn-based, and the digital version animates the gameplay to a fair extent – you can see your ships glide across foreign waters as you plan to raid an unsuspecting community. You can also play the campaign mode to get a better idea of how the gameplay works. Once ready, you can play with friends online and compete for the most loot!

Price: $9.99

Download

2. DomiNations  

This is one of the best strategy games for iOS. Although it takes inspiration from a few of the greatest strategy games on different consoles, DomiNations puts its spin on it. It also has an immense amount of replayability.

The game tasks you to see through the progress of human civilization, starting from the tools in the Iron Age to the age of flying cars – the Space Age. While you oversee all of human history and progress, you also get to conduct raids and build empires of your own.

DomiNations has a few microtransactions, though. If you want to progress faster, you have to make some in-game purchases for leveling up or getting more resources. If you aren’t willing to spend money, you can still play the game without purchasing. However, your progress will be slower.

Regardless of microtransactions, this game is still an absolute joy to play. If you like your strategy games to give you decisive moments that will create a great impact in the latter stages of your campaign, DomiNations is for you!

Price: Free (In app-purchase starts from $0.99)

Download  

3. The Elder Scrolls: Legends

The Elder Scrolls franchise has been popularized over the years through numerous entries on video game consoles. With The Elder Scrolls: Legends, you get the wonderful stories of the Elder Scrolls universe, along with the elements of a strategy game.

The game changes the gameplay style taken from other similar card and strategy games. There are two lanes for battling creatures instead of one. Moreover, you can put certain effects on the lanes, changing how they operate for the rest of the match.

The game doesn’t believe in the idea of microtransactions, so you will not have to spend huge sums of money to get any sort of advantage. In fact, with a little bit of patience, you will be rewarded with cards from the higher tiers, as well as some worthwhile challenges.

If you want to play this game with friends, you can compete over tournaments and ranked challenges. These challenges change every month, so you will have to adjust your playstyle accordingly to reach and remain at the top.

If you’re a fan of the Elder Scrolls universe, you will not be disappointed, as elements from the previous games on consoles have been added to the mobile game. Additionally, there’s a campaign for you to play through as well!

Price: Free (In app-purchase starts from $1.99)

Download  

4. Sid Meier’s Civilization® VI 

Sid Meier’s Civilization games have been the cornerstone of strategy games on video game consoles for a long time. Now, this powerhouse of a strategy game is available on iOS as well.

The game has been ported over to mobile devices, but it does not leave any bells and whistles. It is the full game, as gorgeous as you can find it on a laptop or a gaming PC. With a steep learning curve and vastly deep gameplay mechanics, Civilization VI is one of the best war strategy games for iPhone and iPad.

In Civilization VI, you control the way human beings progress through time. From building empires to establishing corporate structures in a dystopian future, you can do it all. It has turn-based gameplay, and you can gather resources to build your settlement either through war or political connections.

It is a race towards becoming the most advanced community in the world. The maps on which you can play the game are also quite large, meaning that there’s a fair bit of exploring here.

If you’re already a fan of Sid Meier’s strategy games and Civilization VI on gaming consoles, this game is a must-play for your mobile device. You will have to purchase the game after playing 60 rounds, but the price is worth it.

Price: Free

Download

5. Subterfuge

A war strategy game, Subterfuge takes command over bases and submarines as you try to manage your resources to survive the war.

The game changes the mechanics of war strategy games. Instead of matches that last for a single play session, the matches in Subterfuge are drawn out far longer.

When you issue a command over your base or submarines, the instructions will be carried out over hours in real-time. Basically, as a player, you have to think a few steps ahead of your opponents and track how long it takes for the game to carry out your orders.

As a strategy game, the mechanics are quite complex. You will have to invest a fair amount of time in understanding how the game works and what your playstyle or method of diplomacy in the game could be. Some modifiers can add to your war force. However, the boosts they provide to your bases or submarines are temporary.

Price: Free (In app-purchase starts from $0.99)

Download  

6. FTL: Faster Than Light

When Faster Than Light was released on PC in 2012, it took the gaming community by storm. Its addictive gameplay was combined with a rewarding challenge-based progression system that fans adored.

With its release for Apple devices, you can now enjoy this award-winning game at your fingertips. You’re tasked with running your spaceship as you try to save the galaxy. You also have to manage your crew and battle with hostile forces along the way.

The game has eight sectors. It has a procedurally generated system. This means that the game adapts to your actions and generates levels and events in the game based on your actions. Hence, the game’s events won’t be the same for most players.

A playthrough of the game will end if you lose your crew members or your ship is destroyed. In such a scenario, you have to start the game once again. Faster Than Light also includes a good amount of combat and diplomacy.

Price: $9.99

Download

7. ROME: Total War

Rome: Total War was initially released to the PC and received rave reviews for its strategy-based gameplay and storyline. Now, it’s been ported to mobile devices to enjoy the famous series at your fingertips.

The game also brings in the various expansion packs available on the PC game. Rome: Total War gives you the task of commanding one of the greatest armies in history. Guide the Roman army towards victory as you craft an empire from the spoils of war.

Fans of the game’s PC version will understand the need for tactical expertise as you micro-manage every aspect of your army. From the resources required to operate the entire army to the build of each army unit, you will have to supervise these areas both before the start and during the battle.

There are also a few campaigns you can play. During those, you will have to manage the economic and civil aspects of your empire. These points are crucial as they will help strengthen your empire and army. As you keep facing tougher opponents, you will have to upgrade your army as well.

Price: $9.99

Download

8. Invisible, Inc.

Invisible, Inc. is a perfect example of incorporating a unique idea onto a standard strategy game to create something new. Its take on a dystopian future is something rarely seen in mobile games.

The game takes the setting of a dystopian future where mega-corporations are ruling the world. These corporations use a database monitoring people working and living under them.

You, as a player, are put in the shoes of a group of spies and specialists whose objectives are to loot as many resources as possible and ultimately live off the grid. In your bid to escape from the prying eyes of these corporations, you must direct the agents as they try to pull off unbelievable heists. Every successful heist can damage corporations.

Invisible, Inc. also provides different agents to control, and each agent specializes in certain tasks. You can customize the agents to your liking, leading to very different playing styles. You have to make each decision carefully, as any wrong decision could cost an agent’s life.

Price: $4.99

Download

9. Fallout Shelter

The Fallout series has been a classic RPG and strategy series for over 20 years. With Fallout Shelter, a different take on the universe of Fallout comes to iPhone and iPad.

Anyone familiar with Fallout’s story will know that Vaults are important bunkers that form a crucial part of Fallout. A few chosen people are allowed to live in Vaults in case of an apocalyptic scenario. They are chosen based on how much they could help in rebuilding society after a catastrophic event.

In Fallout Shelter, the game’s objective is to manage every aspect of a Vault. In Fallout’s post-apocalyptic scenario, you have to ensure that each Vault resident is safe and well looked after.

While you take care of the residents, you also have to ensure that the Vault is safe from intruders and other such threats. To manage resources, you also have to send out a few residents to loot for both consumables and weapons.

While this game seems to cater to fans, if you’re a newcomer to this series, it is equal parts challenging and rewarding. The gameplay will keep you interested, and its events will tickle your brain cells.

Price: Free (In app-purchase starts from $0.99)

Download

10. Plants vs. Zombies

Plants vs. Zombies has been a classic game for mobile devices for quite some time now. Even after 13 years since the first release of the game, it continues to remain relevant worldwide.

The gameplay is relatively simple. You will have to grow plants outside your in-game home to save yourself from the zombies trying to eat you. The plants come in different varieties and with different weapons that can be used to destroy the zombies.

You will have to manage your resources and plant your different weapons in strategic places to deal with the horde of zombies. The zombies also come in specific types that can counter your plant-based weapons. You will have to think on your feet and act fast to keep them at a safe distance.

title.rendered: How to use mental health features on iPhone

content.rendered:
Whether it’s the ability to track medication intake or sleep patterns, health-related features have been a vital part of every major iOS update since the introduction of the Apple Watch and Health app. With iOS 17 or later, iPhone users can track their mental health in the Health app.

If you’re someone who likes to keep track of every aspect of your mind and body, it’s natural to be excited about this new mental health feature in the Health app. So, here’s everything that you need to know about Mental Wellbeing and how you can use it to log your mood or emotions on your iPhone.

Table of Contents
  • What is Apple's Mental Wellbeing feature?
  • How to log your mood or emotion in the Health app on your iPhone
  • How to take a depression or anxiety assessment in the Health app
  • How to view your mental health data on iPhone

What is Apple’s Mental Wellbeing feature?

Mental Wellbeing in the Health app allows you to efficiently track your mental health-related metrics. You can use this feature to assess your risk of experiencing symptoms related to anxiety or depression and log how you’re feeling each day to see how your mood changes over time. You can also discover how various factors like exercise, sleeping patterns, and time in daylight affect your mood.

Apple has also integrated the ability to log your emotions and daily moods into watchOS with a dedicated Mindfulness app. With this app, you can turn the Digital Crown to scroll through shapes and log how you’re feeling.

Even though this feature is not intended to replace the advice of a medical professional, it still offers a great way to take care of your mental health. It is user-friendly and enables you to monitor your mood and recognize mood patterns to observe changes over time. Moreover, If you’re feeling down, you can conveniently find mental health resources in the Health app.

As you’ve read earlier, this mental wellbeing metric, ‘State of Mind,’ allows you to log your mood or overall emotional state into the health app. Here’s how to use this feature on your iPhone or other Apple devices.

How to log your mood or emotion in the Health app on your iPhone

  1. Open the Health app on your iPhone → Navigate to the Browse tab.
  2. Go to Mental Wellbeing → State of Mind → Get Started.
    After the initial setup, Get Started will be replaced by a Log button.


    ‍ 
  3. Select if you want to log your emotion or mood → Tap Next.
  4. Use the slider to log how you’re feeling → Tap Next.
  5. Select words that best describe what you’re feeling → Tap Next.
  6. Select what’s making you feel these emotions → Tap Done.


    ‍ 
  7. Tap Turn on Reminders to receive reminders twice a day.
  8. Or tap Edit Schedule → Add Reminder to select a different time.

How to take a depression or anxiety assessment in the Health app

In addition to tracking your mood or emotional state, the Health app also offers the ability to let you conduct quick assessments to evaluate your risk of experiencing symptoms related to anxiety and depression on a scale of six. Here’s how to take these assessments and share the results if required.

  1. Open the Health app → Navigate to the Browse tab → Tap Mental Wellbeing.
  2. Select Depression Risk or Anxiety Risk.
  3. Tap Take Questionnaire → Begin.


    ‍ 
  4. Answer the questions honestly → Tap Done.
  5. Tap Export PDF to save the result on your iPhone or share it.
  6. Tap Done after you complete the whole procedure.

How to view your mental health data on iPhone

Once you regularly start logging your mental health-related metrics in the Health app, you can access various insights derived from the data to help you understand what factors have an influence over your overall mental health. Here’s how you can access these helpful insights on your iPhone:

  1. Open the Health app → navigate to the Browse tab.
  2. Tap Mental Wellbeing. You will find all the logged insights on the page for Mental Wellbeing.
  3. Tap the card for State of Mind → Show in Charts to find details about your mood and emotional health.


    ‍ 
  4. Go back and tap the other cards related to Depression Risk, Mindful Minutes, or any other metrics to discover useful details about them.

Pro tip: If needed, you can pin these metrics to the Summary tab. Just scroll down to the end of the page and tap Add to Pinned.

Wrapping up…

All in all, the Mental Wellbeing feature in the Health app can be a very useful tool for individuals who seek to improve their mental health. And thanks to this in-depth guide, you should be able to use this feature on your iPhone with ease. However, if you have any queries or concerns, please feel free to drop them in the comments section below.

Read more:

  • Best Apple Watch health features to upgrade your wellbeing
  • How to sync your Health data to iCloud
  • How to use your iPhone to lead a healthy lifestyle

mainEntity.name: Do App Clips work offline?

acceptedAnswer.text: App Clips require internet connectivity and won't work offline. Since they're only a part of the app, they need to connect to the app database to fetch the complete information and function properly.

mainEntity.name: What is the size of an App Clip?

acceptedAnswer.text: An App Clip is generally between 10MB and 15MB in size. Earlier, the restriction was to keep App Clips under 10MB, but with the introduction of better technology and internet connectivity, App Clips in iOS 16 or later can be up to 15MB large.

mainEntity.name: Do I need to download the full app to use the App Clip?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, you don't need to download the full app. In fact, App Clips work as a teaser for the full app, providing you access to a specific feature to showcase the app's capabilities. If you like the App Clip's functionality, you can download the full app from the App Store.

mainEntity.name: How often should I clear the Facebook cache on my iPhone or iPad?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you actively use Facebook daily, the cache files can quickly pile up. So, you must delete them once every 1-2 weeks. For moderate users, clearing the cache once every month is sufficient.

mainEntity.name: Does clearing the cache delete any of my Facebook data?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not at all. Deleting the Facebook app cache does not affect your information. You will still stay logged into Facebook, and your friends list, shared photos, chats, and other activities will remain as they were.
