title.rendered: Best iPhone 15 Pro folio cases in 2026

content.rendered:
If you want a handy way to carry your cards and cash with your iPhone 15 Pro, you need a folio case. The covers have card holders and protect your iPhone from annoying scratches and accidental drops like any other case. Here, I will list the best iPhone 15 Pro folio cases and covers. So, let’s get started!

Table of Contents
  1. Case-Mate pebbled leather case – Editor's choice
  2. SHIELDON full protection case for iPhone 15 Pro
  3. Belemay case wallet – Soft and flexible
  4. TUCCH leather folio case for iPhone 15 Pro
  5. TORRO kickstand case with card slots – Handcrafted elegance

1. Case-Mate pebbled leather case – Editor’s choice

The Case-Mate pebbled leather case takes wallet folio functionality to the next level for your iPhone 15 Pro. So, bid farewell to your conventional wallet as this case allows you to store up to 3 credit cards, your ID card, and some cash neatly organized in separate pockets.

Beyond its storage prowess, this case features RFID shielding technology to protect against identity theft. Besides, its versatile landscape stand is perfect for your movie sessions. Wrapped in premium pebbled genuine leather, the exterior of this case is aesthetically pleasing and exceptionally durable.

A soft and textured feel enhances daily use. Plus, you can wirelessly charge your iPhone 15 Pro with built-in magnets thanks to the MagSafe case. However, remove any magnetic strip cards before charging. The iPhone’s style and protection remain timeless with a lifetime warranty.

Pros

  • Features 360-degree protection
  • 12-foot drop protection
  • Made of superior pebbled genuine leather

Cons

  • On a pricer side

Check out on Amazon

2. SHIELDON full protection case for iPhone 15 Pro

The SHIELDON full protection case stands out in the crowd when safeguarding your iPhone 15 Pro. This folio wallet case offers a sleek, scratch-resistant exterior and soft interior shell with shockproof edges. It’s tailored to fit your iPhone 15 Pro like a glove, with added protection for the camera lens.

Moreover, the RFID-blocking technology integrated into the card slots keeps your personal information safe from prying eyes. Also, its magnetic cover ensures that your valuables stay securely in place, while the built-in folding stand lets you enjoy your content in landscape mode.

Remember, the more cards you load into it, the weaker the magnetic closure becomes, so keep it sleek and secure. Lastly, it gives you easy access to all ports and functions with precise cutouts. Additionally, with a lifetime replacement warranty, you can trust that your investment is protected for the long haul.

Pros

  • Comes in a variety of colors
  • Have shock-absorbing edge bumpers
  • It can be used as a kickstand

Cons

  • May add bulk to your device
  • No wireless charging support

Check out on Amazon

3. Belemay case wallet – Soft and flexible

The Belemay Case Wallet puts your iPhone’s safety first, alongside its good looks and security features. Inside, it’s got a shockproof TPU shell covering all the corners, with raised edges around the cameras and front screen. Besides, the three card holders and a bill compartment give you room for daily essentials.

Slim leather wallet case fits nicely in your pocket, backpack, or purse. In addition, the suede microfiber lining offers exceptional drop protection. Even if your phone drops, it will remain safe. You can access buttons and ports easily while it snugly fits your phone.

Made by skilled leather craftsmen using premium Italian leather, this folio case has a classy, minimalist design that oozes sophistication. It’s also treated with oil wax technology to avoid scratches, water, stains, smudges, and daily wear. So, it gracefully ages while keeping its original shape.

Pros

  • Waterproof, anti-stain, and wear-resistant
  • Soft TPU interior for durable protection
  • Two card slots and a cash pocket for convenience

Cons

  • No wireless charging support

Check out on Amazon

4. TUCCH leather folio case for iPhone 15 Pro

TUCCH wallet case is one of the fashionable iPhone 15 Pro folio covers. With its integrated RFID-blocking technology, this case safeguards your device and personal information from potential attackers. Additionally, the snug fit guarantees maximum security and quick access to ports and buttons.

Besides, the TPU inner shell has 3D pattern textures and cushion bumpers. So, your iPhone can withstand drops and shocks. Moreover, it replaces needing a separate wallet with three card slots and a money pocket. Whether on FaceTime with pals or watching a movie, you can use it as a kickstand.

Pros

  • Good heat dissipation
  • Soft microfiber lining to protect your phone’s screen and back
  • Available in a variety of stylish colors

Cons

  • Not compatible with MagSafe chargers

Check out on Amazon

5. TORRO kickstand case with card slots – Handcrafted elegance

TORRO kickstand case isn’t your average iPhone 15 Pro case. As it was designed mainly for your phone, it fits perfectly and won’t obstruct the screen, camera, or charging port. Additionally, it is made from top-grain cowhide leather, which undergoes minimal treatment to show off its natural shine.

Your iPhone gets solid protection with this case. It has an internal TPE layer, geometric air pockets, and elastomer for top-notch shock absorption. There’s also a raised edge that looks stylish and safeguards your camera lens.

What makes this case stand out is its practicality. It comes with three card slots and a roomy compartment for your cash. Plus, it has a built-in stand for easy horizontal screen viewing. And don’t forget the microfiber lining that keeps your iPhone snug and safe.

Pros

  • Premium leather construction
  • Durable outer shell to protect from drops and impacts
  • Various color options

Cons

  • Leather can be susceptible to wear and tear over time

Check out on Amazon

That wraps it up for today!

If you’ve got a bunch of cards, ID, and cash to lug around with your iPhone, folio cases are your go-to. Not only do they keep your stuff organized, but they also shield your screen from bumps and bruises. However, if you’re not feeling the whole iPhone 15 Pro folio case vibe, check out some other case choices below.

Editorial Note: When you purchase through our links, we earn a small commission. However, this does not affect our opinions or evaluations. Learn more about our Editorial Process and Disclaimer.

acceptedAnswer.text: If you actively use Facebook daily, the cache files can quickly pile up. So, you must delete them once every 1-2 weeks. For moderate users, clearing the cache once every month is sufficient.

@graph.name: Case-Mate pebbled leather case

@graph.name: SHIELDON full protection case for iPhone 15 Pro
@graph.description: The SHIELDON full protection case stands out in the crowd when safeguarding your iPhone 15 Pro. This folio wallet case offers a sleek, scratch-resistant exterior and soft interior shell with shockproof edges. It’s tailored to fit your iPhone 15 Pro like a glove, with added protection for the camera lens. Moreover, the RFID-blocking technology integrated into the card slots keeps your personal information safe from prying eyes. Also, its magnetic cover ensures that your valuables stay securely in place, while the built-in folding stand lets you enjoy your content in landscape mode. Remember, the more cards you load into it, the weaker the magnetic closure becomes, so keep it sleek and secure. Lastly, it gives you easy access to all ports and functions with precise cutouts. Additionally, with a lifetime replacement warranty, you can trust that your investment is protected for the long haul.

Made by skilled leather craftsmen using premium Italian leather, this folio case has a classy, minimalist design that oozes sophistication. It’s also treated with oil wax technology to avoid scratches, water, stains, smudges, and daily wear. So, it gracefully ages while keeping its original shape.

What makes this case stand out is its practicality. It comes with three card slots and a roomy compartment for your cash. Plus, it has a built-in stand for easy horizontal screen viewing. And don’t forget the microfiber lining that keeps your iPhone snug and safe.

title.rendered: How to Use Shared With You on iPhone and iPad

content.rendered:
Key Takeaways:

  • Shared with You collects iMessage content into apps like Safari, Photos, and Music so you can revisit shared items without digging through texts.
  • It works automatically in iOS 15 and later—shared links, songs, and images show up in their respective apps with sender labels.
  • You can turn it off per app or contact via Settings > Messages > Shared with You for more control over what gets shown.
  • Delete individual shared items in Safari or Messages to tidy up without disabling the entire feature.
  • To disable Shared with You entirely, go to Settings > Messages and toggle off the feature under Shared with You.

Thanks to dozens of instant messaging apps, sharing contacts, links, music, etc., has become easier. But, when the time finally comes to open the item shared with you, everything seems lost. Either the link would’ve gone up in the chat, or you’d be too lazy to search for it. Fortunately, there is a dedicated section where all the shared items are stored! Enters the Shared with You feature on your iPhone. In this article, we will learn about what is Apple’s “Shared with You” feature on your iPhone and how you can access this section and use it to improve your experience.

Table of Contents
  • What is Shared with You?
  • How to Use Shared With You on iPhone
  • How to Turn Off Shared With You on iPhone
    • 1. Disable "Shared With You" for a Specific App
    • 2. Turn Off “Shared With You” for Specific Contacts
    • 3. Disable "Shared With You" Completely
  • How to Remove ‘Shared With You’ Links in Safari on iPhone
  • How to Remove ‘Shared With You’ Links in Messages on iPhone

What is Shared with You?

Apple provided a Shared with You feature in the Messages app with iOS 15. It segregates the content that people send into different sections. For example, all the websites shared with you are in the Links section, images in the Photos section, etc.

And it doesn’t stop here—Shared with You also adds the items shared to the proper apps. This means that if someone shares a link on Messages, it will be not only in the Messages’ Links section but also in Safari.

Similarly, if someone shares a photo, it will appear in Messages as a separate section and also in the Photos app.

How to Use Shared With You on iPhone

Shared with You is enabled by default on your iPhone, so it doesn’t require any setup or toggling to work. However, it is only compatible with the media shared in iMessage.

There are several Shared with You integrations across the iOS apps, some of which are mentioned below:

  • Photos: When someone sends you an image via iMessage, it will automatically show up in the For You tab of the Photos app. You can save it to your Photo library directly from this section.

    Moreover, if you tap the name label at the bottom, the image in iMessage with the in-reply thread open will appear.
  • Apple News: If anyone sends you an Apple News story via iMessage, it automatically appears in the Today and Following tabs.
  • Safari: Many times, friends share links to articles and news pieces that may be useful to us. Now, you’ll no longer need to search your iMessage chat and find the link. Instead, all the links shared with you will show in a separate section in Safari.
  • Apple Music and Podcast: Music and podcast links shared via iMessage show up in the Shared with You section in the Listen Now tab in the Apple Music and Podcast app.
  • Apple TV: When someone sends a movie or a TV show link via iMessage, the TV show or the movie will appear in the Shared with You section of the Watch Now tab so you can start watching it quickly.

Besides, you can access the Shared with You section in Books, Files, Notes, and Reminders among native iOS apps.

Apart from Shared with You, you can use SharePlay to watch movies and TV shows together on your iPhone. To learn more, check out our detailed guide on how to use SharePlay.

How to Turn Off Shared With You on iPhone

While “Shared with You” integration in other apps is great, there may come a point when you start finding it more annoying than useful. Keeping that in mind, Apple gives you complete control over the feature; you can either disable it altogether or turn it off for a specific app.

1. Disable “Shared With You” for a Specific App

While the “Shared with You” functionality may annoy you when using certain apps, you may actually find it useful in some. If so, you can turn off the “Shared with You” functionality for specific apps instead of turning it off altogether.

  1. In the Messages settings, tap on Shared with You.
  2. Here, turn off the toggle next to Apps in which you want to disable the Shared with You functionality.

Alternatively, if you just want to prevent a specific conversation from appearing in Shared with You, you can simply hide it.

2. Turn Off “Shared With You” for Specific Contacts

Looking for a way to turn off ‘Shared with You’ for specific contacts or iMessage group chats? Well, you can do that too from the Messages app. Here are the steps explaining how to do it:

  1. Locate and open the Messages app on your iPhone or iPad.
  2. Open a Messages thread → Then, tap the name at the top.
  3. Toggle off Show in Shared with You → Then tap Done.

3. Disable “Shared With You” Completely

Besides Safari, many other native and third-party apps on your iPhone and iPad also support ‘Shared with You.’ If you want to turn the feature off only for specific apps, follow these steps:

  1. Open the Settings app, scroll down and tap on Apps.
  2. Here, locate and tap on Messages settings.
  3. Next, tap the Shared with You tab and toggle off Automatic Sharing on the subsequent menu.

How to Remove ‘Shared With You’ Links in Safari on iPhone

What if you want to get rid of links that you don’t like but keep using the feature? In that case, you can easily delete certain unwanted links in Safari instead of turning off ‘Shared with You’ entirely.

  1. Locate and open Safari on your iPhone or iPad.
  2. Tap the tab view icon → Then, tap the Plus icon.
    This will open the Safari start page on your device.
  3. Tap and hold a shared link that you wish to delete.
  4. Finally, tap on Remove Link to delete the shared link.

How to Remove ‘Shared With You’ Links in Messages on iPhone

If you, for some reason, aren’t able to delete ‘Shared with You’ links from the Safari start page, you can delete them from the Messages app on your iPhone. This essentially does the same thing from the Messages app instead of Safari. Here are the steps explaining how to do it:

  1. Locate and open the Messages app on your iPhone or iPad.
  2. Open a Messages thread → Then, tap the name at the top.
  3. Now, tap and hold a shared link that you wish to delete.
  4. Finally, tap Delete to remove the link shared with you.

Shared with You is an excellent feature on iPhone and iPad. It lowers the number of steps required to search for a shared item. However, it is limited by the iMessage-only functionality. Had Apple opened up its API to third-party developers, it would have been one of the best iOS features.

What are your thoughts about Shared with You? Share in the comments below!

  • How to use Notification Summary on iPhone

acceptedAnswer.text: App Clips require internet connectivity and won't work offline. Since they're only a part of the app, they need to connect to the app database to fetch the complete information and function properly.

mainEntity.name: What is the size of an App Clip?

acceptedAnswer.text: An App Clip is generally between 10MB and 15MB in size. Earlier, the restriction was to keep App Clips under 10MB, but with the introduction of better technology and internet connectivity, App Clips in iOS 16 or later can be up to 15MB large.

mainEntity.name: How often should I clear the Facebook cache on my iPhone or iPad?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you actively use Facebook daily, the cache files can quickly pile up. So, you must delete them once every 1-2 weeks. For moderate users, clearing the cache once every month is sufficient.

mainEntity.name: Does clearing the cache delete any of my Facebook data?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not at all. Deleting the Facebook app cache does not affect your information. You will still stay logged into Facebook, and your friends list, shared photos, chats, and other activities will remain as they were.

keyPoints.title: Shared with You Overview
keyPoints.explanation: This feature, introduced with iOS 15, organizes shared content like links and photos into dedicated sections across various apps, making it easier to access shared items.

keyPoints.title: Using Shared with You Effectively
keyPoints.explanation: Shared with You works automatically with iMessage to transfer shared content such as photos, links, and media to relevant app sections, enhancing your sharing experience.

keyPoints.title: Disabling Shared with You per App or Contact
keyPoints.explanation: You can turn off Shared with You for specific apps or contacts through Settings and Messages, giving you control over what data appears in your apps.

keyPoints.title: Removing Unwanted Shared Links
keyPoints.explanation: Unwanted links can be deleted in Safari or Messages to keep your Shared with You sections clean without disabling the feature entirely.

keyPoints.title: Turning Off Shared with You Completely
keyPoints.explanation: If you prefer to disable the feature across all apps, you can do so via Settings under Messages, stopping any automatic sharing through Shared with You.

title.rendered: Best VR Games for iPhone in 2026

content.rendered:
Virtual reality games are unbelievably addictive. With immersive 3D experience and spectacular graphics, they take you into a make-believe world where everything looks exceptional. Though I am not a hardcore gamer, I love to indulge in beautiful games with a great concept. Having played many exciting games, I thought of taking my love for gaming to an altogether new level. Based on the thrill and unmatched concept, these VR Games for iPhone have become my hot favorite.

Table of Contents
  • 1. InCell VR
  • 2. VR XRacer
  • 3. Fractal Combat X (FCX)
  • 4. Final Kick VR

1. InCell VR

Enjoy playing action/racing games? InCell VR can be a typical potboiler for you as it’s got everything you would want to infuse plenty of fun into your gaming! You have to give your best to prevent the world from being eliminated. Enter the micro world, explore the human cell and bring all your experience and excellence to fight out the challenge of virus wave.

Though the game is designed for VR, you can play it even without a headset. Moreover, InCell is compatible with View-Master, Fibrum, Homido, Lakento, Archos, Durovis and much other Cardboard like headsets.

Price: Free
Download

2. VR XRacer

Get ready for some fast-paced action as VR XRacer is fully readied to ramp up your adrenaline! You have to lead your team to safeguard the earth from the UFO spaceship attacks. Make the best use of destructive missiles and lethal weapons to destroy the enemies.

As the airway is extremely dangerous, you need to on the money at all times to not just avoid getting killed but also fight out the powerful enemies. There are two modes: virtual reality and hand modes. Awesome 3D visual effects and graphics ensure you never get tired of playing.

Price: Free
Download

3. Fractal Combat X (FCX)

Are you up for a scintillating fight combat game? Fractal Combat X can be an absolute entertainer for you! Enriched by the awe-inspiring 3D graphics, incredible fractal landscapes, this VR game is pure class. There are tons of missions in the story mode to keep you hooked for long.

The fascinating soundtrack brings the real spice into the play. As new missions are added regularly, you always have something really cool to go for!

Price: Free
Download

4. Final Kick VR

Do you really love the tense moments of penalty shots? “Final Kick VR” has to be your top-notch choice as a big football fan.

Play against the best teams in the world. Perfect your defining shots and crush your opponents with your excellent skill and then become the world champion. This VR game will provide you an excellent experience of your football fantasy.

Price: Free
Download

That’s all for now!

What’s your favorite?

Enjoyed taking a peek at these games? I hope you have already grabbed some of them for your fun time, haven’t you? Do let us know your picks?

  • Tower Defense Games for iPhone and iPad
  • Best Card Games for iPhone and iPad

title.rendered: Best waterproof cases for iPhone 11 Pro in 2026

content.rendered:
The iPhone 11 Pro is water-resistant with a rating of IP68. So it can withstand a maximum depth of 4 meters up to 30 minutes. But you still need the best iPhone 11 Pro waterproof cases offering complete protection for a longer duration underwater. They’re a must-have for all kinds of water activities or protection against the elements. Take your pick from the below list of best waterproof cases for iPhone 11 Pro.

Table of Content
  • 1. Ecofine waterproof case – Military-grade protection
  • 2. Vapesoon waterproof case – Best overall
  • 3. Temdan waterproof case – Wireless charging support
  • 4. Fugosell IP68 waterproof case – Best for deep diving
  • 5. LifeProof FRĒ SERIES – Best for underwater photography
  • 6. Dooge waterproof case – Crystal clear protection

1. Ecofine waterproof case – Military-grade protection

With IP68 standard waterproof certificate, the Ecofine case is designed to enable you to click great underwater pictures. It is tested under 6.6 ft deep for 30 minutes and ensures perfect protection while you are underwater swimming or trying to operate your phone in the shower.

The case sandwiches your device and secures all the ports in order to keep all the water away from entering your device. Although it secures your phone from all possible sides, the sensors and faceID would still function precisely. All the controls on your device are covered with an anti-slip TPU frame to avoid any hassle.

USP: Wireless charging compatible

Check out on Amazon

2. Vapesoon waterproof case – Best overall

The waterproof case by Vapesoon is multifunctional as it protects your iPhone 11 Pro from water but without taking away the feel of your iPhone. Its front and back clear cover lets you show off your expensive buy even underwater. Not to forget this case also supports wireless charging, so while it is not protecting your iPhone 11 Pro underwater, it provides all the required supplements to it.

The case is made of high-grade shock-absorbing TPU and PC materials that are shockproof and drop-proof. It has withstood 6.6 ft high drop during its testing period so you can rest assured that it will protect your iPhone in all sorts of harsh environments underwater or on the ground.

USP: Crystal clear

Check out on Amazon

3. Temdan waterproof case – Wireless charging support

A perfect solution for all the diving junkies out there. If you love diving and wish to capture beautiful underwater images then you would love to get the best out of this Temdan waterproof case. It comes with a solid IP68 certificate and fully seals your device for minimum water contact.

A must-have accessory for any underwater activities or for daily use, this case is very much an all-rounder. Coming to the specks of this case; it comes with full-body protection that is designed to exceed military standards (810G-516). Therefore, it could safeguard your iPhone 11 Pro even after 1000 drops from a height of 6.6ft height.

USP: Exceeds military standards

Check out on Amazon

4. Fugosell IP68 waterproof case – Best for deep diving

Don’t miss your music even when you are underwater, the Fugosell case ensures that your music and your phone is accessible to you under all circumstances. This iPhone 11 Pro waterproof case comes with a built-in screen protector that provides anti-scratch assurance along with amicable clarity of the display, without affecting the touch sensitivity.

It has cleared over 100 6.6ft. high drop tests and has also surpassed the Military 810F-516 standards of protection. The wrist strap that you could attach to this case is a highlight for me as it will ensure that my phone doesn’t slip from my hands. The fact that it is also shock-proof is an added bonus.

USP: Shock-proof

Check out on Amazon

5. LifeProof FRĒ SERIES – Best for underwater photography

Here’s an extremely high-quality case that is water and snowproof. It’s fully submersible to 66’/2 m for 1 hour. It also has a built-in scratch protector that is virtually invisible to the eye and incredibly touch-sensitive.

You will have access to all features of your phone and can charge and sync through the USB port. It also cushions against drops and falls, so it is an excellent choice for everyday use too. Enjoy a year-long warranty in case of any quality issues. Available in 5 colors.

USP: Slim and sleek design

Check out on Amazon

6. Dooge waterproof case – Crystal clear protection

Submerge your iPhone under 16ft. deep water for half an hour without a worry as the Dooge waterproof case is fully submersible under the depth of 9.8ft and up to 16.5ft for half-hour. This case can also withstand shock and drops from up to 6.6ft high and protects your phone from rain, dust, and scratches.

This case is made from highly-durable plastic and the best quality TPU material that surpasses the IP-69K ingress protection rating for the full functioning of your device even under 9.8ft deep water without any leakage or water damage. The case is double AR-coated optical glass lenses that provide an unprecedented crystal-clear photo and video quality for taking Photos in the Water.

USP: Can be submerged under 16.5ft deep water

Check out on Amazon

With these iPhone 11 Pro waterproof cases, you won’t have to worry about your phone dropping into your tub or sinks. Which amongst these cases caught your eyes? Let me know that in the comments below.

You might also like these posts:

  • Best iPhone 11 Pro cases

title.rendered: Best iPhone 15 clear cases in 2026

content.rendered:
The iPhone 15 comes in many vibrant colors, and it’s important to protect your investment with a good case. If you’re looking for a clear case that will show off the beauty of your new iPhone, you have come to the right place. I am here to bless you with some of the best iPhone 15 clear cases that you can add to your cart ASAP. Let’s start.

Table of Content
  1. Spigen Ultra Hybrid S – Best iPhone 15 clear case
  2. ESR Zero Clear Case – Sturdy build with bumpers on edges
  3. totallee clear glass case – Free from logos
  4. Speck Presidio Perfect – Dual-layer protection from all sides
  5. Humixx – Cost-effective iPhone 15 clear case
  6. TAURI – Anti-yellowing iPhone 15 clear case
  7. Mkeke – Raised bezels for extra safety
  8. TORRAS Magnetic – Military-grade drop protection for iPhone 15

1. Spigen Ultra Hybrid S – Best iPhone 15 clear case

Don’t want to hide the stylish design of your iPhone 15? Cool! The all-new Spigen Ultra Hybrid S is for you. A crystal-clear body designed with polycarbonate and TPU gives you every reason to flex your smartphone. In addition, the infusion of blue resin by the manufacturer ensures that the clear case for your iPhone 15 retains its clarity even after months of continuous use. Yellowness won’t bother you! 

Designed with excellent drop durability, Ultra Hybrid S is your ultimate savior from unwarranted adversities. It will save the glass back of your iPhone from getting cracked when you carelessly try to slide it inside your pockets but somehow miss it. Moreover, the raised lips on the front lobes and around the camera give elevation to your phone. Eventually, it prevents surface scratches.  

The Spigen Ultra Hybrid S case is fully compatible with wireless and MagSafe chargers. Its strong magnetic array aligns perfectly with the iPhone’s MagSafe ring to give fast charging. Apart from this, the clear case has accessibility buttons for easy functionality and a kickstand for improved visual experiences. Now, you can check our list of best iPhone 15 folio cases just to spice up your collection.

Pros

  • Blue resin gives longer clarity 
  • Excellent accessibility buttons 
  • In-built kickstand  
  • Works with MagSafe chargers 

Cons

  • Requires frequent cleaning  

Check out on Amazon   

2. ESR Zero Clear Case – Sturdy build with bumpers on edges

Anyone who uses iPhone cases can easily vouch for ESR. The brand is recognized for its top-quality covers that offer safety and style. ESR has an excellent option for clear case lovers that easily wraps around your iPhone to ensure its safety. Crafted using TPU, the ESR Zero iPhone 15 clear case features a sleek, 1.6mm thick, lightweight body that you can easily hold or carry in pockets.   

Designed to precision, the ESR Zero clear case your iPhone 15 fits like a second skin. Once clipped, your iPhone won’t get any space to sneak out. Moreover, the military-grade protection offered here gets amplified with the unique Air-Guard corners and raised edges. Where the Air-Guard corners work as cushions against high-impact drops, the elevated rim protects your display from surface scratches.    

The inbuilt TPU buttons perfectly match those on your iPhone, offering high responsiveness and better functionality. Further, ESR has created this cover to be wireless charging friendly. The ideal magnetic alignment on the ESR Zero clear case ensures that your phone stays intact on the charging plate to get instant battery fill. Also, the yellowing-resistant film keeps its clarity unchanged.

Pros

  • Sleek and lightweight build 
  • Anti-yellowing coating 
  • Air Guards for shock absorption 
  • Supports wireless charging 

Cons

  • No MagSafe support 

Check out on Amazon

3. totallee clear glass case – Free from logos

Flex the sexy design of your iPhone 15 with the totallee clear glass case. This lightweight smartphone cover ensures that your precious iPhone is safe from all the adversities likely to inflict upon it over continuous usage over time. As expected, the totallee cover comes with precise fittings that sit right at the four corners of the iPhone, promising complete protection even during rough usage.   

Made with shock-absorbing material, the crystal-clear cover keeps scratches, bruises, and ugly spots at bay. Its slim and sleek design offers an invisible protection with a surprising imprint of caseless usage. Further, totallee lets you retain the original aesthetics of the iPhone by saying NO to flashy logos. Yes, this clear iPhone 15 case from totallee follows a no-branding policy. 

Pros

  • Clear look for long 
  • Uses shock-absorbing material 
  • No logos on display 

Cons

  • No MagSafe support 

Check out on totallee

4. Speck Presidio Perfect – Dual-layer protection from all sides

Speck Presidio Perfect case is more transparent than most of our plans. Okay, jokes apart. Presidio Perfect is just the right pick if you want to show off the half-bitten Apple in your mirror selfies. Equipped with robust MagSafe support, this versatile iPhone 15 clear case gives you instant battery support on the go.

Moreover, you get dual-layer protection with this amazing case without bearing bulkiness. Indeed, it is a perfect balance of safety and design. The clear phone-cushioning rubber guarantees complete protection from all sorts of crises. From dropping your iPhone or your sibling toying with the new gadget – the Speck Presidio Perfect clear case saves you from everything.

Furthermore, the raised bezels that run across the big display and camera setup at the back let you lay your iPhone 15 flat on any surface without worrying about damage.   

Pros

  • Convenient MagSafe charging  
  • Strong, durable build 
  • Raised bezels for added safety 

Cons

  • Might be slippery 

Check out on Amazon

5. Humixx – Cost-effective iPhone 15 clear case

Humixx iPhone 15 clear case is ideal if you need uncompromised safety at a pocket-friendly price. Regarding build, the cover is a blend of hybrid hard polycarbonate and soft DE Bayer TPU materials. The power combo shields your device against scratches, dents, or bruises that might otherwise spoil the iPhone’s look. Also, this Apple clear case with MagSafe lets you enjoy quick charging anywhere and anytime.

Besides, the case offers your iPhone an impressive 14-ft military-grade drop protection. However, this becomes possible because of the rigid PC back, three-layer shock-absorbent TPU bumper with four air cushions on the corners. FYI, the brand vouches the case to disperse 99% of the impact from shocks. Plus, the 1.2mm elevated screen edges and 2.5mm raised camera bezels to protect against surface friction and scratches. 

The ergonomic square side paired with textured buttons gives a no-slip feel and a firmer grip. Your iPhone won’t slide off your hands frequently. Further, this handy cover has anti-fingerprint, antioxidant, and Nano Oleophobic coatings. Everything helps you flaunt the pretty colors of your iPhone 15 without compromising its safety. 

Pros

  • Ultra-slim and durable build  
  • Elevated rims for screen and lenses 
  • Multiple coatings 
  • Ergonomic design for strong grip 

Cons

  • Attracts fingerprints 
  • Difficult to remove bubbles 

Check out on Amazon  

6. TAURI – Anti-yellowing iPhone 15 clear case

Unravel the authentic aesthetics of your iPhone 15 clear case with a TAURI. This amazing case is designed to offer unmatched safety to your iPhone from all edges. Its superior Germany Bayer’s TPU material gives a crystal-clear finish to flex your iPhone’s stunning colors and design. The frame feels soft and provides a firm grip on your smartphone. 

The precise build ensures that the clear case envelops your iPhone completely. Its snug fit, paired with four airbags on the corners, eliminates most of the reasons that can lead to unwanted slips, drops, or bumps. Moreover, the sleek frame is lightweight to hold with one hand or carry around your pocket. Because of the nano antioxidant coating, you don’t have to worry about getting stains and sweat on your case.

TAURI clear case for iPhone 15 comes in a package deal, including two top-quality 9H tempered glasses and two camera lens protectors. The products keep your screen and camera safe from scratches without disrupting their functionality. The clear case sits perfectly on your iPhone together with the screen and camera lens protectors. Thus making it one of the best iPhone 15 clear cases.

Pros

  • Flexible and durable TPU build 
  • It doesn’t turn yellow 
  • Corner Airbags for shock absorption 

Cons

  • No support for wireless charging 

Check out on Amazon 

7. Mkeke – Raised bezels for extra safety

When it comes to clear cases, Mkeke has an excellent option to offer for iPhone 15. Locked in a sleek frame, the Mkeke transparent cover gives end-to-end protection to your iPhone while being equally stylish in design. It has precisely noticeable buttons that fit your iPhone buttons to provide seamless functionality.

Created using superior TPU material, this versatile cover gives military-grade drop protection to your iPhone. The in-built airbags on the four corners absorb the impact of the shocks from drops, bumps, and slips. In addition, the raised rim on the front and the bezels around the camera restrict your phone from touching a surface and getting scratched.   

The precise cutout for the charging port and speakers ensures a hindrance-free work experience. Moreover, the cover keeps your iPhone 15 safe from fingerprints, stains, and sweat. You also don’t have to worry about the clear case turning yellow over time. It’s perfect! 

Pros

  • Slim and lightweight body 
  • Easy to keep in pockets 
  • Smartly placed buttons 

Cons

  • Not designed for charging 

Check out on Amazon  

8. TORRAS Magnetic – Military-grade drop protection for iPhone 15

TORRAS clear case is another impressive option for users seeking the best-in-class protection and safety for their iPhone. Its slim and lightweight build fits beautifully in your hand and your pockets without feeling heavy. Moreover, with TORRAS’ advanced Transternity Tech, this case doesn’t turn yellow after continuous use.  

Regarding safety, TORRAS clear case is certified to offer 3X improved 12ft military-grade drop protection to your smartphone. This becomes possible with the X-Shock 4.0 airbags and flexible rubber bumpers on the four corners that absorb shock impacts. In addition, the 1.2mm bezels around the camera and 1.0mm raised lips over the screen keep them safe from scratches.   

On the sides, this crystal-clear iPhone 15 cover has non-slip textures that give a firm grip to your iPhone. The TPU back provides complete safety for your device without hiding the original color of your device. Further, the TORRAS-BACH Magnetic array firmly attaches to wireless or MagSafe chargers and accessories for quick battery fill.   

Pros

  • Grippy design  
  • Raised lips around the camera and display  
  • Anti-yellow and fingerprint-resistant  

Cons

  • Issues with magnet connectivity 

Check out on Amazon 

Wrapping up 

Clear cases are a perfect medium to flaunt your iPhone without compromising its safety. I have tried to cover some of the best iPhone 15 clear cases in this article for you. If you find your favorite here, do share it in the comments section.

Editorial Note: When you purchase through our links, we earn a small commission. However, this does not affect our opinions or evaluations. Learn more about our Editorial Process and Disclaimer.

mainEntity.name: Do App Clips work offline?

acceptedAnswer.text: App Clips require internet connectivity and won't work offline. Since they're only a part of the app, they need to connect to the app database to fetch the complete information and function properly.

mainEntity.name: What is the size of an App Clip?

acceptedAnswer.text: An App Clip is generally between 10MB and 15MB in size. Earlier, the restriction was to keep App Clips under 10MB, but with the introduction of better technology and internet connectivity, App Clips in iOS 16 or later can be up to 15MB large.

mainEntity.name: Do I need to download the full app to use the App Clip?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, you don't need to download the full app. In fact, App Clips work as a teaser for the full app, providing you access to a specific feature to showcase the app's capabilities. If you like the App Clip's functionality, you can download the full app from the App Store.

mainEntity.name: How often should I clear the Facebook cache on my iPhone or iPad?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you actively use Facebook daily, the cache files can quickly pile up. So, you must delete them once every 1-2 weeks. For moderate users, clearing the cache once every month is sufficient.

mainEntity.name: Does clearing the cache delete any of my Facebook data?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not at all. Deleting the Facebook app cache does not affect your information. You will still stay logged into Facebook, and your friends list, shared photos, chats, and other activities will remain as they were.

@graph.name: TAURI for iPhone 15 Case
@graph.description: Unravel the authentic aesthetics of your iPhone 15 clear case with a TAURI. This amazing case is designed to offer unmatched safety to your iPhone from all edges. Its superior Germany Bayer’s TPU material gives a crystal-clear finish to flex your iPhone’s stunning colors and design. The frame feels soft and provides a firm grip on your smartphone.

@graph.name: Speck Clear iPhone 15 Case
@graph.description: Speck Presidio Perfect case is more transparent than most of our plans. Okay, jokes apart. Presidio Perfect is just the right pick if you want to show off the half-bitten Apple in your mirror selfies. Equipped with robust MagSafe support, this versatile iPhone 15 clear case gives you instant battery support on the go

@graph.name: ESR Zero Clear Case
@graph.description: ESR has an excellent option for clear case lovers that easily wraps around your iPhone to ensure its safety. Crafted using TPU, the ESR Zero iPhone 15 clear case features a sleek, 1.6mm thick, lightweight body that you can easily hold or carry in pockets.

@graph.name: CASE-MATE MagSafe Clear Case
@graph.description: It’s a beauty! This was the first thought that popped into my mind when I saw this Pelican Protector Clear MagSafe case by CASE-MATE. Here, you get an impact-resistant outer layer paired with a shock-absorbing rubber lining that blesses your iPhone 15 with military-grade protection. Also, do you know this delicate-looking cover is strong enough to endure a 16-foot drop? Amazing, right? The MagSafe charging available with this case comes in handy for all those times when you are running late and need an instant battery boost. This becomes possible with the perfect alignment of the magnets stacked in this case. Further, CASE-MATE has added antimicrobial and anti-scratch coatings on the case for an added layer of protection to your iPhone.

@graph.name: Spigen MagSafe Crystal Clear Case
@graph.description: The Spigen Ultra Hybrid S case is fully compatible with wireless and MagSafe chargers. Its strong magnetic array aligns perfectly with the iPhone’s MagSafe ring to give fast charging. Apart from this, the clear case has accessibility buttons for easy functionality and a kickstand for improved visual experiences.

@graph.name: totallee clear glass case
@graph.description: Flex the sexy design of your iPhone 15 with the totallee clear glass case. This lightweight smartphone cover ensures that your precious iPhone is safe from all the adversities likely to inflict upon it over continuous usage over time. As expected, the totallee cover comes with precise fittings that sit right at the four corners of the iPhone, promising complete protection even during rough usage.

@graph.name: Humixx Clear Case
@graph.description: Humixx iPhone 15 clear case is ideal if you need uncompromised safety at a pocket-friendly price. Regarding build, the cover is a blend of hybrid hard polycarbonate and soft DE Bayer TPU materials. The power combo shields your device against scratches, dents, or bruises that might otherwise spoil the iPhone’s look.

@graph.name: TORRAS Magnetic Designed for iPhone 15 Case
@graph.description: TORRAS clear case is another impressive option for users seeking the best-in-class protection and safety for their iPhone. Its slim and lightweight build fits beautifully in your hand and your pockets without feeling heavy. Moreover, with TORRAS’ advanced Transternity Tech, this case doesn’t turn yellow after continuous use.

title.rendered: Best Bluetooth FM Transmitters for iPhone in 2026

content.rendered:
If you are an iPhone user, you might be familiar with online radio. You can find plenty of online radio apps in the App Store, and some are paid, and some are free. However, many iPhone users opt for FM transmitters. Whenever you feel like listening to music in the absence of the Internet, FM transmitters come in handy, especially while traveling. When you plan to travel, instead of spending money on Internet data plans or Wi-Fi, you can use FM transmitters. It is an excellent way to listen to your playlists directly from your iPhone.

Table of Contents
  • 1. LIHAN
  • 2. Nulaxy KM18
  • 3. Criacr
  • 4. GOgroove FlexSMART X3
  • 5. IMDEN

1. LIHAN

Blessed with appreciable sound quality, LIHAN is good enough to spice up your music time. The built-in microphone comes with noise suppression technology to keep background clamor away during your phone calls.

Two USB ports, it ensures you are able to charge multiple devices simultaneously. Another notable feature is the desired security it offers while powering your device. Being pretty compact, it’s easy to carry.

USP: Top-quality microphone
Check out on Amazon

2. Nulaxy KM18

Nulaxy KM18 excels as a car FM transmitter, Bluetooth receiver or car audio adapter. It quickly detects the battery voltage level and displays in on the 1.44 inches LCD. Thus, you remain posted about the battery voltage. 5V-2.1A charging port lets you safely charge your device.

Advanced interference and noise cancellation technology boost your calling experience by providing clear sound. One of the most notable qualities of KM18 is the broad compatibility. For instance, it works with the iOS device, MP3, and MP4 players, etc. Besides, KM18 is available in six color options like black, coffee, golden, green, etc.

USP: Crystal clear sound
Check out on Amazon

3. Criacr

Criacr ticks off most boxes to be your reliable FM transmitter. It offers FM radio frequency range from 87.5 to 108.0MHz. As a result, you have a more stable frequency.

The High-Fi stereo sound enriches your music. It supports multiple formats like MP3/wma/wav/flac to ensure you relish great music experience without any hiccups. Plus, the inclusion of two USB ports helps you keep your devices powered up with ease.

USP: High-Fi stereo sound
Check out on Amazon

4. GOgroove FlexSMART X3

The biggest highlight of GOgroove FlexSMART X3 is the multipoint Bluetooth connectivity. Hence, you can connect it to two devices at once to let you stream music and take calls from both the devices.

The mic is endowed with high-quality noise reduction technology. That means your calling won’t be interrupted by the clamor. With regard to charging your device, you can expect it to live up to the task effectively. Lastly, FlexSMART X3 is supported by the three-year warranty.

USP: Multipoint Bluetooth connectivity
Check out on Amazon

5. IMDEN

IMDEN Bluetooth FM transmitter has two USB ports charger support; you can charge your iPhone and iPad simultaneously while you are on a long drive. The transmitter delivers excellent performance with noise suppression (CVC) technology and gives you crystal clear call.

The multi-functional device enables you to answer, redial, dismiss or end a call with a click of a button. You can drive safely as this transmitter supports voice navigation of your iPhone. IMDEN has packed safety features to protect your device against over-current, over-voltage and short-circuit.

USP: High-performance microphone
Check out on Amazon

He dons the cap of editor-in-chief to make sure that articles match the quality standard before they are published."  About Dhvanesh Ever since teenage years, gadgets and technology have held a special place in Dhvanesh's heart. This fascination with gadgets and their inner workings fueled a lifelong passion for exploration and troubleshooting. Disassembled electronic items scattered around the house became a familiar sight during his younger years, a testament to this insatiable curiosity. From SEO Expert to Apple Evangelist After completing his IT engineering diploma, Dhvanesh's professional journey began with a 4.5-year stint as an SEO executive, honing valuable digital marketing skills. However, the desire to share tech knowledge and connect with a like-minded community proved stronger. In 2012, Dhvanesh embarked on a new adventure, founding iGeeksBlog. This blog became a haven for Apple enthusiasts and tech aficionados seeking insightful and in-depth information about everything Apple. A Decade of iGeeksBlog: Leading the Apple Charge In the past 12 years, Dhvanesh has donned multiple hats at iGeeksBlog. As the founder, he has steered the blog’s vision, ensuring it remains a trusted resource for Apple users worldwide. Additionally, he has been serving as the CEO of iGeeks Media Private Limited for the past 4 years, overseeing the company's growth and development. Beyond Writing: A Multifaceted Approach Dhvanesh isn't just a prolific writer, having penned hundreds of articles for iGeeksBlog. He has also served as the blog’s Editor-in-Chief and Content Strategist, ensuring a consistent flow of high-quality content that caters to the diverse needs of the Apple user base. The passion for exploration extends beyond the written word. He has created numerous YouTube videos for iGeeksBlog, providing visual demonstrations and engaging directly with the audience. Staying Connected with the Apple Ecosystem Dhvanesh's dedication to the Apple community goes a step further. Currently, he also manages the iGeeksBlog+ weekly newsletter, delivering curated Apple news, gadgets, apps, tips and tricks straight to subscribers' inboxes. This unwavering commitment to Apple technology and a genuine desire to empower fellow users make him a valuable asset to the iGeeksBlog team.

title.rendered: Best rugged cases for iPhone 14 Plus and 14 Pro Max in 2025

content.rendered:
If you prefer big displays and got the iPhone 14 Plus or the iPhone 14 Pro Max, it’s best to take extra care of it. However, if you frequently drop your phone and have butterfingers, a rugged case is the best option. It wouldn’t be wise to put just any rugged case on your iPhone. So I’ve prepared a list of some great rugged cases for your iPhone 14 Plus and 14 Pro Max.

Most rugged cases for iPhone 14 Plus and 14 Pro Max (Top 10 picks)

1. Spigen Rugged Armor (MagFit) case – Editor’s choice

Spigen is well-known for making durable accessories for iPhones and even other devices. That doesn’t change with this Spigen rugged case. It’s one of the best cases from Spigen.

The best part about this case is that it maintains a slim form factor and provides shock absorption capacity with an added bulk of only 34 grams. Additionally, you get raised bezels that protect both camera and the screen from coming in direct contact with surfaces.

Furthermore, the case has a good texture that provides you with a better grip to hold. It also supports MagSafe out of the box, so you don’t have to worry about MagSafe charging. Moreover, Spigen allows you to connect its range of MagSafe accessories to the case and calls it MagFit.

Pros

  • Slim profile and weightless
  • Better grip
  • MagSafe compatible

Cons

  • Available in one color

Check out on Amazon: iPhone 14 Plus | iPhone 14 Pro Max

2. Poetic Revolution case – Best all-round protection

If you’re planning to go much more rigid, the Poetic Revolution case is the right choice. It comes with 20ft military-grade protection that protects your iPhone from all angles. You get a kickstand on the back of the case and a screen protector on the front.

Its toughness comes from the combination of polycarbonate and TPU bumpers on the back, which results in 360-degree protection. However, this adds a little bulk to the case, but I’d say you should be better safe than sorry. It is compatible with all wireless chargers but not MagSafe.

Pros

  • 20 feet Military-grade protection
  • Kickstand and screen protector
  • Slim Fit

Cons

  • No MagSafe-compatibility
  • Bulky

Check out on Amazon: iPhone 14 Plus | iPhone 14 Pro Max

3. HOYZNBI shockproof case – Ergonomically Design Grip

If 20ft military-grade protection is less for you, the HOYZNBI shockproof case can be perfect. It comes with a whopping 48-feet military-grade protection. Moreover, it has a double-layered structure that is soft inside and hard outside, made of polycarbonate material with nano-coating technology.

The 1.5mm raised frame on the camera and thickened corners keep your iPhone durable to a great extent. It also keeps your iPhone cool and has vented channels for heat dissipation. There’s support for wireless charging, but not MagSafe for some reason.

Pros

  • 48-feet Military-grade protection
  • Cooling vents for heat dissipation
  • Wireless charging compatible

Cons

  • No MagSafe support

Check out on Amazon: iPhone 14 Plus

4. Supcase Unicorn Beetle Pro – 360° protection case

The SUPCASE Unicorn Beetle Pro is a highly-rated protective case designed to safeguard your iPhone with an array of features. One key attribute that sets it apart from other cases is its compatibility with MagSafe technology, allowing for convenient use with wireless chargers. 

Moreover, the rugged case also includes an integrated screen protector that provides exceptional scratch protection without compromising the iPhone’s touch sensitivity. With this feature, your iPhone can remain functional while also being shielded from everyday wear and tear. 

Furthermore, the detachable swiveling belt clip in the case enables you to carry your phone hands-free and pocket-free. The clip also provides you with an optimal viewing angle for activities like streaming videos or making video calls. 

Pros

  • Durable 
  • Value for money 
  • Wireless charging compatible 
  • Stylish design 

Cons

  • Bulky design 
  • Color options are limited 

Check out on Amazon: iPhone 14 Plus | iPhone 14 Pro Max

5. CaseBorne V – Best ultimate protection

If you don’t care about wireless charging and are just looking for pure protection, the CaseBorne V rugged case is your answer. It was tested in multiple scenarios (a wall smash test and running a car over), and it kept the iPhone safe. You get 21ft drop protection with this rugged case.

The case is tough outside but has a foam layer that keeps it soft inside, giving it a multi-layer design. Also, you get a built-in kickstand that keeps your iPhone upright without touching it. Finally, it works with wireless charging, but the case manufacturer doesn’t recommend using it. Unfortunately, there’s no support for MagSafe either.

Pros

  • 21-feet Military-grade protection
  • Built-in kickstand
  • Wireless charging compatible

Cons

  • No MagSafe

Check out on Amazon: iPhone 14 Plus | iPhone 14 Pro Max

6. OtterBox – Industry-grade protection

As someone who is always on the go, I need a phone case that can keep up with my busy lifestyle. Fortunately, this OtterBox rugged case is the perfect solution.  

The OtterBox rugged case combines practical design with military-grade security. I can rest easy knowing that my phone is protected from unintentional drops and shocks. 

I particularly value the integrated RokLock Twist lock system because it makes it simple for me to use twist lock bike mounts, motorbike mounts, and automobile mounts. When I travel, this function makes connectivity and navigation easier. 

The OtterBox tough case is compact and lightweight, and it fits perfectly in my pocket despite providing excellent protection. Overall, I’m satisfied with the product and would advise anyone looking for a dependable phone cover to get this tough and practical case. 

Pros

  • Convenient design 
  • Better grip 
  • Slim fit 

Cons

  • Fewer color options 
  • Expensive 

Check out on Amazon: iPhone 14 Plus | iPhone 14 Pro Max

7. URBAN ARMOR GEAR – Heavy-duty iPhone case

URBAN ARMOR GEAR is another heavy-duty, multi-layer case for my list of the best-rugged cases for iPhone 14 Plus or Pro Max devices. This case has a sturdy exterior made up of a shock-absorbing core, layers of carbon fiber and leather, a polycarbonate shear plate, alloy metal hardware, and an impact-resistant rubber surround. 

The case also boasts a honeycomb traction grip that enhances grip and keeps it from unintentionally slipping out of your hand. Additionally, thanks to the raised lips at the back, your iPhone’s screen and camera lens are shielded from scratches, bumps, and other harm. 

Moreover, it has features that improve functionality, like ultra-responsive, oversized tactile buttons with a clear, crisp click-feel that increases usability. This case works with Apple Pay and most third-party wireless chargers. 

It has also been certified by a third-party lab to be military grade and tested to withstand falls of up to 20 feet (6 meters), so you can be sure it can withstand the worst circumstances. URBAN ARMOR GEAR is a great option if you’re searching for a dependable, robust case to safeguard your iPhone. 

Pros

  • Provides multi-layer protection 
  • Soft and impact-resistant core 
  • Enhanced grip 
  • Protruding design 

Cons

  • Adds some bulk and weight 
  • Comparatively expensive 

Check out on Amazon: iPhone 14 Plus | iPhone 14 Pro Max

8. Smartish – Durability personified 

The Smartish protective case can be exactly what you need if you are seeking a case that can handle the most difficult of environments. This case assures that gravity won’t stand a chance against your device thanks to its strong protection features. 

It can withstand drops of up to 6 feet onto concrete, thanks to its shock-absorbing air-pocket corners that cushion your phone from impact. Hence, whether you’re an explorer, an athlete, or just a busy person on the go, the case will protect your iPhone. 

Aside from its durable appearance, this sturdy case has textured sides that offer a great grip, ensuring that you won’t drop your phone. When your phone is face up or face down, the raised bumper edges keep it raised, preventing cracks and scratches to the screen. 

Due to the case’s own powerful magnets that are baked in, it is also compatible with MagSafe chargers and accessories. Since it is a great combination of comfort and strength, it is one of the most robust cases for the iPhone 14 Pro Max. 

Pros

  • Can withstand everyday wear and tear 
  • Precise cutouts  
  • Comes in a variety of colors and styles
  • Affordable

Cons

  • Bulky 
  • Slippery 
  • Unsure about the durability 

Check out on Amazon: iPhone 14 Plus | iPhone 14 Pro Max

9. Rockform – Premium rugged case

You can use a MagSafe charger with the Rokform case, which securely holds your iPhone using strong industrial-grade magnets. However, its strength is not only its noteworthy quality but with the integrated RokLock Twist lock system, you may use any of their twist lock mounts for your bike, motorcycle, or automobile with ease. 

In addition, the case also includes strengthened corners and improved camera and screen protection, which help it endure drops and shocks up to four times better than conventional cases. In fact, it surpasses the MIL-STD 801G-516.6 military-grade specifications. 

The case is lightweight, and its slim design will fit your iPhone perfectly and will offer 360-degree protection from all sides without adding any extra bulk. But what really distinguishes it is its adaptability and portability, as it lets you carry it in your pocket or purse with ease. 

Pros

  • MagSafe compatible 
  • Military-grade standards 
  • Slim & Lightweight 

Cons

  • Slightly expensive 
  • Limited color options 

Check out on Amazon: iPhone 14 Plus | iPhone 14 Pro Max

10. Belemay – The leather folio case 

The Belemay case is a high-quality leather wallet phone cover made to guard your iPhone 14 Pro Max or Plus against drops, knocks, scuffs, and water stains. With three card slots and one bill section for your everyday necessities, this stylish case is made of premium Italian leather and fitted with cutting-edge RFID-blocking technology. 

A shockproof TPU shell wraps around all four corners of the case, providing superior drop protection around the cameras and front screen. A leather folio can also be folded into a stand that allows hands-free viewing at home or on the road.  

The case is not compatible with MagSafe or wireless chargers. The company provides lifetime replacement warranties for quality-related problems. The Belemay case is a great option if you want a stylish and reliable iPhone wallet case. 

Pros

  • High-quality leather material 
  • Multiple card slots 
  • Genuine leather 
  • Multiple color options 

Cons

  • Not MagSafe compatibility

Check out on Amazon: iPhone 14 Plus | iPhone 14 Pro Max

Get a rugged case for your iPhone…

These were some of the best rugged cases for iPhone 14 Plus and 14 Pro Max. Rugged cases are known for their best protection in even the worst cases. However, they can feel a little bulky. Ultimately, it’s your call if you want rugged cases or others.

title.rendered: Top iPad mini 6 Accessories to Improve Your Experience

content.rendered:
The iPad mini 6 is one of my favorite devices, but a few extras can make it even better. Yes, I’m talking about the best iPad mini 6 accessories that can help you get more out of this power-packed tablet. From protection to enhanced functionality, the list below covers it all and applies to all kinds of different use cases.

1. ESR folio case: All-round protection

There are many great cases for iPad mini 6, but my favorite is this one from ESR that’s got a slim polycarbonate back with a sleek folio cover. It offers all-around protection to keep away scratches and minor bumps. 

Moreover, there’s a magnetic clasp that wraps around your Apple Pencil to secure it while charging and keep the case securely closed to protect your screen. You can also prop up your iPad mini in three different viewing angles for watching something or working with your stylus. 

Pros

  • All-round protection
  • Includes a kickstand
  • Holds the Apple Pencil
  • Affordable price
  • Four color options

Cons

  • The clasp feels a bit clunky

Check out on Amazon

2. Ailun screen protector: Keep scratches away

There’s nothing as traumatic as damaging your device’s display. Why take the risk when screen protection is so affordable and readily available? Check out this hard, tempered glass screen protector that’s just what your iPad mini needs. 

It maintains the original touch screen sensitivity and has an oleophobic coating to keep away fingerprint smudges. Moreover, it’s easy to install and remove. The curved edges fit perfectly around your iPad mini without adding any weight. What’s more? It comes with a 12-month warranty. 

Pros

  • Easy to install and remove
  • Oleophobic coating
  • Inexpensive
  • 12-month warranty

Cons

  • None

Check out on Amazon

3. MoKo sleeve: Carry in style

If you’re always on the go, it’s a good idea to get a sleeve for additional protection. I love this one from MoKo made of premium polyester and a high-density fluff lining that keeps away scratches, dust, splashes, and other dangers.

Moreover, it can provide shock absorption when your tablet is in your bag or if it accidentally falls. There’s also a smooth and durable zipper to prevent your device from accidentally falling out. The best part is that it’s lightweight, stylish, and available in eight colors. 

Pros

  • Stylish
  • Soft and cushioned
  • 8 color options
  • High-quality zipper

Cons

  • None

Check out on Amazon

4. Logitech wireless keyboard: Use your iPad mini like a computer

Although the iPad mini is a bit small to truly use as a laptop, you can still use a keyboard with it for easier typing. Apart from keyboard cases, I love this Logitech keyboard with an integrated cradle to hold your tablet at the right angle to read while you type.

The great thing is that it works across your tablet, phone, or computer. So, it’s compatible with Windows, Mac, iPadOS, iOS, and Android. At the same time, it’s also small and portable while still being comfortable enough to type on. This makes it one of the best iPad mini 6 accessories for students and professionals.

Pros

  • Ergonomic design for comfortable typing
  • Cost-effective
  • Cross-platform compatibility

Cons

  • Feels a bit heavy

Check out on Amazon

5. Twelve South HoverBar Duo: Multifunctional stand

I love the iPad mini for its portability, but sometimes you need it to sit still so you can watch something, record a video, or hop onto or video call. Hence begins the hunt for the perfect stand, and the Twelve South HoverBar Duo is the best one I’ve tried.  

It includes a weighted desktop stand and shelf clamp for maximum flexibility and value. Plus, it’s fully adjustable, and you can place your iPad in almost any angle you desire. This is perfect for content creators.

Moreover, it can hold any other phone or tablet too. It’s the perfect stand to use with the Center Stage feature on your iPad mini.

For more details, check out my full review of the Twelve South HoverBar Duo.  

Pros

  • Multiple angles
  • Robust build quality
  • Ideal for watching and recording videos, plus making calls
  • Compatible with any phone or tablet

Cons

  • Shelf clamp may not fit on thicker tables or shelves.

Check out on Amazon

6. Apple Pencil 2: Must-have for writers & artists

If you love writing or sketching, the Apple Pencil 2 is a life-changing little gadget. It expands your creative possibilities by allowing you to quickly digitize your words or creations to take them to the next level.

Although there are other stylus, the Apple Pencil boasts pixel-perfect precision, plus tilt and pressure sensitivity. Moreover, it magnetically attaches to iPad mini, charges wirelessly, and lets you change tools with a simple double-tap. Pretty nifty! 

Pros

  • Super smooth performance without lag
  • Tilt and pressure sensitivity for detailing
  • Magnetic attachment and charging

Cons

  • Pricey

Check out on Amazon

7. Hiearcool USB-C dongle: Must-have for connectivity

The iPad mini 6 comes with a USB-C port, and you can expand its capabilities with this dongle. It perfectly combines all the functions you need, such as an HDMI port, two USB 3.0 ports, SD/TF Card Adapter, and a Type-C Power Delivery charging port.

You can enjoy lifelike 4K 3840 x 2160 30Hz HDMI images that bring an immersive 3D resolution experience. Further, the dongle is super lightweight and portable for everyday convenience. Of course, you can also use it with your MacBook.

Pros

  • Compact size
  • All the ports you need
  • Supports 4K
  • Multifunctional

Cons

  • Build quality could be better

Check out on Amazon

8. Cellet car mount: Convenient for your commute

Want to prop up your iPad mini in your car to see Maps while you drive? It’s easy-peasy with this handy stand. It provides a stable viewing platform with an adjustable base that perfectly fits vehicle cup holders from 2. 86 inches to 3. 47 inches.

The arm can be extended up to 13.5 inches, and the protective soft holder will not scratch your device. It’s also got a 360-degree rotational ability to adjust the viewing angle as required.

Pros

  • Sturdy
  • Easy to install
  • Adjustable viewing angles
  • Firm grip on your tablet

Cons

  • Takes up the cup holder space, so you can’t use it.

Check out on Amazon

9. Anker USB-C power bank: Charge on-the-go

The iPad mini 6 battery life differs according to what you’re using it for. If you want to continue using it without interruptions, it’s wise to get a power bank. That’s why you need this PowerCore external battery with an 18W Power Delivery USB-C port and a PowerIQ-enabled USB-A port. You can use the dual USB ports to charge another device at the same time as your iPad.

Further, it’s got a sleek matte exterior and cool-blue LED light-wheel to display battery level. It’s a premium product, both inside and out. You also get a worry-free 18-month warranty and friendly customer service.

Pros

  • High capacity
  • Slim and lightweight
  • Affordable price
  • 18-month warranty

Cons

  • Takes all day to charge before use

Check out on Amazon

That’s my list of the top ten best iPad mini 6 accessories you need to make the most of your tablet. Let me know in the comments below what else you’d like to know.

Read more:

  • Best iPad mini 6 screen protectors
  • Best keyboard cases for iPad mini 6
  • Download the iPad mini 6 and 7 wallpapers in 4K

acceptedAnswer.text: App Clips require internet connectivity and won't work offline. Since they're only a part of the app, they need to connect to the app database to fetch the complete information and function properly.

acceptedAnswer.text: An App Clip is generally between 10MB and 15MB in size. Earlier, the restriction was to keep App Clips under 10MB, but with the introduction of better technology and internet connectivity, App Clips in iOS 16 or later can be up to 15MB large.

title.rendered: Best CRM Apps for iPhone and iPad in 2026

content.rendered:
Customer relationship management is a pragmatic practice that drives future growth. It is done through comprehensive planning and the right approach. Throughout the long and engaging process of managing your customers, you must be prepared to make the most of every opportunity coming your way. Though there are various ways to maintain a healthy rapport with customers, well-designed apps can bring amazing convenience. We have lined up the best CRM Apps for iPhone so that you can choose the most efficient app to boost your productivity.

1. Zendesk Sell

Base CRM Apps for iPhone and Sales Tracking app enable you to manage contacts, track sales and create tasks with great comfort. You can quickly sync the changes with the cloud to keep them fully secured.

It helps you capture info efficiently during or after meeting without having to take long steps.

You can add tasks and reminders so that you are always on task and never get late. With the use of Geo-location, it lets you visualize your customer on a map. Besides, you can log calls with clients, view the latest updates from your colleagues, and more.

Price: Free

Download

2. Contacts Journal CRM

Contacts Journal CRM has been designed to solve your customer relationship management activities immaculately. You can create private contacts and private groups to keep information separate and not allow them to mix up with your personal ones. Also you can call, SMS or even email your contacts right from the App.

You can easily attach documents to contacts via Wi-Fi. To bring some personal touch into play, you can also create custom fields and attach custom data to each contact. To remain informed about the upcoming assignments, you can add alerts to Notification Center.

With the use of Dropbox, you can transfer data between iPhone and iPad. It works even offline.

Price: Free

Download

3. Zoho CRM

Zoho CRM makes it very convenient for you to manage, edit, view, and create and delete contacts. It has a very significant search function to help you find out all the necessary info about your customers easily.

You can add or modify customer info even offline. It provides you the ability to call your clients directly from the app.

Price: Free

Download

4. Nimble

Nimble helps you in building an excellent rapport with your customers in some clever ways. It allows you to gather all the necessary info such as contact details, insights, email, and more at one place so that you can easily retrieve them.

This app is equipped to deliver insights about your contacts, mutual interest, shared passions and lots of other important things thanks largely to its ability to search the web and social networks.

Price: Free

Download

5. Salesmate – Sales CRM

Here’s an all-in-one CRM app that makes it a breeze to manage your sales process and pipeline from the comfort of your iPhone or iPad. It primarily helps you gain control of your sales results by focusing on all the right contacts to stimulate business growth.

Further, it boasts many useful features like two-way email sync, locating your nearby contacts, comprehensive information about your prospects, and more. It’s been designed as a companion to the Salesmate CRM web app and supports integration with over 600+ third-party apps, including Google Apps.

Price: Free

Download

6. Microsoft Dynamics CRM

Microsoft Dynamics CRM has been designed to help you remain updated with your customer info in the easiest possible way. It allows you to get prepared in advance for every appointment. With the use of it, you can update your notes, tasks, contacts, accounts, and leads conveniently.

You can quickly enter customer data with just a few steps, track progress, access your accounts, contacts, and more from the dashboard easily.

Price: Free

Download

7. Insightly CRM

Insightly CRM has been smartly designed to carry out the assigned task with precision. This app lets you call, email, text message, and map your shared contacts. You can manage contacts, projects, and view email shared by others in a team with ease.

You can sign up for a free amount of up to 3 users.

Price: Free

Download

8. OnePageCRM

OnePageCRM is an easy to use tool to convert sales to a simple to-do list. The simple UI enables salespeople to manage their contacts, sales, to-do lists, log calls, and create new tasks. You can also integrate the OnePageCRM with MailChimp, Unbounce, Wufoo, Skype, Evernote, Google Apps, Help Scout, and Zapier to make the most out of it.

It is a professional app with great productivity features that actually helps. The app is free to download and use. However, you will need to have a OnePageCRM account, to begin with.

Price: Free

Download

9. Capsule CRM

Capsule CRM is very simple to use. This app allows you to start calls or email directly from a contact’s profile. You can view a contact’s location on the map; see the history of emails and notes about a contact.

It lets you keep track of sales opportunities. Moreover, you can create and assign follow-up tasks depending on requirements.

Price: Free

Download

That’s all!

What’s your pick?

So, which one have you handpicked to bolster your productivity? Is it the lightweight CRM Apps for iPhone or the one that’s fully-featured? Let us know its name.

You might want to refer these posts as well:

  • Best Project Manager Apps
  • Zoho Assist for Mac
