title.rendered: Top-Rated Cases for iPhone 14 and 14 Pro to Buy in 2026

content.rendered:
Apple announced the iPhone 14 series at the “Far Out” event on September 7, 2022. It has a similar design to the iPhone 13 series. The iPhone 14 and 14 Pro sport a 6.1-inch display, so I’ve put together a list of the best iPhone 14 and 14 Pro cases you can get right now.

Table of Contents
  • 1. Apple leather case with MagSafe – Editor's choice
  • 2. Encased Rebel Series – Bundled with a screen protector
  • 3. Spigen Mag Armor (MagFit) – Sheer elegance
  • 4. ESR Project Zero clear case – Flaunt your iPhone's color
  • 5. Torras crystal clear case – Ultra-thin
  • 6. Mujjo full leather case – Environment-friendly
  • 7. ESR metal kickstand case – Enabling a hands-free experience
  • 8. Torro kickstand case – Most protective
  • 9. i-Blason Ares – 360-degree protection

1. Apple leather case with MagSafe – Editor’s choice

Here is Apple’s provision to protect your iPhone 14 and 14 Pro. In addition to some modifications to suit the new short beasts, this one retains the typical features of Apple’s iPhone cases. Apple’s iPhone 14 and 14 Pro leather cases came out a few moments after Apple announced the release of its new premium lineup. This case is available in five colors; amber, forest green, ink, midnight, and orange.

It’s tanned leather, a snug fit, with a soft texture and patina finish despite being tough. That’s not surprising. Besides, Apple has designed it specifically for the iPhone 14 series. The raised edges, clear-cut ports, and button protrusions are factory standard and well-fitted to add extra protection against fall or impact.

The inner layer is lined with a sensory magnet to offer a smart attach and detach experience. The magnetic units eat deep into its functionality by giving you the fast-charging capability to keep your iPhone 14 or 14 Pro running.

Pros

  • Apple-recommended case for the iPhone 14 series
  • Fast charging on MagSafe
  • Different color options are available
  • Strong, tanned leather with a patina finish
  • Raised edges enhance the protection of the iPhone 14 series units

Cons

  • Expensive
  • Gets a MagSafe marking upon prolonged use

Check out on Amazon: iPhone 14

2. Encased Rebel Series – Bundled with a screen protector

Encased Rebel Series offers a sturdy back cover with an HD tempered glass screen protector. So, your new iPhone 14 is safe and secured from every side. The brand has incorporated a multi-layer protective design with wireless charging compatibility. You will see a rubberized internal backplate for better stress absorption and a rigid PC outer cover for durability. 

This durable dual-hybrid case, it has passed the 10-foot mil-grade drop test as well. There is a reinforced camera guard included to protect the camera bump. You won’t have to worry about dropping your iPhone because of its rubbery non-slip edges. Moreover, tactile buttons make it easy to operate. The best part is you will get a limited lifetime guarantee.  

As the case is slightly thick, you may notice slow wireless charging with the case on. The iPhone 14 and 14 Pro cases have two color options: black and purple. I liked the unique purple color; it looks funky!

Pros

  • Multi-layer protection
  • Rubberized internal backplate
  • Textured sides for better grip 
  • Non-slip edges

Cons

  • Gets scratches
  • Limited color options

Check out on Amazon: iPhone 14 | iPhone 14 Pro

3. Spigen Mag Armor (MagFit) – Sheer elegance

Feature-rich products packed with all the necessary protection protocols are hard to come by. However, the Spigen Mag Armor (MagFit) is one of a kind.  

The case weighs around 1/15 ounces or 32.8 grams. It is made out of TPU, and it features magnet-integrated shock absorption. The side has an Air Cushion, and you’ll get raised lips to protect the display against drops, etc.  

You do not miss out on MagSafe charging as the case comes with a magnetic ring. It also features solid feedback buttons, which are easy to press and maintain tactile feedback of the iPhone 14. It is available in Matte Black and Navy Blue.

Pros

  • Sleek and textured back 
  • Tactile button feedback 
  • Textured sides for better grip 
  • MagSafe magnetic ring 
  • Extra protection, thanks to raised lip and camera bump 

Cons

  • No significant cons 

Check out on Amazon: iPhone 14 Pro

4. ESR Project Zero clear case – Flaunt your iPhone’s color 

The iPhone 14 series comes in great colors. I love the Blue and Product Red iPhone 14 and the Deep Purple iPhone 14 Pro. If you’re looking for a clear case to flaunt your new iPhone’s color, the ESR Project Zero is the right choice.  

The camera guard and air guard enable military-grade protection to ensure a dropped iPhone doesn’t ruin your day. ESR also states that the product is made from high-quality TPU material that takes longer to scratch and turn yellow.  

Get the ESR Project Zero if you’re looking for a case that doesn’t look bulky and lets you flaunt your iPhone without compromising its safety.  

Pros

  • Military-grade protection  
  • Only 1.6mm thick 
  • The high-quality TPU material takes longer to scratch and turns yellow 

Cons

  • Will turn yellow after a certain amount of time 

Check out on ESR: iPhone 14 | iPhone 14 Pro

5. Torras crystal clear case – Ultra-thin

If you care about protection more than anything else, the Torras slim protective case is the right choice. It has a translucent back with bumper edges on the camera and has 10ft military-grade drop protection.  

While providing excellent protection, it doesn’t compromise on the in-hand feel. It is slim and grippy in hand. The case also supports MagSafe magnets on the case, which enable fast wireless charging speeds. The case is available in matte black and matte blue.

Pros

  • Military-grade drop protection 
  • Grippy edges 
  • MagSafe magnets to enable fast wireless charging 

Cons

  • No significant cons 

Check out on Amazon: iPhone 14 | iPhone 14 Pro

6. Mujjo full leather case – Environment-friendly

I loved Mujjo’s iPhone 13 leather case. The leather cases for the iPhone 14 and 14 Pro are even better with a few more details added. This Mujjo leather case for the iPhone 14 series is crafted from vegetable leather that has been tanned to retain its patina over time. As a result, it is a better choice for the environment.

The Mujjo leather case is available in brown color only. The case looks bright regardless and pitches elegance. It also supports wireless charging.

I find the raised edges around the camera region protective enough for your iPhone 14 or 14 Pro lens. The skin around the screen protrudes by 1mm to prevent direct impact on your iPhone screen. Like other cases on the list, you’ll love the detail in the port cuts and button protrusions.

Pros

  • Tanned vegetable leather confers strength and is environmentally friendly
  • Raised edges around camera and screen regions protect against impacts

Cons

  • No significant cons

Check out on Mujjo: iPhone 14 | iPhone 14 Pro

7. ESR metal kickstand case – Enabling a hands-free experience

Many of us use the iPhone as a media consumption device thanks to its amazing display with accurate colors. But holding the iPhone 14 for long durations is painful, and the ESR Metal kickstand case enables a hands-free experience.  

Open the stand and keep your device on the table or any flat surface to view content without holding your iPhone for long hours.  

It has precise cutouts, is wireless charging compatible, and enables tactile button feedback. The case is available in black with a clear, non-slip textured design.

Pros

  • Strong kickstand  
  • Military-grade protection 
  • Textured design for great grip 

Cons

  • The clear variant will eventually turn yellow 

Check out on ESR: iPhone 14 | iPhone 14 Pro

8. Torro kickstand case – Most protective

The Torro leather case for the iPhone 14 series is ideal for you if you love your leather grained. Torro is a wallet design featuring a fitting card holder inside the closure, which also folds into a kickstand for convenience. Purely carved out of genuine leather, this case for the iPhone 14 series is undoubtedly rugged and snug fit.

The inner part of the screen cover is lined with thermoplastic polyurethane, ensuring your device stays shockproof all day. The Torro leather case might cover your iPhone 14’s glory, but you’ll be protecting the screen. The case also protrudes around the screen and camera edges for further protection.

Pros

  • Kickstand available
  • The wallet design offers extra protection for the screen
  • Raised edges add more protection

Cons

  • It doesn’t support MagSafe

Check out on Amazon: iPhone 14 | iPhone 14 Pro 

9. i-Blason Ares – 360-degree protection

The i-Blason Ares rugged bumper case is for those who want their iPhone to be in pristine condition and do not mind the additional bulk. It also features an in-built screen protector.

While this case adds significant bulk to your iPhone, it ensures 360-degree protection and is available in various colors. It also supports wireless charging and has tactile buttons and accurate cutouts. 

Pros

  • 360-degree protection 
  • In-built screen protector 
  • Wireless charging compatible

Cons

  • Bulky design 

Check out on Amazon: iPhone 14 | iPhone 14 Pro

These were some of the best cases for the newly launched iPhone 14 and iPhone 14 Pro. If you have other case recommendations, leave them in the comments below.  

Read more:  

  • Best waterproof cases for iPhone 14 and 14 Pro
  • How to use Emergency SOS via Satellite on iPhone and Apple Watch.

acceptedAnswer.text: If you actively use Facebook daily, the cache files can quickly pile up. So, you must delete them once every 1-2 weeks. For moderate users, clearing the cache once every month is sufficient.

title.rendered: Best Charging Stands for Apple Watch in 2025

content.rendered:
The Apple Watch comes in various models, the latest being the Apple Watch 6 and SE. Older ones include Series 5, 4, and 3. No matter which one you own, one of the essential accessories to get is a charging station. This handy place to keep your watch while charging or at night. Many stands support nightstand mode for your watch; automatically turning it into an alarm clock makes life even more convenient. So, take your pick from these best charging stands for your Apple Watch.

Best Apple Watch charging stands to buy (Our top picks)

1. Apple Magnetic Charging Dock

This magnetic charging dock from Apple lets you charge your watch in a flat position with the band open. When you dock your watch sideways, it will automatically put it into Nightstand mode so you can use it as an alarm clock.

Of course, the charging dock is compatible with all models of the Apple Watch and uses the same charging connector that comes with your watch. You can connect it via the Lightning to USB Cable and Apple 5W USB Power Adapter.

Pros

  •  Sleek design
  • Minimalist
  • Original Apple product

Cons

  • A bit pricey

Check out on Amazon

2. Spigen S350 Apple Watch Stand

Conveniently place and charge your watch on this sleek stand with the strap open or closed. It’s compatible with nightstand mode and the original Apple charging cable.

Further, it’s designed for quick and easy access, and You can choose from five color options. However, although it’s compatible with all watch models, it might not accommodate some bulkier cases. Choose from five color options.

Pros

  • Compatible with Nightstand mode
  • Small and portable
  • Color options

Cons

  •  Might not accommodate a watch with a bulky case

Check out on Amazon

3. elago W2 Apple Watch Charger Stand

This cute little Apple Watch stand would be a nifty addition to your bedside table or desk. It’s got precise cutouts that ensure your charging cable stays in place while also looking tidy and organized.

Further, the premium silicone keeps your watch scratch-free and prevents the stand from moving while resting on a surface. Moreover, it comes in a wide range of colors to suit your preferences.

Pros

  • Compact design
  • Scratch-free material
  • Color options

Cons

  • Easily slips off surfaces.

Check out on Amazon

4. Twelve South TimePorter for Apple Watch

Here’s an Apple Watch charging stand cum case that’s designed to make traveling with your Apple Watch worry-free. It’s handy 3-in-1 design makes it a compact travel case, a bedside charging stand, and a storage box for your watch accessories.

Further, there’s a silicone cap on the integrated cutout to holds your magnetic charging disk securely in the lid. You can adjust the lid to your preferred angle to charge in standard or nightstand mode.

Pros

  • Ideal for travel
  • Compact size
  • Storage for accessories

Cons

  • No color options

Check out on Amazon

5. Transeca Apple Watch Charging Dock

This tailor-made Apple watch charger holder ensures a snug fit and keeps your charging cable tidy. It makes the overall Apple watch charging setup easy and straightforward.

It’s the perfect solution as a bedside charging stand or even to put your Apple Watch into nightstand mode. Start charging automatically by merely putting your Apple watch on the stand without needing to remove the band.

Pros 

  • Snug fit
  • Four color options
  • Neat cable management

Cons 

  • Ergonomics could be better.

Check out on Amazon

6. Orzly Charging & Display Stand

This Apple Watch charging dock boasts a sturdy design and a refined look. It’s designed to make charging and displaying your Apple Watch as convenient as possible by acting as a nightstand or desk dock stand.

The notch’s design keeps the overlong Apple Watch magnetic charging cable tidy to prevent clutter on your desk. Moreover, the durable TPU material is sturdy but also lightweight and compact.

Pros

  • Sturdy build
  • Compact size
  • Durable material

Cons

  • Limited color options

Check out on Amazon

7. MoKo Charging Station

This stand is constructed of durable scratch-free TPU material with a weighted and non-slip base for a solid build. It supports your Apple Watch at a stable and comfortable viewing angle.

The open structure of the dock efficiently accommodates the magnetic charge. Further, the strong adhesive attaches firmly to the surface where you place it, preventing accidental slips.

Pros

  • Strong adhesive
  • Compact design
  • Scratch-proof TPU

Cons

  • No color options

Check out on Amazon

8. ZVEproof Charging Stand for iPhone and Apple Watch

The impressive aluminum build of this Apple Watch charging stand makes it stand out from the crowd. It’s convenient to keep your iPhone along with your watch. Plus, it can be adjusted to have a more convenient viewing angle.

Further, the anti-skidding rubber pads can protect your device from slipping and scratching. It’s sturdy and ergonomic, with smooth edges. You can choose from a range of finishings that will look good in any space.

Pros

  • Beautiful finishing
  • Holds iPhone and watch
  • Comfortable viewing angles

Cons

  • A bit big

Check out on Amazon

Summing Up!

Which of these Apple Watch charging stands did you like the best? Let us know in the comments section below. And don’t forget to get the best chargers for your watch too.

He dons the cap of editor-in-chief to make sure that articles match the quality standard before they are published."  About Dhvanesh Ever since teenage years, gadgets and technology have held a special place in Dhvanesh's heart. This fascination with gadgets and their inner workings fueled a lifelong passion for exploration and troubleshooting. Disassembled electronic items scattered around the house became a familiar sight during his younger years, a testament to this insatiable curiosity. From SEO Expert to Apple Evangelist After completing his IT engineering diploma, Dhvanesh's professional journey began with a 4.5-year stint as an SEO executive, honing valuable digital marketing skills. However, the desire to share tech knowledge and connect with a like-minded community proved stronger. In 2012, Dhvanesh embarked on a new adventure, founding iGeeksBlog. This blog became a haven for Apple enthusiasts and tech aficionados seeking insightful and in-depth information about everything Apple. A Decade of iGeeksBlog: Leading the Apple Charge In the past 12 years, Dhvanesh has donned multiple hats at iGeeksBlog. As the founder, he has steered the blog’s vision, ensuring it remains a trusted resource for Apple users worldwide. Additionally, he has been serving as the CEO of iGeeks Media Private Limited for the past 4 years, overseeing the company's growth and development. Beyond Writing: A Multifaceted Approach Dhvanesh isn't just a prolific writer, having penned hundreds of articles for iGeeksBlog. He has also served as the blog’s Editor-in-Chief and Content Strategist, ensuring a consistent flow of high-quality content that caters to the diverse needs of the Apple user base. The passion for exploration extends beyond the written word. He has created numerous YouTube videos for iGeeksBlog, providing visual demonstrations and engaging directly with the audience. Staying Connected with the Apple Ecosystem Dhvanesh's dedication to the Apple community goes a step further. Currently, he also manages the iGeeksBlog+ weekly newsletter, delivering curated Apple news, gadgets, apps, tips and tricks straight to subscribers' inboxes. This unwavering commitment to Apple technology and a genuine desire to empower fellow users make him a valuable asset to the iGeeksBlog team.

title.rendered: Best bumper cases for iPhone 14 Plus and 14 Pro Max in 2025

content.rendered:
The bigger iPhones look and feel premium, but they are more expensive. You wouldn’t risk the security of your iPhone, would you? Then you must get these best bumper cases for iPhone 14 Plus and 14 Pro Max with raised corners for superior drop protection. According to your preference, choose the right one from my hand-picked list of bumper cases.

1. Ringke Fusion bumper case – Editor’s choice

The Ringke Fusion bumper case is for minimal lovers like me. It has a robust hybrid polycarbonate clear casing with TPU bumper frame reinforcement. Besides, the strengthened corners and air pockets enhance impact protection.

Besides, the case is slim and lightweight, with sharp corner pads and a square frame design. With the integrated Duo-QuikCatch lanyard holes, connect hand straps for simple handling and to avoid unintentional slides.

The best part is it supports wireless charging and is compatible with screen protectors. Thus this case is perfect for those who are always on the go or like traveling.

Pros

  • Anti-shock space protection
  • Long-lasting transparency

Cons

  • Yellows with prolonged use

Check out on Amazon: iPhone 14 Plus | iPhone 14 Pro Max

Check out on Ringke: iPhone 14 Plus | iPhone 14 Pro Max

2. ESR Krystec clear case – MagSafe compatible

ESR offers one of the best, most durable, and transparent cases for iPhone 14 Pro Max and 14 Plus. The brand has used anti-yellowing, ultra-clear polycarbonate to provide military-grade protection.

It also has ESR’s signature HaloLock and MagSafe compatibility. Thanks to strong built-in magnets with 1,500 g of holding force, you can attach any magnetic accessories securely and quickly.

The shock-absorbing corners, polymer bottom edge, raised screen edges, and camera guard lens framing prevent scratches. Additionally, the sides are covered in thin polymer to improve grip and absorb stress. In addition, the polycarbonate buttons provide a smooth user experience.

Pros

  • HaloLock ensures a strong magnetic lock
  • MagSafe compatibility
  • Camera guard

Cons

  • No evident cons

Check out on Amazon: iPhone 14 Plus | iPhone 14 Pro Max

Check out on ESR: iPhone 14 Plus

3. Casekoo KooShock case – Zero-smudge matte finish

This case is for the ones who want a hardback and soft non-slip bumper case for your iPhone 14 Pro Max or 14 Plus. It provides extensive drop resistance and has passed 4500+ tests for 10ft Military-grade drop protection.

Furthermore, it has shock-absorbing rubber material and an upgraded shock-protection system consisting of 3-ply strengthened frame and 3-Gen AirShock.

The brand designed the case keeping the big display and larger camera sensor in mind. It elevated the 2.5mm and 1.5mm bezels specifically to guard against damage.

By combining matte coating with Bayer material using the three essential procedures of spraying, electroplating, and over-molding, the case offers zero fingerprints, zero scratches, and ease of cleaning. Also, the enhanced non-slip texture on both sides of the frame gives you a more stable grip.

Pros

  • 10ft Military-grade protection
  • Triple authority certification
  • Eco-friendly

Cons

  • The translucent shade is dark tinted

Check out on Amazon: iPhone 14 Plus | iPhone 14 Pro Max

4. Diaclara full-body rugged Case

The Diaclara rugged case offers 360-degree dual-layer protection. It provides a 2-pack hardness tempered glass camera lens protector to protect your camera.

With soft TPU bumper shock absorption, a 1.5mm raised screen edge, and a 4.6mm raised camera edge, your iPhone 14 Pro Max or 14 Plus is safeguarded from unintentional accidents.

Besides, the case has an integrated design with an inbuilt, touch-sensitive, anti-scratch screen protector for easy usage. So you can protect the delicate iPhone display from scratches and cracks. Wireless charging is an added advantage of this case.

Pros

  • Value for money
  • Lifetime free return & replacement
  • Wireless charging

Cons

  • Attracts dust, lint, etc.

Check out on Amazon: iPhone 14 Plus | iPhone 14 Pro Max

5. Spigen Tough Armor MagFit case

The Spigen Tough Armor provides dual-layer protection, a foam interior layer to cushion impact during drops, and a durable polycarbonate exterior. Besides, the Extreme Protection and Air Cushion technology level up the protection. The icing on the cake is the MagSafe support in this version. So, if you want a reasonably priced case that offers much protection, this is it. 

Besides, your new iPhone looks classy thanks to the boxy corners and matte surface, which also improves the grip. Also, the textured buttons offer reliable feedback and simple pressing. I liked the design with a hole in the center to display the gleaming Apple logo! There is also a built-in, foldable kickstand to use your phone in landscape mode (not a great one, though!).

Pros

  • Extra grip
  • Slim profile
  • Extreme protection technology

Cons

  • The kickstand is not durable

6. UAG Monarch rugged case – Great drop protection

mainEntity.name: Does clearing the cache delete any of my Facebook data?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not at all. Deleting the Facebook app cache does not affect your information. You will still stay logged into Facebook, and your friends list, shared photos, chats, and other activities will remain as they were.

mainEntity.name: Do iPhones show call waiting?

title.rendered: Best cases for iPad Air 13-inch and 11-inch (M2) in 2026

content.rendered:
After a two-year hiatus, Apple has finally unveiled the all-new iPad Air M2 lineup. This exclusive release introduces two new display sizes and a new XDR retina display, a feature previously limited to the iPad Pro lineup. However, with the superior display and a powerful M2 chip comes the responsibility of protecting the iPad Air against bumps and drops. To help you with it, I have curated this list of the best iPad Air 13-inch and 11-inch cases you can order right now.

Table of Content
  • Best cases for iPad Air 13-inch and 11-inch (M2)
    • 1. Apple Smart Folio case
    • 2. Spigen Air Skin Pro
    • 3. ESR Ascend Keyboard case
    • 4. Otterbox Defender Series
    • 5. ESR Classic hybrid back case

Best cases for iPad Air 13-inch and 11-inch (M2)

To prepare this list, I considered various factors such as weight, material, protection, compatibility, and practicality.

After hours of testing and research, I have found the best iPad Air (M2) cases for various use cases, including 11-inch and 13-inch sizes. Read the descriptions of each product and pick one that perfectly meets your requirements!

1. Apple Smart Folio case

  • Compatibility: iPad Air 11-inch and 13-inch (M2)
  • Product type: Smart folio
  • Material: Polyurethane
  • Weight: NA
  • Additional features: Wide range of viewing angles when folded

The Apple Smart Folio case perfectly fits your iPad Air M2 and provides reliable protection from both the front and the back. Its minimalistic design makes it ideal for users who prefer simplicity and sophistication.

While 0.45kg seems heavier, it is justifiable when considering the cost of the iPad and the protection this case offers. Along with top-notch protection, the Folio case offers a wide range of folded viewing angles. You can use it as a stand to attend FaceTime calls or watch your favorite web shows.

Moreover, the cover automatically wakes up the iPad when you open it and puts it back to sleep when you close it, eliminating the need to press the power button.

Price: $79

View at Apple: 13-inch iPad Air |11-inch iPad Air

2. Spigen Air Skin Pro

  • Compatibility: iPad Air 11-inch and 13-inch (M2)
  • Protection: Air Cushion Tech for extra drop protection
  • Material: PC, TPU, and premium vegan Velo leather
  • Weight: 0.31 kg
  • Additional features: Built-in Apple Pencil holder and triangle fold stand, sleep/wake functionality

The Spigen Air Skin Pro case for iPad Air M2 is the right choice if you want to flaunt your iPad Air’s unique color while protecting it from bumps and scratches.

The case offers a unique yet minimalistic design with a built-in Apple Pencil holder. So, you don’t have to worry about finding your Apple pencil the next time you want to jot down notes or make a sketch.

The Air cushion corners and vegan Velo leather built on the front provide reliable protection without sacrificing style.

Price: $64.99

View at: Spigen

3. ESR Ascend Keyboard case

  • Compatibility: iPad Air 11-inch (M2)
  • Protection: Military-grade protection
  • Material: NA
  • Weight: 1.05 kg
  • Additional features: Supports Pencil 2 magnetic pairing, dedicated keyboard with trackpad, long-lasting battery, detachable back case

If getting things done is your top priority, you simply can’t go wrong with the ESR Ascend keyboard case. Whether you are typing emails on the go, working on a project in a cafe, or watching your favorite Twitch streamer’s stream, this detachable keyboard case offers the versatility and protection that your iPad needs.

With a long-lasting battery, a backlit keyboard for low lighting conditions, and a freely adjustable stand, this cover is a must-have accessory for your M2 iPad Air.

Price: $119.99

View at: Amazon

4. Otterbox Defender Series

  • Compatibility: iPad Air 11-inch (M2)
  • Protection: Military-grade protection
  • Material: Polycarbonate, Synthetic Rubber, and Polyester
  • Weight: 0.44 kg
  • Additional features: Port covers, added touchscreen protection, tablet stand

One thing that sets this case apart from others on this list is that it comes with port covers to keep out dust and debris, making it perfect for users who work or travel in a rugged environment.

The ESR classic hybrid back case offers the traditional clear design while not compromising the protection it needs to offer. It has raised edges, a camera guard to protect against unwanted scratches, and shock-absorbing Air Guard corners for added drop protection.

Also, unlike other covers on this list, this one comes with full Apple Pencil 2 support, meaning you can magnetically charge your Apple Pencil 2 without taking off the case.
